title: Vacation Duck on a Swim Ring
description:
🕶️墨镜一戴
[蓝色心形R]谁都不爱

🧶线材：雪妃尔萌娃娃2号@雪妃尔毛线
🎨颜色：纯白 小鸡黄 橘色 浅湖蓝 黑色
🪡钩针：3mm
游泳圈的鸭子嘴巴和主体鸭子嘴巴一样，眼睛是3mm

**标签**: #钩针小物 #钩针玩偶 #治愈小鸭子 #手工钩织 #精神状态belike #可爱小物 #可爱鸭 #手工友人成长计划
author: 芷兰兮

patterns.englishText:
Vacation Duck on a Swim Ring — Duck, Sunglasses, Cup & Ring

Duck body (in the round)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: 4 sc, inc, 8 sc, inc, 4 sc (20)
Rnd 5: 5 sc, inc, 8 sc, inc, 5 sc (22)
Rnd 6: 5 sc, inc, 10 sc, inc, 5 sc (24)
Rnds 7-8: Sc around (24)
Rnd 9: 6 sc, inc, 10 sc, inc, 6 sc (26)
Rnd 10: 8 sc, inc, sc, inc, sc, 2 inc, sc, inc, sc, inc, 8 sc (32)
Rnd 11: 10 sc, *sc, inc* ×6, 10 sc (38)
Rnds 12-16: Sc around (38)
Rnd 17: Sc, *2 sc, dec, 2 sc* ×6, sc (32)
Rnd 18: *Sc, dec, sc* ×8 (24)
Rnd 19: *Sc, dec* ×8 (16)
Rnd 20: Dec ×8 (8). Stuff and close.

Wings (make 2, worked flat)
Row 1: Ch 2; inc in 2nd ch from hook
Row 2: Ch 1, turn; sc, inc
Rows 3-5: Ch 1, turn; 3 sc
Row 6: Ch 1, turn; dec, sc
Edge: Sc along both sides, 3 sc in each corner (see the little symbol chart).

Feet (make 2): Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR; Rnd 2: (ch 3, sl st) ×3 — the webbed toes.
Beak: Ch 3; from 2nd ch 2 sc.
Cup: Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: *sc, inc* ×3 (9).
Sunglasses (flat): Ch 6; from 2nd ch: sc, dc, ch, sl st, ch, dc, sc.
Swim ring tube: Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: inc around (12); Rnds 3-46: 12 sc. Sew the last round to Rnd 2, forming the donut.
Swim ring head (duck head on the ring): Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: inc around (12); Rnd 3: *sc, inc* ×6 (18); Rnds 4-6: 18 sc; Rnd 7: *sc, dec* ×6 (12).
patterns.notes: White duck in sunglasses lounging on a yellow duck-head swim ring, with a tiny drink cup. From the post: Xuefeier 萌娃娃2号 yarn (white, chick yellow, orange, light lake blue, black), 3.0 mm hook, 3 mm eyes; ring-duck beak same as main beak. Designer: 芷兰兮.

meta.intro: A vacation duck in sunglasses lounging on a duck-head swim ring with a tiny drink — a summery desk buddy made of four small pieces: duck, glasses, cup and the donut ring.
materials: Xuefeier 萌娃娃2号 yarn in white, chick yellow, orange, light lake blue and black

faq.question: How is the swim ring made?
faq.answer: Crochet a 12-sc tube for 46 rounds, then sew the last round to round 2 to close it into a donut. The little duck head on the ring is a separate ball with its own beak.

faq.question: How are the webbed feet made?
faq.answer: Five sc in a magic ring, then (ch 3, sl st) three times — each chain loop is one webbed toe.

faq.question: What about the sunglasses?
faq.answer: A single ch-6 row worked with sc, dc and chain picots forms both lenses; sew it across the face above the beak.

title: Pouty Happy Fish (Walking Fish Meme)
description:
🍔本鱼毕生所爱蟹黄堡和快乐水！喝了快乐水就是快乐的小鱼儿～～吃饱了，回家躺板板就变成了摆烂鱼了[黄金薯R]
[打卡R]其实本鱼才是真正享受生活的～吃饱了就睡💤睡饱了就吃～～～～～～～
图解：@简妮马德贵
🧶：@苏苏姐家 4股棉 柳绿 杏色 纯白 空蓝 浅橙等

**标签**: #比奇堡居民 #钩针小物 #海绵宝宝路人鱼 #原创图解 #钩针玩偶 #海绵宝宝龙套鱼 #钩织摆件
author: 简妮马德贵

patterns.englishText:
Pouty Happy Fish (Walking Fish Meme) — Part 1: Body, Shirt, Eyes & Fin

Materials: SuSu 4-ply cotton — willow green 25, apricot 53, pure white 64, sky blue 72, light orange 03, champagne 87, true red 51. Hooks 1.8 mm + 1.1 mm; 1.5 mm floral wire for shaping.

Body (start from the bottom)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×8 (24)
Rnd 4: *3 sc, inc* ×6 (30)
Rnd 5: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc* ×6 (36)
Rnd 6: (Leg opening) count 9 sts, start at the 10th st and work 18 sc, fasten off
Rnd 7: 36 sc — continue from the sl st at the start of Rnd 6, working the separately chained section together into 36 sts
Rnd 8: 16 sc, [color change] 4 sc, 16 sc
Rnd 9: 15 sc, [color] 6 sc, 15 sc
Rnd 10: 14 sc, [color] 8 sc, 14 sc
Rnd 11: Dec, 12 sc, [color] 8 sc, 12 sc, dec (34-36 per chart)
Rnds 12-22: 13 sc, [color] 8 sc, 13 sc
Rnd 23: Inc, 13 sc, [color] 6 sc, 13 sc, inc
Rnd 24: 16 sc, [color] 4 sc, 16 sc
Rnd 25: Sc around (36)
Rnd 26: Inc, 16 sc, 2 inc, 16 sc, inc (40)
Rnd 27: Sc around (40)
Rnd 28: (Mouth slit) leave 4 sts unworked in the middle, chain separately and work 36 sc
Rnd 29: Work 36 sc back and forth flat
Rnd 30: 36 sc, ch 4
Rnd 31: (3 sc, dec) ×2, 16 sc, (3 sc, dec) ×2, 4 sc
Rnd 32: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc* ×6
Rnd 33: *3 sc, dec* ×6 (24)
Rnd 34: Sc around (24)
Rnd 35: *Sc, dec, sc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 36: *Sc, dec* ×6 (12)
Rnd 37: Dec ×6. Close.

Shirt: Rnd 1: ch 36, join, 36 sc; Rnd 2: dec, 32 sc, dec; Rnds 3-11: 34 sc.
Eyes (make 2): Row 1: ch 4; from 2nd ch inc, sc, 3-sc-in-one, 2 sc; Rnd 2: 8 sc.
Eyelids (make 2, 2-ply, 1.1 mm): Row 1: ch 6; from 2nd ch inc, 3 sc, 3-sc-in-one, 4 sc; Rnd 2: inc, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc; Rnd 3: inc, 6 sc, inc, 6 sc; Rnd 4: 16 sc.
Mouth corners (2-ply, 1.8 mm): Ch 4; from 2nd ch sc, 2 sl st.
Fin: Ch 16; working into the back bump of the chain: sl st, 2 sc, 2 dc, 5 hdc, 2 dc, 2 sc, sl st.
patterns.chineseText:
撅嘴快乐鱼（@简妮马德贵）第1页
苏苏姐家4股：25柳绿.53杏色.64纯白.72空蓝.03浅橙.87香槟.51正红；钩针1.8mm+1.1mm+1.5mm定型条
主体从屁股开始：R1:环起8X / R2:8V / R3:(X,V)*8 / R4:(3X,V)*6 / R5:(2X,V,2X)*6 / R6:(另外起针)数9个针目，第10个针目开始钩18X断线 / R7:36X(从第6圈开头引拔处继续钩，链接另外起针的部分一起钩36X) / R8:16X,换线4X,16X / R9:15X,换线6X,15X / R10:14X,换线8X,14X / R11:A,12X,换线8X,12X,A / R12-R22:13X,换线8X,13X / R23:V,13X,换线6X,13X,V / R24:16X,换线4X,16X / R25:36X / R26:V,16X,2V,16X,V / R27:40X / R28:中间空4X,另外起针钩36X / R29:往返片钩36X / R30:36X,4CH / R31:(3X,A)*2,16X,(3X,A)*2,4X / R32:(2X,A,2X)*6 / R33:(3X,A)*6 / R34:24X / R35:(X,A,X)*6 / R36:(X,A)*6 / R37:6A
衣服：1:36CH,首尾相连36X / 2:A,32X,A / 3-11:34X
眼睛*2：1:4CH,倒二V,X,W,2X / 2:8X
眼皮拆2股1.1钩针*2：1:6CH,倒二V,3X,W,4X / 2:V,5X,V,5X / 3:V,6X,V,6X / 4:16X
嘴角拆2股1.8：4CH，倒二X,2SL
鱼鳍：16CH,倒二钩里山 SL,2X,2T,5F,2T,2X,SL
patterns.notes: Part 1 of the pouty 'happy fish' walking meme character (SpongeBob background fish) with drink cup. Non-commercial; pattern by @简妮马德贵. The white belly stripe is worked as inline color changes; body color blocks per the photos. See Part 2 for mouth, hands, cola, sleeves, feet and lid.

patterns.englishText:
Pouty Happy Fish — Part 2: Mouth, Hands, Cola Cup & Feet

Mouth
Rnd 1: Rejoin yarn in the 4 skipped sts: 4 sc, 2 sc in the mouth corner, 4 sc on the opposite side, 2 sc in the other corner
Rnd 2: Dec ×6
Rnd 3: Change color; FLO inc ×6 (the pouty lips).

Cola hand
Rnds 1-6: 6 sc in MR, sc around
Rnd 7: 4 sc, dec (5)
Rnds 8-21: Sc around (5).

Other hand
Row 1: Ch 4; from 2nd ch: 2 sc, 3-sc-in-one, sc, inc
Rnd 2: 8 sc
Rnd 3: 2 sc, 2 dec, 2 sc
Rnd 4: 6 sc
Rnd 5: 4 sc, dec
Rnds 6-8: 5 sc.

Sleeves (make 2)
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR
Rnd 2: *Sc, inc* ×2 (6)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×3 (9)
Rnds 4-5: Sc around (9).

Feet (make 2)
Rnds 1-10: 6 sc in MR, sc around
Rnd 11: 4 sc, dec (5)
Rnds 12-15: Sc around (5).

Cola cup (2-ply, 1.1 mm hook)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: BLO sc around (18)
Rnd 5: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnds 6-13: Sc around (24).

Lid
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: BLO sc around (24)
Straw: wrap yarn around wire/cord and glue it on.
patterns.chineseText:
撅嘴快乐鱼（@简妮马德贵）第2页
嘴巴：1:在空的4针里面重新起针 4X,嘴角2X,对面4X,嘴角2X / 2:6A / 3:换线钩外半针6V
拿可乐的手：R1-R6:环起6X / R7:4X,A / R8-R21:5X
另一个手：1:4CH,倒二钩2X,W,X,V / 2:8X / 3:2X,2A,2X / 4:6X / 5:4X,A / 6-8:5X
袖子*2：R1:环起4X / R2:(X,V)*2 / R3:(X,V)*3 / R4-R5:9X
脚*2：R1-R10:环起6X / R11:4X,A / R12-R15:5X
可乐拆2股1.1钩针：R1:环起6X / R2:6V / R3:(X,V)*6 / R4:钩内半针18X / R5:(X,V,X)*6 / R6-R13:24X
盖子：R1:环起6X / R2:6V / R3:(X,V)*6 / R4:(X,V,X)*6 / R5:钩内半针24X / 吸管绕线后粘上去
patterns.notes: Part 2 of the pouty happy fish: rework the 4 reserved mouth stitches for the pouting lips, skinny tube arms and legs, and a little cola cup with lid and straw. Stuff the arms into the sleeves before fixing to the body (per the photo captions).

meta.intro: The pouty 'walking home with a drink' fish meme as a full amigurumi: a color-blocked body with worked-in mouth and leg openings, sleepy eyelids, a removable shirt and a tiny cola cup with straw.
materials: SuSu 4-ply cotton (willow green, apricot, white, sky blue, light orange, champagne, red)

faq.question: How is the pouty mouth made?
faq.answer: Round 28 leaves 4 stitches unworked; you later rejoin in those stitches, work a small tube with corner increases, decrease, then finish with FLO increases in a new color for the protruding lips.

faq.question: Why do rounds 8-24 list stitch counts in three parts?
faq.answer: Those are inline color changes for the white belly stripe — e.g. '14 sc, [white] 8 sc, 14 sc'. Carry the second color inside the stitches.

faq.question: What is the wire for?
faq.answer: 1.5 mm floral wire stiffens the skinny legs and arms so the fish can stand and hold its cola cup.

title: Jellycat-Style Baby Mobile (Full Charm Set)
description:
收集了一堆jellcat图解
每天一点一点地钩，终于钩出来了[派对R]
jiojio都是通用jio～
图解来源看图解水印[斜眼R]

**标签**: #床铃 #钩织 #钩织图解 #一起来钩织 #钩针玩偶 #jellcat #想记录下此刻
author: 桃几MoMo

patterns.englishText:
Baby Mobile Bead Ring — Macaron Balls

First ball
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 6-9: Sc in each st around (30)
Rnd 10: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 11: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 12: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 13: Sc in each st around (12)
Change color.

Following balls (repeat)
Rnd 1: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 2: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 3: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 4-7: Sc in each st around (30)
Rnd 8: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 9: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 10: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 11: Sc in each st around (12)
Change color and repeat until the ring is the desired length, then join into a circle.
patterns.notes: Ring of connected stuffed balls forming the base circle of a Jellycat-style baby mobile. Work balls continuously, changing color after each; the post used 24 balls in 8 macaron colors, 3 repeats. Stuff as you go.

patterns.englishText:
Jellycat-Style Amuseable Heart — with Legs

Heart (make 2 lobes, then join)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: Sc in each st around (18)
Rnd 5: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnds 6-7: Sc in each st around (24)
Rnd 8: Fasten off the first lobe. Join the two lobes by working one stitch together, then sc in the remaining sts around both lobes (46)
Rnds 9-11: Sc in each st around (46)
Rnd 12: Dec once at each side (44)
Rnd 13: Sc around (44)
Rnd 14: Dec once at each side (42)
Rnd 15: *5 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (36)
Rnd 16: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 17: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 18: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 19: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 20: Dec around (6). Fasten off.

Legs (make 2)
Row 1: Ch 5; from 2nd ch from hook: 3 sc, 3 sc in next st, 3 sc working around the chain
Rnd 2: 3 sc, 3 inc, 3 sc
Rnd 3: 3 sc, 3 hdc-dec, 3 sc
Rnd 4: Sc, dc-dec, 2 hdc-dec, dc-dec, sc
Rnds 5-10: 6 sc around. Stuff lightly and sew to the heart.
patterns.chineseText:
jellycat爱心图解 (@MangOOOO)
1: 6X / 2: 6V / 3: 6(X,V) / 4: 18X / 5: 6(X,V,X) / 6-7: 24X
8: 第一个断线，然后合并两个合钩一针，剩下的针目钩46X
9-11: 46X / 12: 两侧各减一针44X / 13: 44X / 14: 两侧各减一针42X
15: 6(5X,A) / 16: 6(2X,A,2X) / 17: 6(3X,A) / 18: 6(X,A,X) / 19: 6(X,A) / 20: 6A
【jiojio】1: 5CH，倒2钩3X，W，3X / 2: 3X，3V，3X / 3: 3X，3FA，3X / 4: X，TA，2FA，TA，X / 5-10: 6X
patterns.notes: Jellycat-style plush heart made from two cup-shaped lobes joined into one body, with skinny dangling legs. Shorthand: W=3 sc in one st, FA=hdc decrease, TA=dc decrease.

patterns.englishText:
Mushroom Charm — Cap, Stem, Spots & Feet

Use a 3.0 mm hook throughout.

Mushroom cap (red)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (40)
Rnd 6: Sc, inc, *4 sc, inc* 7 times, 3 sc (48)
Rnd 7: Sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 8: Dc in each st around (48)
Rnd 9: BLO sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 10: Sc, dec, *4 sc, dec* 7 times, 3 sc (40)
Rnd 11: Change color. *3 sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 12: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 13: *Sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (16)

Stem (cream)
Rnd 1-4: 8 sc in MR; inc around (16); *sc, inc* ×8 (24); *sc, inc, sc* ×8 (32)
Rnd 5: Sc around (32), then *sc, dec, sc* ×8 (24)
Rnds 6-8: Sc around (24)
Rnd 9: *Sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (16)

White spots (make 5): 8 sc in MR, fasten off.
Feet: 6 sc in MR; inc around (12); 12 sc; 2 sc, 4 dec, 2 sc; 2 sc, 2 dec, 2 sc; 6 sc for 2 rounds. Fasten off.
patterns.notes: Hanging mushroom charm. Yarns named in the chart: JuKeAi #42 (cap), #14 (stem), #01 (white spots), XiaoDouZai #32 (feet); all with 3.0 mm hook. Sew spots on the cap, stuff cap and stem, join, add hanging loop.

patterns.englishText:
Amuseable Eggplant ("Boss Eggplant") — Body, Stem & Leaves

Body (purple)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 4: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 5: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (36)
Rnd 6: *5 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (42)
Rnd 7: *3 sc, inc, 3 sc*, repeat 6 times (48)
Rnd 8: *7 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (54)
Rnds 9-16: Sc in each st around (54)
Rnd 17: *7 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (48)
Rnds 18-22: Sc around (48)
Rnd 23: *3 sc, dec, 3 sc*, repeat 6 times (42)
Rnds 24-26: Sc around (42)
Rnd 27: *5 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (36)
Rnds 28-29: Sc around (36)
Rnd 30: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 31-34: Sc around (30)
Rnd 35: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnds 36-37: Sc around (24)
Rnd 38: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 39: Sc around (18)
Rnd 40: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 41: Dec around (6). Stuff and close.

Stem (green)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 2 times (8)
Rnds 3-7: Sc around (8)
Rnd 8: *Sc, inc*, repeat 4 times (12)
Rnd 9: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)

Leaf edge: Ch 6; from 2nd ch from hook work sl st, sc, dc, hdc, hdc. Make 6 leaves total, skipping 2 sts of the stem edge between leaves.
patterns.notes: Original designer: 柠檬糖手作 (public pattern, non-commercial use). Shorthand: x=sc, v=inc, A=dec, S=sl st, T=dc, F=hdc. Eyes/face embroidered; hang as a bag charm or make it palm-size.

patterns.englishText:
Jellycat-Style Boiled Egg — Egg White, Yolk & Feet

Egg white
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (30)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc*, repeat around (36)
Rnd 7: Sc in each st around (36)
Rnd 8: *5 sc, inc*, repeat around (42)
Rnd 9: *3 sc, inc, 3 sc*, repeat around (48)
Rnds 10-17: Sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 18: *3 sc, dec, 3 sc*, repeat around (42)
Rnds 19-20: Sc around (42)
Rnd 21: *5 sc, dec*, repeat around (36)
Rnds 22-23: Sc around (36)
Rnd 24: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat around (30)
Rnd 25: Sc around (30)
Rnd 26: *3 sc, dec*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 27: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat around (18)
Rnd 28: *Sc, dec*, repeat around (12)
Rnd 29: Dec around (6). Stuff and close.

Yolk (sew onto the front)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* around (30)
Rnd 6: *4 sc, inc* around (36)
Rnd 7: One round of sc in FLO only (36)

Feet (make 2)
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Inc around (10)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc) 2 times, 6 sc (12)
Rnds 4-5: Sc around (12)
Rnd 6: 3 dec, 6 sc (9)
Rnd 7: 3 dec, 3 sc (6)
Rnds 8-12: Sc around (6). Sew to the body.
patterns.notes: Jellycat-style boiled egg plush: white egg body with a flat yolk disc sewn on the front and small dangling feet. Embroider the face on the yolk.

patterns.englishText:
Coffee Cup Charm — Small & Large Versions

Use a 3.0 mm hook.

SMALL CUP (charm size)
Cup body
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×8 (24)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×8 (32)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×8 (40)
Rnd 6: BLO sc around (40)
Rnds 7-17: Sc around (40)
Lid: Repeat body Rnds 1-5 (40). Rnd 6: sc, inc, *4 sc, inc* ×7, 3 sc (48). Rnd 7: BLO dc around (48). Rnd 8: sc around (48). Rnd 9: *4 sc, dec* ×8 (40).
Cup sleeve: Ch 7; from 2nd ch work 6 sc. Work back and forth in BLO rows until it wraps the cup; join the last row to the first with sc.
Feet: 6 sc in MR; inc around (12); 12 sc; dec ×6 (6); 6 sc.

LARGE CUP (diffuser size)
Cup body: Rnds 1-5 as above (40). Rnd 6: sc, inc, *4 sc, inc* ×7, 3 sc (48). Rnd 7: BLO sc around (48). Rnds 8-21: sc around (48).
Lid: Repeat body Rnds 1-5. Rnd 6: *5 sc, inc* ×8 (48→56). Rnd 7: BLO dc around (56). Rnd 8: sc around (56). Rnd 9: *5 sc, dec* ×8 (48).
Cup sleeve: Ch 9; from 2nd ch work 8 sc; BLO rows to desired length (about 43 rows), join to first row.

patterns.englishText:
Jellycat-Style Amuseable Sun — Body, Rays & Legs

Yarn: plush chenille in yellow + brown; 4.0 mm hook; 6 mm safety eyes.

Body (make 2 discs? work as one ball)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×8 (24)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×8 (32)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×8 (40)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc* ×8 (48)
Rnd 7: Sc around in BLO (the loop facing away from you) (48)
Rnd 8: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc* ×8 (40)
Rnd 9: *3 sc, dec* ×8 (32)
Rnd 10: *2 sc, dec* ×8 (24)
Rnd 11: *Sc, dec* ×8 (16)
Rnd 12: Dec around (8). Stuff and close.

Rays (make several)
Rnds 1-2: 6 sc in MR; sc around (6)
Rnd 3: Sc, (sc, inc) ×2, sc (8)
Rnds 4-5: Sc around (8)
Flatten, work 4 sc across to close, then sew evenly around the body.

Legs (make 2)
Row 1: Ch 5; from 2nd ch: 3 sc, 3 sc in one st, 3 sc around the chain
Rnd 2: 3 sc, 3 inc, 3 sc
Rnd 3: 3 sc, 3 hdc-dec, 3 sc
Rnd 4: Dc-dec, hdc-dec, hdc, hdc-dec, dc-dec
Rnds 5-6: 5 sc around
Flatten, work 2 sc to close, sew to the body.

patterns.englishText:
Universal Jellycat-Style Feet (Make 2)

Row 1: Ch 6; starting from 2nd ch from hook: 4 sc, 3 sc in next st, 3 sc, inc (working around both sides of the chain)
Rnd 2: Inc, 3 sc, 3 inc, 3 sc, 2 inc (18)
Rnd 3: Sc around in BLO (18)

patterns.notes: Generic dangling feet that fit most Jellycat-style amigurumi in this mobile set. Shorthand: x=sc, v=inc, a=dec, w=3 sc in one st.

patterns.englishText:
Plush Flower — Petals & Center (Baby Mobile Piece)

Petals (make 5)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×6 (30)
Rnds 6-8: Sc around (30)
Rnd 9: *3 sc, dec* ×6 (24)
Rnd 10: Sc around (24)
Rnd 11: *2 sc, dec* ×6 (18)
Rnd 12: *Sc, dec* ×6 (12). Stuff lightly, close, sew 5 petals around the center.

Flower center (make 2)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc/dec — the chart is partly obscured here; working *3 sc, inc* ×6 gives (30), matching the 30 sc of the next rounds
Rnds 6-7: Sc around (30)

patterns.notes: Flower piece for the mobile, from a 3/3 screenshot by 春日鹿. In the source image Rnd 12 of the petals is annotated as (x,a)×6, and the flower-center Rnd 5 is partially blurred; the count that fits the following 30-sc rounds is *3 sc, inc*×6. flag note: single ambiguous row resolved by stitch math.

meta.intro: A complete Jellycat-style baby mobile: a ring of macaron-colored balls plus ten hanging charms including a heart, mushroom, eggplant, boiled egg, coffee cups, sun, cucumber and a plush flower. Patterns for every piece are collected in one place.
materials: 4-ply cotton and plush yarn in assorted colors
Safety eyes (6 mm for the sun)

faq.question: Do I have to make every charm?
faq.answer: No — each charm is an independent pattern. Pick your favorites and hang as many as your frame fits; the poster used a ring of 24 balls with about 8 charms.

faq.question: How do the little feet work?
faq.answer: Most charms share one universal foot pattern: an oval base from a ch-6 start, a BLO round, quick decreases and a skinny 6-sc tube. Make two per charm and sew them on.

faq.question: What holds the ring shape?
faq.answer: The base ring is a chain of stuffed balls crocheted continuously with color changes; joining the last ball to the first closes the circle, and the charms hang from it on cords.

title: Tiger Burger Keychain
description:
看着复杂
钩起来还蛮简单
不想买眼睛和鼻子配件
用线缝意思意思
图解来自@Moyam

**标签**: #钩针汉堡 #钩针老虎 #钩针挂件玩偶 #钩针动物 #钩针编织
author: 金姑棒JINGOODBANG

patterns.englishText:
Tiger Burger Charm — Bun, Lettuce, Tomato, Cheese & Patty

Head / top bun (tiger, orange)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×6 (30)
Rnds 6-7: Sc around (30)
Rnd 8: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc* ×6 (36)
Rnds 9-10: Change to white; sc around (36)
Rnd 11: BLO *4 sc, dec* ×6 (30)
Rnd 12: *3 sc, dec* ×6 (24)
Rnd 13: *2 sc, dec* ×6 (18)
Rnd 14: *Sc, dec* ×6 (12). Stuff and close.

Muzzle: 6 sc in MR, invisible sl st join; make 2, sew on.
Ears: Split the yarn to 2 plies, 1.8 mm hook. Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR, do not join. Rnd 2: change color, inc around (10). Sew between Rnds 4-5 of the head.

Lettuce
Rnds 1-5: As head Rnds 1-5 (30)
Rnd 6: *Sl st, ch 3*, repeat around for the ruffled edge.

Tomato / patty (make in red & brown)
Rnds 1-5: As head Rnds 1-5 (30)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc* ×6 (36)

Cheese: Ch 11; from 2nd ch 10 sc; work flat for 10 rows; finish with sc around all four edges, 3 sc in each corner.

Bottom bun: Same as tomato; make 2 discs and join them with a round of sl st through matching stitches.
patterns.chineseText:
小老虎汉堡 图解（Moyam）
头部：R1:环起6X / R2:6V / R3:6(X,V) / R4:6(X,V,X) / R5:6(3X,V) / R6-7:30X / R8:6(2X,V,2X) / R9-10:换白线36X / R11:内半针6(4X,A) / R12:6(3X,A) / R13:6(2X,A) / R14:6(X,A)，收口
嘴巴：环起6X，无痕引拔，钩2个
耳朵：拆两股线，1.8钩针 R1:环起5X，不引拔 R2:换线5V 缝在[R4R5]处
生菜：R1:环起6X / R2:6V / R3:6(X,V) / R4:6(X,V,X) / R5:6(3X,V) / R6:SL,3CH,重复一圈
番茄/肉饼：R1:环起6X / R2:6V / R3:6(X,V) / R4:6(X,V,X) / R5:6(3X,V) / R6:6(2X,V,2X)

patterns.notes: Burger stack with a tiger-face top bun; layers are sewn or stacked in order: bun, lettuce, tomato, cheese, patty, bottom bun. Ears use 2-ply split yarn with a 1.8 mm hook; embroider the tiger stripes and face with black thread. W=3 sc in one st.

meta.intro: A stacked burger charm with a tiger-face top bun — lettuce, tomato, cheese and patty layers are each crocheted separately and assembled into one adorable hamburger.
materials: Yarn in orange, white, green, red, yellow and brown
1.8 mm hook for the ears (2-ply split yarn)
Black thread for embroidering the face

faq.question: How are the burger layers made?
faq.answer: All layers start from the same 30-stitch disc (6 sc in MR increased over 5 rounds). Lettuce gets a ch-3 ruffle, tomato and patty grow to 36 sts, cheese is a flat sc square, and the bottom bun is two discs slip-stitched together.

faq.question: Do I need safety eyes?
faq.answer: No — the original skips bought eye and nose parts and embroiders the whole tiger face with thread.

faq.question: What are the ears made of?
faq.answer: Split the yarn into two plies and use a 1.8 mm hook: 5 sc in a ring, then change color and increase. Sew them between rounds 4-5 of the head.

title: Raffia Straw Hat & Basket Charms
description:
这是一款适合新手友好又有质感的小织物！
线材采用拉菲草绳，3.0钩针，线有点涩，慢慢钩，就能适应！
简单的针法也能钩出很有夏日得小饰品～
喜欢的姐妹先点赞再收藏哦！也可以关注一下，之后还会出更多可爱的小物~🍄
同样也欢迎喜欢钩织的姐妹来评论区晒图👏🏻
场景照片均为实物拍摄，🈲禁止搬运与转载！

**标签**: #一织蘑菇 #钩织小物 #新手钩织 #新手友好钩织 #织女 #新手指南 #棉草小物 #夏日挂件 #夏日项链 #夏日穿搭
author: 一织蘑菇（乐心Lexin）

patterns.englishText:
Summer Raffia Charms — Two Straw Hats & Two Mini Baskets

Straw hat 1
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnds 5-7: Sc around (24)
Rnd 8: FLO, hdc-inc in each st around (48) — the flared brim
Rnd 9: *Ch 2, skip 1, sl st*, repeat around (picot edge).

Basket 1 (oval base)
Rnd 1: Ch 7; from 2nd ch: 5 sc, 3 sc in one, inc, working around the chain
Rnd 2: Inc, 4 sc, 3 inc, 4 sc, 2 inc (20)
Rnds 3-8: Sc around (20)
Rnd 9: 3 sc, skip 2 with ch 5, 8 sc, skip 2 with ch 5, 5 sc (chain handles).

Basket 2 (round)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×6 (30)
Rnds 6-7: Sc around (30)
Rnd 8: Dc in each st around (30)
Strap: Ch 15, sew both ends to the rim.

Straw hat 2
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×8 (24)
Rnd 4: BLO sc around (24)
Rnds 5-6: Sc around (24)
Rnd 7: FLO *sc, inc* ×12 (36)
Rnd 8: *5 sc, inc* ×6 (42)
Rnd 9: *3 sc, inc, 3 sc* ×6 (48)
patterns.chineseText:
夏日草编小挂件（ONEMOGU）
草帽一：R1:环起6X / R2:6V / R3:(X,V)*6 / R4:(X,V,X)*6 / R5-7:24X / R8:外半针24FV / R9:2CH、K1、SL，循环一圈
篮子一：起7CH，倒二回钩5X、W、V / R2:V、4X、3V、4X、2V / R3-8:20X / R9:3X、K2(5CH)、8X、K2(5CH)、5X
篮子二：R1:环起6X / R2:6V / R3:(X,V)*6 / R4:(X,V,X)*6 / R5:(3X,V)*6 / R6-7:30X / R8:30T / 包带：锁15CH，缝合即可
草帽二：R1:环起8X / R2:8V / R3:(X,V)*8 / R4:内半针24X / R5-6:24X / R7:外半针(X,V)*12 / R8:(5X,V)*6 / R9:(3X,V,3X)*6
patterns.notes: Beginner-friendly raffia/straw yarn charms: two hats and two baskets, finished with leather cord ties and small buttons. Uses raffia straw yarn with roughly a 3.0 mm hook; K=skip, W=3 sc in one st, T=dc, FV=hdc increase, FLO/BLO as marked.

meta.intro: A beginner-friendly set of summer raffia charms — two mini straw hats and two tiny baskets crocheted from straw yarn, finished with cord ties for necklaces or bag charms.
materials: Leather cord and small buttons for finishing

faq.question: Is raffia yarn hard to work with?
faq.answer: It is stiffer than cotton and a little rough on the hands. Work slowly at even tension; the payoff is charms that hold their shape without stiffener.

faq.question: How do the hat brims flare?
faq.answer: Both hats switch to front-loop-only rounds and increase sharply — hat 1 works an hdc increase into every stitch, hat 2 spreads increases over three rounds — which makes the brim ripple outward.

faq.question: How are the basket handles made?
faq.answer: Basket 1 skips two stitches with a ch-5 arch on each side; basket 2 uses a separate ch-15 strap sewn to the rim.

title: Saharah (Animal Crossing) Charm
description:
曹卖软糖体，一起钩织吧🔛图解在最后一张图片
准备四股棉线🧶
主体色：橙色，藏青色、卡其色
钩针：2.0mm
注意：R2钩内半针，留着钩刘海（如果你想用不织布裁剪后粘贴，可以不预留外半针），腮红部分用单股或双股线环起再缝到主体上，围裙是辫子针＋长针到合适宽度，再缝白色补丁。
缝合比较需要有耐心，希望大家都能做出自己的曹卖宝宝🤗当包挂或钥匙扣超级可爱！！完成记得@章鱼娜 ，有问题可以留言评论区一起讨论~

**标签**: #动物森友会 #动森小动物 #钩织玩偶 #钩针图解 #图解分享
author: 章鱼娜

patterns.englishText:
Saharah (Animal Crossing Camel) Gummy-Body Charm — Doll, Basket & Turnip

Doll — head, hands & feet in orange; body in navy ("gummy body" style)
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Inc around (10)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×5 (15)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×5 (20)
Rnds 5-7: Sc around (20)
Rnd 8: Dec around (10); change to navy on the last stitch
Rnd 9: Sc, inc, 4 hdc, (inc, sc, inc), 4 hdc, inc, sc, inc — work the hdc bumps in orange (they form the muzzle/cheeks)
Rnd 10: Sc around (15)
Rnd 11: 4 sc, 4 hdc, 3 sc, 4 hdc, 6 sc — hdc groups again in orange
Rnd 12: Dec around
Rnd 13: Close up.

Basket (brown/khaki)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: Sc around (12)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 5: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 6: *Sc, inc* ×12 (36) — fold the rim for the basket edge.

Turnip (white + green)
Body (white): Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: *sc, inc* ×3 (9); Rnd 3: *sc, inc, sc* ×3 (12); Rnd 4: sc, 5 dec, sc.
Leaf (green): Ch 8, then work dc, sc, sl st, sl st, sc, dc along the chain.

Headscarf: Chain to a comfortable length, leave yarn tails at both ends, then dec at each row end to form the triangular scarf. Sew everything in place.

patterns.notes: Handwritten pattern for Saharah/曹卖 from Animal Crossing as a keychain charm. From the post: 4-ply cotton, 2.0 mm hook; work Rnd 2 of the head in the inner half loop and leave the front loop for the fringe; cheeks made with single/double strand loops sewn on; apron is chains + dc rows with a white patch. A few handwritten tokens (arrows/corrections around R9) are interpreted per the annotation 'v,x,v above the 4f groups'.

meta.intro: Saharah the camel from Animal Crossing as a chunky little 'gummy body' charm, complete with her basket, a turnip and a tiny headscarf. Translated from a handwritten original pattern.
materials: 4-ply cotton in orange, navy, brown/khaki, white and green

faq.question: What is a 'gummy body'?
faq.answer: A one-piece squat body style: the head ball decreases sharply (10 dec), then the body widens again with hdc bumps forming the muzzle and cheeks — no separate head and body to sew.

faq.question: Any color-change tricks?
faq.answer: Change to navy on the last stitch of round 8, and work the hdc bump groups of rounds 9-11 in orange so the muzzle stands out against the navy body.

faq.question: The original chart is handwritten — is anything uncertain?
faq.answer: A few arrows around round 9 are ambiguous in the photo. The translation follows the annotation that places (inc, sc, inc) over the hdc groups; check against the finished photos as you crochet.

title: Lemon Keychain with Slice & Leaf
description:
来自ins：The_Crochet_Corner免费分享的柠檬挂饰图解

**标签**: #编织图解 #柠檬 #一起来钩织 #针织手作 #钩针图解 #手工挂件
author: 陆十七knit🔥

patterns.englishText:
Lemon Keychain — Lemon, Slice & Leaf

Materials: cotton yarn in yellow, white and green; 2.5-3 mm hook; fiberfill; yarn needle; scissors; keychain ring.

Lemon (make 1)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc ×6 (12)
Rnd 3: (Sc 1, inc) ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: (Sc 2, inc) ×6 (24)
Rnds 5-10: Sc around, 6 rounds (24)
Rnd 11: (Sc 2, dec) ×6 (18)
Rnd 12: (Sc 1, dec) ×6 (12)
Rnd 13: Dec ×6 (6). Stuff lightly and close.

Lemon slice (make 1)
Using white yarn: Ch 10. From 2nd chain: sc, hdc, dc, hdc, sc, hdc, dc, hdc, sc. Fasten off.
Join yellow yarn and work 1 round of sc around the edge.

Leaf (make 1)
Ch 6. From 2nd chain: sc, hdc, dc, hdc, sc. Fasten off.

Assembly
1. Attach the leaf on top. 2. Attach the lemon slice on the side (front). 3. Add the keychain ring.
Tips: use tight stitches so stuffing doesn't show; a smaller hook gives neater stitches.
patterns.chineseText:
柠檬挂件图解（英文原版：The_Crochet_Corner 免费图解）
LEMON (Make 1): 1 MR,6sc(6) / 2 inc x6(12) / 3 (sc1,inc)x6(18) / 4 (sc2,inc)x6(24) / 5-10 sc around(24) / 11 (sc2,dec)x6(18) / 12 (sc1,dec)x6(12) / 13 dec x6(6)，塞棉收口
LEMON SLICE (Make 1)：白线 ch10，倒2起：sc,hdc,dc,hdc,sc,hdc,dc,hdc,sc；断线；换黄线沿边缘钩一圈短针
LEAF (Make 1)：ch6，倒2起：sc,hdc,dc,hdc,sc；断线
ASSEMBLY：叶子缝顶部，柠檬片缝正面，装钥匙圈
MATERIALS：棉线（黄/白/绿）、2.5-3mm钩针、填充棉、缝针、剪刀、钥匙圈
patterns.notes: Free English infographic pattern by IG The_Crochet_Corner, reshared on XHS. Beginner friendly, quick make; great for keychains, bag charms and gifts. The image itself is already in English with step photos, so it can be displayed directly.

meta.intro: A quick lemon keychain with a white lemon slice and a leaf — a free English infographic pattern that is perfect for beginners, gifts and bag charms.
materials: Cotton yarn in yellow, white and green

faq.question: How do I keep stuffing from showing?
faq.answer: Use tight stitches and go down a hook size if needed — the pattern's own tip is that a smaller hook gives neater stitches.

faq.question: How is the slice made?
faq.answer: Chain 10 in white and work graduated stitches (sc-hdc-dc waves) along the chain, then edge the wedge with one round of yellow sc.

patterns.englishText:
Mudkip Gummy (Pokemon) — Body, Tail & Head Fin

Body
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnds 5-7: Sc around (24)
Rnd 8: Sc around (24) — highlighted sts: change to white yarn here
Rnd 9: Dec ×12 (12)
Rnd 10 (worked in FLO): inc, sc, inc, bobble, [inc, 2 sc, inc — in white], bobble, inc, sc, inc
Rnd 11: 6 sc, 6 sc, 6 sc (18)
Rnd 12: 6 sc, bobble, 5 sc, bobble, 5 sc
Rnd 13: 6 sc, 6 sc, 6 sc (18)
Rnd 14: *Sc, dec, sc* ×6. Stuff and close.

Tail fin (work flat; turn + turning ch every row)
Row 1: 2 sc in MR
Row 2: 2 sc
Row 3: Sc, inc
Row 4: 3 sc
Row 5: 2 sc, inc
Row 6: 4 sc
Row 7: Sl st, 2 sc, sl st

Head fin (work flat; turn + turning ch every row)
Rows 1-4: 3 sc in MR; 3 sc; 3 sc; 3 sc
Row 5: Sl st, sc, sl st
Cheek frills are on the next page of the pattern.
patterns.chineseText:
水跃鱼软糖（猫团团）
R1.环起6x / R2.6v / R3.6(x,v) / R4.6(x,v,x) / R5-7.24x / R8.24x / R9.12A / R10*.v,x,v,B,v,2x,v,B,v,x,v / R11.6x,6x,6x / R12.6x,B,5x,B,5x / R13.6x,6x,6x / R14.6(x,A,x)
* R10钩外半针；高亮处换白色线
尾巴：环起2x / 2x / x,v / 3x / 2x,v / 4x / sl,2x,sl
头：环起3x / 3x / 3x / 3x / sl,x,sl
*头尾每行翻面+起立
patterns.notes: Fan-made Mudkip 'gummy' amigurumi. B=bobble stitch (orange cheek bumps); highlighted stitches switch to white for the belly. Head and tail fins are worked flat with turning chains and sewn on.

patterns.englishText:
Mudkip Gummy — Cheek Frills (Page 2)

Cheeks (make 2)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12). Fasten off.

Cheek spikes
Insert the hook at the red dot of the diagram and come out at the green dot, pull up a chain loop; then, working onto that loop:
*Ch 2, sl st in 2nd ch from hook, sl st onto the base loop* — repeat 3 times. Fasten off.
This makes the three little points of Mudkip's star-shaped cheek. Attach the cheeks to the sides of the head, following the eye-placement sketch.
patterns.chineseText:
水跃鱼软糖（第二页）
脸颊×2：环起6x，6v，断线
钩针从下图的红点入针，绿点出针，拉一个锁针出来，然后在这个锁针形成的线圈上：
3（2ch，倒2sl，sl到线圈上）断线
（附小图：圆片符号图，红点入针、绿点出针；眼睛摆位示意）
patterns.notes: Second page of the Mudkip pattern: flat cheek discs plus a 3-point spike edge worked from a pulled-up loop. The small symbol chart marks the insertion (red) and exit (green) points; the oval sketch shows eye and cheek placement.

meta.intro: Mudkip as a chubby Pokemon 'gummy' — a fan pattern with a round blue body, white belly, flat head and tail fins, and star-point cheeks built from a clever pulled-loop trick.
materials: Yarn in blue, white and orange

faq.question: How are the orange cheek spikes made?
faq.answer: Crochet a small disc (6 sc in MR, inc around), then pull a chain loop through the marked point and work (ch 2, sl st in 2nd ch, sl st onto the loop) three times to form the three points.

faq.question: What does the bobble 'B' in the body do?
faq.answer: The bobbles on rounds 10 and 12 make the bumps where the head fin and leg nubs sit, giving the gummy silhouette.

faq.question: Are the fins crocheted in the round?
faq.answer: No — the head fin and tail are worked flat in short rows with a turning chain each row, then sewn on.

title: Fluffy Mini Elephant
description:
线材：蓝色皮草线 🎵贝妍毛线 @爱吃桃子🍑（贝妍）
用量：大约半团，50g左右
工具：6.0mm钩针
图解来源：@饭饭大王
眼睛：8mm

**标签**: #钩织玩偶 #皮草线 #毛茸茸软乎乎 #手作玩偶 #钩针
author: 小林PRO

patterns.englishText:
Mini Fur-Yarn Elephant Gummy — Body, Ears & Trunk

Body
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Inc around (10)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×5 (15)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×5 (20)
Rnds 5-7: Sc around (20)
Rnd 8: Dec ×10 (10)
Rnd 9: Sc, inc, bobble, inc, sc, inc, bobble, inc, sc, inc — the two bobbles form the cheek bumps
Rnd 10: Sc around (15)
Rnd 11: 4 sc, bobble, 4 sc, bobble, 5 sc
Rnd 12: *Sc, dec* ×5. Stuff and close.

Ears (make 2)
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR, do not join (5)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (10). Fasten off, sew flat to the head.

Trunk
Ch 5; starting from 2nd ch from hook work 4 dc. Sew below the eyes.
patterns.chineseText:
软糖小象图解（@饭饭大王）
身体：R1:5X / R2:5V / R3:5(X,V) / R4:5(X,V,X) / R5-R7:20X / R8:10A / R9:X,V,B,V,X,V,B,V,X,V / R10:15X / R11:4X,B,4X,B,5X / R12:5(X,A)
耳朵：R1:5X（不引拔）/ R2:5V
鼻子：5CH倒二钩4T
patterns.notes: Tiny elephant in blue fur/plush yarn. From the post: fur yarn, about half a 50 g ball; 6.0 mm hook; 8 mm safety eyes; pattern credit @饭饭大王. B=bobble stitch.

meta.intro: A palm-size fluffy elephant in blue fur yarn — a fast gummy-style body with bobble cheeks, disc ears and a little dc trunk. Half a ball of yarn is all it takes.

faq.question: Is fur yarn beginner friendly?
faq.answer: Stitches are hard to see in fur yarn, so count carefully and use a stitch marker each round. The pattern is short (12 rounds), which keeps it manageable.

faq.question: How is the trunk made?
faq.answer: Chain 5 and work 4 dc back down the chain — one row makes the little curled trunk, sewn under the eyes.

faq.question: What do the B stitches in rounds 9 and 11 mean?
faq.answer: They are bobbles that pop outward to form the cheeks; work them a touch looser in fur yarn so they show.

title: Bikini Bottom Fish Pair (Cool & Lazy Fish)
description:

毛线@苏苏姐家 四股唯棉 色号05、06、67、51、21、57、63（酷酷鱼）45、72、03、18、06、92（瘫瘫鱼）

图解来自：酷酷鱼@七月手工 瘫瘫鱼@三分钟热度的半吊子 感谢图解❤️

**标签**: #海绵宝宝 #比奇堡 #比奇堡居民 #比奇堡丑鱼 #钩针图解 #钩针小物
author: 孟孟

patterns.englishText:
Cool Fish (Bikini Bottom Fish) — Part 1: Body, Sleeves, Arms & Legs

Sleeves (white)
Rnd 1: Ch 12, join into a ring, 12 sc
Rnd 2: Sc around (12)
Rnd 3: Dec, 4 sc, dec, 4 sc (10)
Rnd 4: Sc around (10)
Rnd 5: Dec, 3 sc, dec, 3 sc (8). Sleeves are double-layered and joined to the body.

Arms (blue)
Row h1: Ch 4; from 2nd ch 3 sc, ch 1, turn
Row h2: 3 sc, ch 3, sl st to the 1st st to form a ring
Rnds 1-5: 6 sc around
Rnd 6: Dec, 4 sc (5)
Rnd 7: Dec, 2 sc (3). Glue/stitch thin dark-blue stripes on.

Pants pocket: Work 3 sc into the FLO left on Rnds 10-13, turn; inc, 2 sc, inc. Fix the hands under the pocket wrapping both sides; tuck arms into the sleeves and fix to the body.

Legs (blue)
Row h1: Pick up 4 sc + inc in the BLO of Rnd 5, ch 1, turn
Row h2: 6 sc, sl st into a ring
Rnds 1-12: 6 sc around
Rnd 13: Dec, 4 sc (5)
Rnd 14: Dec, 2 sc (3). Add thin blue stripes; bend the feet at Rnds 9-10 (floral wire optional).

Pant legs (red): Starting from the center in the FLO of Rnd 5 —
Rnd 1: 2 sc, 6 dc, 3 sc
Rnd 2: 2 sc, 6 dc, 3 sc
Rnd 3: Sc, 8 dc, 2 sc. Leave a tail and tack the pants inside toward the body.

Main body (start red)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×6 (30)
Rnd 6: 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, skip 5 + ch 6 (armhole), 2 sc, inc, 4 sc, inc, 2 sc, skip 5 + ch 6 (armhole), 2 sc, inc, 2 sc (36)
Rnds 7-9: Sc around (36)
Rnd 10: 8 sc, 1 BLO sc, 18 sc, 1 BLO sc, 8 sc
Rnd 11: 9 sc, 1 BLO sc, 16 sc, 1 BLO sc, 9 sc
Rnd 12: 10 sc, 1 BLO sc, 14 sc, 1 BLO sc, 10 sc
Rnd 13: Inc, 35 sc (37)
Rnd 14: 36 sc, inc (38)
Rnd 15: Invisible color change to white; 38 sc
Rnd 16: BLO sc around (38)
Rnds 17-19: Sc around (38)
Rnd 20: Inc, 37 sc (39)
Rnds 21-23: Sc around (39)
Rnd 24: 38 sc, inc (40)
Rnds 25-27: Sc around (40)
Rnd 28: 8 sc, (3 sc through sleeve), 18 sc, (3 sc through sleeve), 8 sc — joining the sleeves
Rnd 29: Sc around (40)
Rnd 30: Invisible color change to blue; 40 sc
Rnd 31: Sc around (40)
Rnd 32: Dec, 38 sc (39)
Rnds 33-38: Sc around (39)
Rnd 39: 37 sc, dec (38)
Rnds 40-43: Sc around (38)
Rnd 44: Sc, *2 sc, dec, 2 sc* ×6, sc (32)
Rnd 45: Dec, 30 sc (31)
Rnd 46: 29 sc, dec (30)
Rnd 47: *3 sc, dec* ×6 (24)
Rnd 48: Sc around (24)
Rnd 49: *Sc, dec, sc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 50: *Sc, dec* ×6 (12). Stuff firmly and close.

patterns.notes: Part 1 of 2 for the 'cool fish' background character from Bikini Bottom (SpongeBob). Non-commercial pattern by @七月手工. The BLO single stitches on Rnds 10-13 reserve front loops for the pants pocket; ch-6 gaps on Rnd 6 are armholes later joined at Rnd 28. See Part 2 for fins, eyes, mouth and spots.

patterns.englishText:
Cool Fish (Bikini Bottom Fish) — Part 2: Fin, Eyes, Mouth, Brows & Spots

Dorsal fin (Tunisian / afghan stitch)
Row 1: Ch 13; from 2nd ch pick up 12 incomplete sc loops, then work them off two by two, 12 times
Row 2: Ch 1, pick up 11 loops, work off 6 times; continue forward picking up 6 more loops, work off, 11 total
Row 3: Ch 1, 11 loops, work off 11 times
Row 4: Ch 1, 10 loops, work off 10 times
Row 5: Ch 1, 8 loops, work off 8 times — sew at center back, between the blue rounds
Row 6: Ch 1, 7 loops, work off 7 times — sew at center back.

Eye whites (3-ply split yarn, 1.8 mm hook, 0.3 m safety eyes)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: inc around (12); Rnds 3-4: 12 sc. Use with the purl side facing out.

Eyelids (2-ply split yarn, 1.8 mm hook, crochet loosely)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR; Rnd 2: *sc, inc* ×4 (12); Rnds 3-5: 12 sc. Fit the eye whites inside the eyelids.

Mouth
Ch 11; from 2nd ch: (sl st, sc, dc, dc-inc, dc, dc-inc, dc, sc, sl st), ch 2; repeat the bracket along the opposite side of the chain, ch 2, sl st. Fold in half with wrong side inside; sew centered — mouth corners at blue Rnd 3, middle at Rnd 4.

Eyebrows: Ch 5; from 2nd ch: sc, 3 sl st.

Spots (single ply, hook 1.0 mm or smaller)
Large: ch 5, from 2nd ch 4 sc; ch 1, 4 sc along the other side, ch 1, sl st.
Small: ch 4, join head-to-tail into a little ring.

patterns.notes: Part 2 of the cool fish pattern. The fin uses Tunisian simple stitch ('pick up loops, work off in pairs'). Droopy eyelids over eye whites give the bored expression; pink spots are sewn on the head and body. Some spot-row punctuation in the source is messy; transcribed as printed.

patterns.englishText:
Lazy Fish (Bikini Bottom Couch Fish) — Full Pattern

Body
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×6 (30)
Rnd 6: Sc around (30)
Rnd 7: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc* ×6 (36)
Rnd 8: 16 sc, 4 sc (color section), 16 sc
Rnd 9: 15 sc, 6 sc, 15 sc
Rnds 10-24: 14 sc, 8 sc, 14 sc (36) — keep the belly color section
Rnds 25-29: Sc around (36)
Rnd 30: 8 sc, dec, 16 sc, dec, 8 sc (34)
Rnd 31: Sc around (34)
Rnd 32: 7 sc, dec, 16 sc, dec, 7 sc (32)
Rnd 33: Sc around (32)
Rnd 34: 7 sc, dec, 14 sc, dec, 7 sc (30)
Rnd 35: Sc around (30)
Rnd 36: *3 sc, dec* ×6 (24)
Rnd 37: Sc around (24)
Rnd 38: *Sc, dec, sc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 39: Sc around (18)
Rnd 40: *Sc, dec* ×6 (12)
Rnd 41: Dec around (6). Stuff and close.

Whiskers (make 2, 2-ply): Ch 5; from 2nd ch 4 sc.
Feet (make 2): Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnds 2-14: 6 sc; Rnd 15: 2 sc, 2 dc, 2 sc (the flipper tip).
Hands (make 2): Row 1: ch 4; from 2nd ch inc, sc, 3-sc-in-one, 2 sc; Rnd 2: 8 sc; Rnd 3: 3 sc, dec, 3 sc; Rnds 4-5: 7 sc; Rnd 6: sc, dec, sc, dec, sc; Rnds 7-14: 5 sc.
Mouth (2-ply): lower lip ch 9, from 2nd ch 2 sl st, 4 sc, 2 sl st; upper lip ch 11, from 2nd ch 2 sl st, 6 sc, 2 sl st.
Fin: Ch 10; from 2nd ch sl st, sc, dc, hdc, sl st, hdc, dc, sc, sl st.
Shirt: Rnd 1: ch 42, join; Rnd 2: 42 sc; Rnds 3-5: 42 dc (add/remove rows to adjust length; sample has 1 extra row); Rnd 6: 9 sc, ch 4 + skip 4, 16 sc, ch 4 + skip 4, 9 sc (armholes); Rnd 7: 9 dc, 4 BLO dc, 16 dc, 4 BLO dc, 9 dc; Rnd 8: 42 sc.
Sleeves (make 2, into the skipped sts): Rnds 1-2: 10 sc; Rnd 3: inc, 8 sc, inc; Rnd 4: 12 sc.
Eyelids (make 2, 2-ply): Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: *sc, inc* ×3 (9); Rnd 3: sc, 2 inc, sc, 2 inc, sc, 2 inc (15); Rnds 4-5: 15 sc.
Eyes (make 2): Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: inc around (12); Rnds 3-4: 12 sc; Rnd 5: dec ×6.

patterns.notes: The orange 'lazy fish' lying on the couch from SpongeBob background scenes, wearing a removable blue dc shirt. Non-commercial pattern by @三分钟热度的半吊子. Shorthand: x=sc, v=inc, a/A=dec, w=3 sc in one st, T=dc, F=hdc, E=sl st, K=skip; 拆两股=split yarn to 2 plies.

meta.intro: The bored 'cool fish' and couch-loving 'lazy fish' from Bikini Bottom as a pair of tall amigurumi dolls — complete with droopy eyelids, a Tunisian-stitch dorsal fin, stripes, spots and a removable shirt.
materials: Glue for detail placement (slow-dry fabric glue)
Optional floral wire for the legs

faq.question: How are the arms attached through the shirt?
faq.answer: On the cool fish, round 6 leaves two ch-6 armholes; at round 28 you crochet through sleeve and body together, so the white shirt looks worn rather than sewn on.

faq.question: What technique does the dorsal fin use?
faq.answer: Tunisian (afghan) stitch: pick up a row of incomplete loops on the hook, then work them off two at a time. Six short rows are then sewn along the back seam.

faq.question: How do the sleepy eyes work?
faq.answer: Eye whites are worked purl-side-out from 3-ply split yarn, then tucked inside looser 2-ply eyelid cups so the lids droop over them.

faq.question: Is the lazy fish's shirt removable?
faq.answer: Yes — it is a separate tube of dc rounds with ch-4 armholes and short sleeves, slipped onto the body.

title: Lying-Down Eeyore Mini Plush
description:
可爱的小毛驴，小小一只握在手心里很安心呐～
🧵：@雪妃尔毛线 萌小爱（22天蓝/50肤色/34咖啡）
🪡：3.0/2.5

**标签**: #钩针小物 #手工玩偶 #一起来钩织 #安抚玩偶 #屹耳 #百亩森林 #钩针图解 #钩针玩偶 #手工钩织
author: 椰汁甜甜

patterns.englishText:
Lying-Down Eeyore Mini Plush — Head, Body, Ears & Tail

Head
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: Sc around (12)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnds 5-7: Sc around (18)
Rnd 8: *Sc, dec* ×6 (12)
Rnd 9: Dec ×6 (6). Stuff, close.

Muzzle (2-ply split yarn)
Row 1: Ch 6; from 2nd ch: 4 sc, 3-sc-in-one, 3 sc, inc (around the chain)
Rnd 2: Inc, 3 sc, 3 inc, 3 sc, 2 inc. Sew to the front of the head.

Body (lying pose)
Rnds 1-2: 6 sc in MR, work 2 tubes (the front legs)
Rnd 3: Join with ch 1, 14 sc around both
Rnd 4: 2 sc, inc, 3 sc, 2 inc, 2 sc, inc, 3 sc (20)
Rnd 5: 6 sc, 4 inc, 6 sc — wait, count as written (chart says 6X,4V,6X)
Rnds 6-7: 20 sc
Rnd 8: 6 sc, 4 dec, 6 sc
Rnd 9: 8 dec
Rnd 10: 8 sc. Stuff and close.

Ears (1-ply split yarn)
Ch 9; from 2nd ch: 2 sc, 3 dc, 2 hdc, 5 hdc in the corner st, then down the other side: 2 hdc, 3 dc, 2 sc.
Work the pink inner ear the same way; layer the two pieces and edge them together with one round of sc in blue.

Forelock (1-ply): *In a ring: ch 4, 3 sl st back down the chain, sl st into the ring* — repeat 6 times.
Tail: Ch 9; from 2nd ch 8 sl st; at the tip join coffee-color yarn and work (sc, dc, sc) for the tuft.
Bow (2-ply): In a ring: ch 3, 2 hdc, ch 3, sl st into the ring; repeat once more for the second loop.

patterns.notes: Palm-size lying Eeyore. Yarn from the post: Xuefeier 萌小爱 plush (sky blue 22 / skin 50 / coffee 34), hooks 3.0/2.5 mm. Shorthand: W=3 sc in one st, T=dc, F=hdc; 拆N股=split the yarn to N plies. Pattern marked personal-use only.

meta.intro: A tiny lying-down Eeyore that fits in your palm — floppy layered ears, a stubby muzzle, a slip-stitch forelock and tail tuft, and a little bow on the back.
materials: Plush yarn in sky blue, skin tone and coffee (Xuefeier 萌小爱 22/50/34)

faq.question: How is the lying pose made?
faq.answer: The body starts as two small 6-sc tubes (the front legs) that are chained together and worked as one oval — the doll naturally lies flat on its belly.

faq.question: How are the two-tone ears made?
faq.answer: Work a blue outer ear and pink inner ear along both sides of a ch-9 foundation with taller stitches at the tip, then layer them and edge both together with one round of blue sc.

faq.question: What is '拆股' (split yarn)?
faq.answer: Plied yarn is separated into thinner strands: the ears use 1 ply and the muzzle and bow use 2 plies, so small parts stay delicate.

patterns.englishText:
Piglet Link (Zelda) Gummy Charm — Handwritten Pattern

Head & body (orange, gummy style)
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Inc around (10)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×5 (15)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×5 (20)
Rnds 5-7: Sc around (20)
Rnd 8: Dec ×10 (10); change to blue
Rnd 9: Sc, inc, bobble, inc, sc, inc, bobble, inc, sc, inc — work the bobbles in brown (snout/cheek bumps)
Rnd 10: 15 sc (brown section per arrows)
Rnd 11: 4 sc, bobble, 3 sc, bobble, 6 sc — bobbles in brown
Rnd 12: *Sc, dec* ×5. Stuff, close.

Tail: Ch 3; from 2nd ch: sl st, sc.
Ears: Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR; Rnd 2: inc ×5 (10); Rnd 3: *sc, inc, sc* ×5.
Hair strands / band: Rows 1-8: ch 8 loops; Row 9: ch 9 (sl st, 2 sc, sl st, sl st, 3 sc); Rows 10-13: ch 4-5, sl st along the whole chain; Row 14: ch 9 (sl st, 2 sc, sl st, sl st, 3 sc).
Hat (work loosely): increase rounds up to Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×5 (25); Rnds 6-7: 25 sc; brim: sc, inc, 3 dc, ch 12, 3 dc + inc, sc — insert the needle through one chain when sewing.
Snout (2-ply): Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR; Rnd 2: dc-inc, (ch, sl st) in next st, ch, dc-inc, ch, sl st (nostril bumps; annotations mark 'next st' vs 'same st').
Horn (2-ply): Rnd 1: 5 sc; Rnd 2: inc, 2 sc, inc, sc (7); Rnd 3: 7 sc; Rnd 4: inc, 2 sc, inc, sc, inc, sc (10); Rnd 5: 10 sc.
Eye covers (2-ply): Rnd 1: 5 sc; Rnd 2: 10 sc (make 2).

patterns.notes: Handwritten pattern photographed from paper for 'piglet Link' (Zelda soft-gummy body). From the post: 2.5 mm hook, MengXiaoYa yarn, pattern credit @钩了个豆. Several handwritten tokens are ambiguous (arrows, corrections); rounds above follow the clearest reading and the 小象-style bobble/gummy construction. Double-check R9-R11 bobble placement against the photos when making.

meta.intro: 'Piglet Link' from Zelda as a soft gummy-body charm — an orange piggy body in a blue tunic with ears, horn, hair strands and a tiny hat, translated from the designer's handwritten notes.

faq.question: The source is handwritten — how reliable is the translation?
faq.answer: Most rounds are clear, but a few arrows and corrections around rounds 9-11 (bobble placement) are ambiguous. The translation follows the standard gummy-body construction; compare against the finished photos as you go.

faq.question: What makes the snout bumps?
faq.answer: Round 9 alternates increases with brown bobbles, and round 11 repeats two more bobbles — the same cheek-bump trick used in gummy elephants and similar charms.

faq.question: How is the hair made?
faq.answer: Chain loops (ch 8-9) with slip stitches back down, worked in rows; two longer strands get small sc details at the ends.

#小马里奥钩织 #钩针玩偶图解 #手工钩
patterns.notes: Page 9 of 9 of the Mini Mario doll pattern (完整清晰版 by 那丫头真拽). Symbols defined on page 3: x=sc, v=inc, a=dec, ch=chain, sl=sl st, f=dc, BLO=back loop, FLO=front loop; g appears in the arm row as a special st (thumb bump). Colors: skin, white, light coffee, dark blue, red, pale yellow, light brown.

meta.intro: A complete mini Mario doll pattern across nine clear pages: head, ears, nose, mustache, gloved arms with thumbs, shoes-to-overalls legs, bib and straps, hair cap with sideburns, and the red M hat.
materials: Yarn in skin tone, white, light coffee, dark blue, red, pale yellow and light brown
White felt or yarn for the M badge

faq.question: In what order should I assemble Mario?
faq.answer: Head with ears, nose and mustache first; then hair cap with sideburns; body from the shoes up with the overalls bib, straps and buttons; arms with glove cuffs; and finally the hat with its embroidered M.

faq.question: How do the color layers of the legs work?
faq.answer: BLO rounds mark each transition — shoe to trouser (round 4) and trouser to red shirt (round 15) — leaving front loops free for the pants edge and the bib to be worked into.

faq.question: What is the 'g' stitch in the arm round?
faq.answer: A small thumb bump worked in one stitch (bobble-style); the left and right arms place it at mirrored positions.

patterns.englishText:
Mushroom Charm — Cap, Stem, Spots & Feet

Use a 3.0 mm hook throughout.

Mushroom cap (red)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (40)
Rnd 6: Sc, inc, *4 sc, inc* 7 times, 3 sc (48)
Rnd 7: Sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 8: Dc in each st around (48)
Rnd 9: BLO sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 10: Sc, dec, *4 sc, dec* 7 times, 3 sc (40)
Rnd 11: Change color. *3 sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 12: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 13: *Sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (16)

Stem (cream)

Egg white

Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (30)

Rnd 7: Sc in each st around (36)
Rnd 8: *5 sc, inc*, repeat around (42)

Rnds 10-17: Sc in each st around (48)

patterns.englishText:
Baby Mobile Bead Ring — Macaron Balls

First ball
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 6-9: Sc in each st around (30)
Rnd 10: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 11: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 12: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)

Following balls (repeat)

patterns.englishText:
Skinny Eggplant Plush — Body, Stem & Leaves

Body (purple)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* ×6 (30)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc* around (36)
Rnds 7-9: Sc around (36)
Rnd 10: (2 sc, dec, 2 sc) ×2, 24 sc (34)
Rnd 11: Sc around (34)
Rnd 12: (3 sc, dec) ×2, 24 sc (32)
Rnd 13: Sc around (32)
Rnd 14: (Sc, dec, sc) ×2, 24 sc (30)
Rnd 15: Sc around (30)
Rnd 16: (Sc, dec) ×2, 24 sc (28)
Rnd 17: Sc around (28)
Rnd 18: 2 dec, 24 sc (26)
Rnds 19-22: Sc around (26)
Rnd 23: 11 sc, dec — continue in pattern (as printed)
Rnd 24: 2 sc, dec
Rnd 25: Sc, dec
Rnd 26: Dec ×6. Stuff and close — the decreases all sit on one side, giving the bent skinny shape.

Stem cap + leaves (green)
Rnds 1-2: 5 sc in MR, sc around
Rnd 3: 3 sc, dec
Rnd 4: Inc ×4
Rnd 5: *Sc, inc* ×4
Rnd 6: *Sc, inc, sc* ×4
Rnd 7: *3 sc, inc* ×4 (20)
Leaves: *Ch 6; back down the chain: sl st, sc, dc, hdc, sl st* ×5 — one leaf every 3 sts (the author suggests every 4 sts since the last round has 20 sts).
patterns.notes: Slim bendy eggplant from the mobile set, by lulu. Shorthand: X=sc, V=inc, A=dec, T=dc, F=hdc, E=sl st. Rounds 23-25 are printed compactly in the source; keep decreasing in line until 6 sts remain.

patterns.englishText:
Soft Peach Plush — Peach, Feet, Leaf & Stem

Peach body (chenille yarn, 4.0 mm hook, 8 mm flat-back eyes)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* around (30)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc* around (36)
Rnd 7: Sc around (36)
Rnd 8: *5 sc, inc* around (42)
Rnd 9: *3 sc, inc, 3 sc* around (48)
Rnds 10-17: Sc around (48)
Rnd 18: *3 sc, dec, 3 sc* around (42)
Rnds 19-20: Sc around (42)
Rnd 21: *5 sc, dec* around (36)
Rnd 22: *4 sc, dec* around (30)
Rnd 23: *3 sc, dec* around (24)
Rnd 24: *2 sc, dec* around (18)
Rnd 25: *Sc, dec* around (12)
Rnd 26: Dec around (6).
Leave an extra-long tail and cinch it around the peach to sculpt the bum cleft. Don't overstuff or it's hard to shape.

Feet (coffee brown, 2.5 mm hook)
Row 1: Ch 6; from 2nd ch: inc, 3 sc, 3-sc-in-one, 4 sc
Rnd 2: BLO 3 sc, 3 dec, 3 sc
Rnd 3: 2 sc, 3 dec, sc
Rnd 4: 2 sc, dec, 2 sc
Rnd 5: 5 sc
Rnds 6-7 (or 8): 5 sc.

Leaf (4-ply cotton, 2.5 mm): Ch 16; from 2nd ch: sl st, sc, dc, hdc, 8 sl st, hdc, dc, sc, sl st, ch, then repeat down the other side: sl st, sc, dc, hdc, 8 sl st, hdc, dc, sc, sl st.
Stem (4-ply, 2.5 mm): Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnds 2-5: 6 sc.
patterns.chineseText:
软妹水蜜桃（@白羊团团钩）

patterns.englishText:
Jellycat-Style Lemon — Lemon, Leaves & Legs

Yarn: chenille (body) + No.5 milk cotton (brown tip, legs); 3.0 mm hook. Designer: Jane.

Lemon (yellow)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: (Sc, inc) ×3 (9)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc, sc) ×3 (12)
Rnd 4: (Sc, inc) ×6 (18)
Rnd 5: (Sc, inc, sc) ×6 (24)
Rnd 6: (3 sc, inc) ×6 (30)
Rnd 7: (2 sc, inc, 2 sc) ×6 (36)
Rnd 8: (5 sc, inc) ×6 (42)
Rnd 9: Sc around (42)
Rnd 10: (3 sc, inc, 3 sc) ×6 (48)
Rnds 11-21: Sc around (48)
Rnd 22: (3 sc, dec, 3 sc) ×6 (42)
Rnd 23: (5 sc, dec) ×6 (36)
Rnd 24: Sc around (36)
Rnd 25: (2 sc, dec, 2 sc) ×6 (30)
Rnd 26: (3 sc, dec) ×6 (24)
Rnd 27: (Sc, dec, sc) ×6 (18)
Rnd 28: Sc around (18)
Rnd 29: (Sc, dec) ×6 (12)
Rnd 30: Dec ×6 (6)
Rnds 31-35: Change to brown milk cotton, 6 sc (the lemon tip). Fasten off.

Leaves (make 2)
Row 1: Ch 16; from 2nd ch: inc, sc, 2 dc, 9 hdc, dc, 3-sc-in-one, then down the other side: dc, 9 hdc, 2 dc, sc, inc, sl st
Row 2: Inc, 2 sc, dc-inc, 8 dc, dc-inc, 2 sc, 3 inc, 2 sc, dc-inc, 8 dc, dc-inc, 2 sc, inc.

Legs (make 2)
Row 1: Ch 6; from 2nd ch: 4 sc, 3-sc-in-one, 3 sc, inc
Rnd 2: Inc, 3 sc, 3 inc, 3 sc, 2 inc (18)
Rnd 3: Sc, inc, 3 sc, (sc, inc) ×3, 3 sc, (sc, inc) ×2 (24)
Rnds 4-5: Sc around (24)
Rnd 6: 5 sc, 3 M, 7 sc
Rnd 7: 4 sc, 2 M, 6 sc
Rnd 8: 3 sc, 2 dec, 5 sc
Rnd 9: 4 sc, dec, 4 sc
Rnds 10-17: Sc around (9)
Rnd 18: Sc, dec, 3 sc, dec, sc (7)
Rnd 19: Sc around (7). Fasten off, sew to the lemon.
patterns.notes: Jellycat lemon lookalike with long legs and two leaves. 'M' in leg Rnds 6-7 is an undefined shorthand in the source (likely a cluster/decrease shaping the heel) — follow the photo when working those rounds. TV=dc increase, w=3 sc in one st, T=dc, F=hdc.

patterns.englishText:
Avocado Half — Flesh, Skin & Pit

Symbols: X = sc, V = inc, A = dec, BLO = back loop only, K = skip.

Flesh (light green)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc ×6 (12)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc) ×6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc) ×6 (24)
Rnd 5: (3 sc, inc) ×6 (30)
Rnds 6-9: Sc around (30)
Rnd 10: BLO (4 sc, inc) ×6 (36)
Rnd 11: (5 sc, inc) ×6 (42)
Rnd 12: 2 sc, (6 sc, inc) ×5, 4 sc, inc (48)
Rnd 13: (7 sc, inc) ×6 (54)
Rnd 14: 3 sc, (8 sc, inc) ×5, 5 sc, inc (60)
Now work flat (the dip for the pit):
Row 15: 13 sc, turn
Row 16: Skip 1, 12 sc, turn
Row 17: Skip 1, 11 sc, turn
Rows 18-24: Continue — skip 1, one fewer sc each row, turn
Row 25: Skip 1, 3 sc.

Skin (dark green)
Rnds 1-10: Same as flesh Rnds 1-14 shaping up to (60)
Rows 11-21: Same flat short-row section (13 sc down to 3 sc)
Rnd 22: 10 sc along the flat-section edge, 48 sc, 10 sc along the other edge, 3 sc (69)
Rnds 23-26: Sc around (69)
Joining: Hold flesh inside skin and sc 69 around through both layers.

Pit (brown)
Rnd 1: 7 sc in MR (7)
Rnd 2: Inc ×7 (14)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc) ×7 (21)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc) ×7 (28)
Rnds 5-8: Sc around (28)
Rnd 9: (2 sc, dec) ×7 (21)
Rnd 10: (Sc, dec) ×7 (14)
Rnd 11: Dec ×7 (7). Stuff, fasten off, weave in ends. Sew the pit into the dip.
patterns.notes: Avocado half with removable-look pit. Original Turkish pattern (AVOKADO Tarifi) by zeynebin.yumaklari, Chinese translation by @沐子手作屋. The short-row flat section forms the pit hollow; keep the skin one round taller and join with a round of sc through both layers.

meta.intro: A finished Jellycat-style baby mobile with 24 macaron balls and a basket of fruit-and-food charms — this post collects the charts used: mushroom, boiled egg, skinny eggplant, peach, lemon and avocado plus the bead ring.

faq.question: Where do the individual charts come from?
faq.answer: The maker collected public charts from several designers (each chart carries its author's watermark) and crocheted the set during late pregnancy — credits are preserved in each pattern's notes.

faq.question: How many balls make the ring?
faq.answer: 24 balls in 8 macaron colors, repeating 3 times, crocheted as one continuous chain of stuffed balls then joined into a circle.

faq.question: Which charm is the trickiest?
faq.answer: The avocado — it uses short rows to hollow a dip for the pit and joins flesh and skin with a 69-sc round through both layers. The peach's shaping cinch is the other fiddly step.

patterns.englishText:
Mini Goose Charm — Tiny Duckling Keychain

Body
Rnd 1: Ch 6; starting from the 2nd ch from hook: 4 sc, 3 sc in the next st, then along the other side 3 sc, inc (working around the chain)
Rnd 2: Sc in each st around

meta.intro: A mini white goose charm that works up in under an hour — a folded oval body with orange beak and feet on a ball chain. Impossible to tell if it's a goose or a duck, and that's the charm.
materials: Xuefeier 萌娃娃2号 yarn in white (01) and orange (26)

faq.question: How does the folded body work?
faq.answer: Work an oval around a ch-6 base for three rounds, then on round 4 crochet 3 sc, fold and cross to the opposite side and continue — this pinches the oval into the goose's body-and-head shape.

faq.question: How do I close the top?
faq.answer: Thread the tail through the front loops only of the last round and pull tight like a drawstring, then sew flat.

title: Crochet Stingray Amigurumi
description:
在ins刷到这个超级可爱的鳐鱼钩织玩偶，搜了xhs竟然发现没有一模一样的，钩针新手决定挑战一下，分享给大家。
先钩织鳐鱼的上下两片（图5）；用黑色毛线缝出眼睛嘴等（图8）；将白色预留线缝合里圈内半针，留小口塞棉花后缝合（图9）；最后用灰色预留线缝合外轮廓即完成。

**标签**: 图解 毛线手工 钩针图解 钩针 手工钩织 图解分享 织女 钩针玩偶
author: Luyi年糕糖

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Stingray — Top & Bottom Panels

White bottom panel
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 4: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 5: *9 sc, inc*, repeat 3 times (33)
Rnd 6: Worked in FLO only. The sequence below is HALF of the outline — work it once, then work it again in reverse order back to the start. Each ( ) group = one stitch of the previous round:
(sl st) (hdc, hdc) (sl st) (hdc, sl st) (sc) (sc) (dc, dc) (hdc, hdc, sl st) (sl st, dtr) (dtr, dtr) (dtr) (dtr) (hdc, hdc) (dc) (dc, hdc) (hdc, sl st) (dtr)
Tail: Ch 10; starting from the 2nd ch from hook work 4 sl st, 5 sc. Leave a 30 cm tail for sewing.

Gray-black top panel
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: Sc in each st around (24)
Rnd 6: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 7: *9 sc, inc*, repeat 3 times (33)
Rnd 8: Same edging as Rnd 6 of the white panel; only the tail differs.
Tail: Ch 10; from 2nd ch from hook work 4 sc, 5 dc. Leave a 50 cm tail for sewing.
patterns.chineseText:

R6:⚠️此圈只钩外半针，下面是一半的图解，钩完以后从后往前再钩一遍，()为一个针目
(引拔针)(F,F)(E)(F,引拔针)(X)(X)(T,T)(F,F,E)(E,3卷长针)(3卷长针,3卷长针)(3卷长针)(3卷长针)(F,F)(T)(T,F)(F,E)(3卷长针)

尾部起10ch，倒1钩4X，5T，预留50cm线用于缝合
patterns.notes: Stingray amigurumi in two flat panels (white bottom, gray-black top) crocheted separately, edged, then sewn together with the tail. Original inspiration from Korean IG designer applemint_knit. Chart shorthand: X=sc, V=inc, F=hdc, T=dc, E/引拔针=sl st, 3卷长针=dtr (3-wrap treble). Stitch heights in the FLO edging round are the translator's best mapping of the shorthand.

meta.intro: A flat stingray amigurumi worked as two panels — a white belly and a gray-black top — edged with a sweep of graduated stitches and finished with a skinny tail. Sew the panels together for a squishy palm-size ray.

faq.question: How is the stingray constructed?
faq.answer: Two flat panels are crocheted separately. Each ends with a FLO edging round that sweeps from slip stitches up to double trebles to create the wing outline, then the panels are sewn together with light stuffing.

faq.question: Why is the edging written as only half the outline?
faq.answer: The chart gives half of the wing sequence; you work it once, then repeat it in reverse back to the start so both wings mirror each other.

faq.question: What are the tails made of?
faq.answer: Each panel has its own chained tail (ch 10 base). The bottom tail uses slip stitches and sc; the top uses sc and dc. Leave 30-50 cm yarn ends for sewing the panels together.

author: 芷兰兮

patterns.englishText:
Off-Duty Duck — Duck on a Sofa ('Don't Want to Work' Duck)

Short-row shaping: '渡线到...第N针' means sl st/travel the yarn to the Nth stitch of the given round, then work the listed stitches back and forth over that section (partial rounds that build the duck's chest and head bumps). W = 3 sc in one st; M = sc3tog.

Body (in the round, white)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnds 4-5: 18 sc
Rnd 6: travel to 7th st of Rnd 5, 6 sc (6)
Rnd 7: travel to 6th st of Rnd 5, 8 sc (8)
Rnd 8: travel to 5th st of Rnd 5, 10 sc (10)
Rnd 9: travel to 4th st of Rnd 5, 12 sc (12)
Rnd 10: travel to 1st st of Rnd 5, 18 sc (18)
Rnd 11: travel to 7th st of Rnd 10, 6 sc (6)
Rnd 12: travel to 6th st of Rnd 10, 8 sc (8)
Rnd 13: travel to 5th st of Rnd 10, 10 sc (10)
Rnd 14: travel to 4th st of Rnd 10, 12 sc (12)
Rnd 15: travel to 1st st of Rnd 10: sc, inc, 14 sc, inc, sc (20)
Rnd 16: 8 sc, (FLO: 4 inc), 8 sc (24)
Rnd 17: 8 sc, inc, 6 sc, inc, 8 sc (26)
Rnd 18: travel to 9th st of Rnd 17: 3 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 3 sc (12)
Rnd 19: travel to 8th st of Rnd 17: 14 sc (14)
Rnd 20: travel to 7th st of Rnd 17: 6 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 6 sc (18)
Rnd 21: travel to 6th st of Rnd 17: 20 sc (20)
Rnd 22: travel to 5th st of Rnd 17: 22 sc (22)
Rnd 23: travel to 1st st of Rnd 17: sc, inc, 26 sc, inc, sc (32)
Rnds 24-25: 32 sc
Rnd 26: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 27: *Sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (16)
Rnd 28: Dec 8 times (8). Stuff, close.

Wings (make 2, flat — see the little symbol chart: start at the bottom point, sc up one side, 3-sc in the corner, back down)
Row 1: Ch 2, inc from 2nd ch
Row 2: Ch 1, from 2nd ch: sc, inc
Rows 3-4: Ch 1, 3 sc
Edge: sc along both side edges with 3 sc (W) at the corner point.

Beak: Ch 3, from 2nd ch: 2 sc.

Feet (yarn split to 2 strands, make 2, in the round)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: BLO: 3 inc, [hdc, dc], [dc, hdc], inc (12)
Rnd 3: Ch 2, dc, ch 2, then twice [sl st, ch 2, dc, ch 2], sl st — the three webbed toes
Then work 4 rounds of 6 sc into the front loops of Rnd 1 (the leg).

Sofa Seat Cushion (red, in the round)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: (Sc, 3 sc in next st) 4 times (16)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, W, (3 sc, W) 3 times, sc (24)
Rnd 4: 3 sc, W, (5 sc, W) 3 times, 2 sc (32)
Rnds 5-6: 32 sc
Rnd 7: 3 sc, sc3tog, (5 sc, sc3tog) 3 times, 2 sc (24)
Rnd 8: 2 sc, sc3tog, (3 sc, sc3tog) 3 times, sc (16)
Rnd 9: (Sc, sc3tog) 4 times (8) — a flat square cushion; the W/sc3tog columns form the corners.

Sofa Backrest (red, in the round)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Sc, 2 W, 2 sc, 2 W, sc (16)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, W, 2 sc, W, 4 sc, W, 2 sc, W, 2 sc (24)
Rnds 4-5: 24 sc
Rnd 5b: 2 sc, sc3tog, 2 sc, sc3tog, 4 sc, sc3tog, 2 sc, sc3tog, 2 sc (16)
Rnd 6: Sc, 2 sc3tog, 2 sc, 2 sc3tog, sc (8)

Assembly: sew backrest to cushion, sit the duck on the sofa, sew wings to the sides, add beak and 3mm eyes; badge is felt, chair legs are yarn-wrapped wire bent to shape.

patterns.notes: Original design by @芷兰兮. Yarn: Xuefeier Mengwawa No.2 in pure white, chick yellow, watermelon red, haze blue; hooks 2.0mm (feet 1.4mm); 3mm eyes. The many short-row 'travel' rounds sculpt the duck's slumped chest and head — follow the stitch counts at the end of each row.

meta.intro: A slumped-over duck that clearly does not want to go to work, complete with its own crocheted red sofa, felt ID badge and wire chair legs.
materials: Xuefeier Mengwawa No.2: pure white, chick yellow, watermelon red, haze blue
Felt badge, wire for chair legs

faq.question: What are all the 'travel to st N' rounds?
faq.answer: Short rows: you slip the yarn to a given stitch of an earlier round and crochet partial rows there — they sculpt the duck's slumped chest and drooping head.

faq.question: How are the webbed feet shaped?
faq.answer: A 6-sc ring flares in BLO with hdc/dc pairs, then three (ch 2, dc, ch 2, sl st) points form the toes; the leg is worked up from the leftover front loops.

faq.question: What are W and M in the sofa rounds?
faq.answer: W = 3 sc in one stitch, M = sc3tog — they form the sofa cushion's square corners.

title: Raffia Snail Bag Charm

patterns.englishText:
Raffia Snail Bag Charm — Coach-Style Snail

Yarn: raffia in cinnamon + grain; 2.5mm hook, single strand. Hardware: 3mm faux-leather cord, letter charm, 4mm black eyes.

Shell (cinnamon; work every sc into the back loop — the loop away from you)
Worked flat in rows, turning each row (ch 1 at each turn):
Row 1: Ch 2, inc from 2nd ch
Row 2: Sc, inc
Row 3: 3 sc
Row 4: Sc, inc, sc
Row 5: 4 sc
Row 6: Sc, inc, 2 sc
Row 7: 5 sc
Row 8: Sc, inc, 3 sc
Row 9: 6 sc
Row 10: Sc, inc, 4 sc
Row 11: 7 sc
Row 12: Sc, inc, 5 sc
Row 13: 8 sc
Row 14: Sc, inc, 6 sc
Row 15: 9 sc
Row 16: Sc, inc, 7 sc
Row 17: 10 sc
Row 18: Sc, inc, 8 sc
Row 19: 11 sc
Row 20: Sc, inc, 9 sc
Row 21: 12 sc
Row 22: Sc, inc, 10 sc (mark the 2nd sc — hanging loop position)
Row 23: 13 sc
Row 24: Sc, inc, 11 sc
Row 25: 14 sc
Row 26: Sc, inc, 12 sc
Row 27: 15 sc
Rows 28-29: 15 sc
Row 30: Sc, dec, 12 sc
Row 31: 14 sc
Row 32: Sc, dec, 11 sc
Row 33: 13 sc; leave a long tail and cut.
Fold the strip in half lengthwise and sl st the stitches together pair by pair back to the start, stuffing as you go. Then coil the stuffed tube into a snail spiral and whip-stitch (S-shaped stitches) along the slip-stitched ridge to hold the coil.

Antennae (make 2, grain color): double-chain foundation of 10 ch, leave long tails.

Body (grain color)
Lower body: Ch 22; from 3rd ch: hdc-inc, 12 hdc, 4 dc(t), 2 sc, (5 sc in end st); other side: 2 sc, 4 dc, 12 hdc, hdc-inc; sl st, cut.
Upper body:
Row 1: Ch 21; from 2nd ch: inc, 18 sc, 3 sc in end st; other side: 18 sc, inc
Row 2: 21 sc, (dc, hdc, dc) around the tip, 21 sc, sl st
Row 3: 21 sc, (dc, hdc-inc), (hdc, sl st, hdc), (hdc-inc, dc), 21 sc, sl st. Leave a long tail (this end is the head).

Assembly: attach the antennae first — thread the two chain tails through the top of the head and knot inside. Match the wide end of the lower body to the head, whip-stitch pair by pair to the tail; fold the last 3 sts of the upper body and sew to the opposite side; finish sewing around the head. Sew the shell onto the body, hide ends, glue on the eyes.

faq.question: How does the flat strip become a shell?
faq.answer: The long BLO-ridged strip is folded in half, slip-stitched closed while stuffing, then coiled into a spiral and whip-stitched along the ridge.

faq.question: Where does the hanging loop go?
faq.answer: Mark the 2nd sc of Row 22 — that stitch becomes the hanging point for the cord.

patterns.englishText:
Lazy Goose Charm — Flopped-Over White Goose

Body (white — worked as one piece: round body, long floppy neck, then yellow beak)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 6-9: Sc around (30)
Rnd 10: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 11: Sc around (24)
Rnd 12: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 13: Sc around (18)
Rnd 14: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 15: Sc around (12)
Rnd 16: Dec 6 times (6) — stuff the body; the neck starts here
Rnds 17-24: 6 sc around (the long skinny neck — leave unstuffed so it flops)
Rnd 25: Inc in each st (12)
Rnds 26-30: 12 sc around (the head)
Rnd 31: Dec 6 times (6)
Change to yellow:
Rnds 32-34: 6 sc around (the beak)
Rnd 35: Dec 3 times, close.

Wings (make 2)
Ch 9, from 2nd ch: 7 sc, 3 sc in next st (W), 5 sc, ch 1, turn; 5 sc, 3 inc, 7 sc, ch 3, from 2nd ch: 10 sc, (inc, sc) 3 times, 2 sc.

Webbed Feet
Ch 7, from 2nd ch: sc, sl st into the 2nd ch from the end; *ch 2, sc from 2nd ch, sl st into the same hole as the previous sl st* twice (the three toe points), then work into the back bumps of the remaining 5 chain sts to the end.

meta.intro: A 'lying flat' lazy goose with a long unstuffed neck that flops wherever it lands — round body, floppy head, little wings and webbed feet.
materials: Xuefeier Mengxiaoya yarn, colors 02 white / 25 yellow

faq.question: Why does the goose flop?
faq.answer: The 8-round neck tube (Rnds 17-24) is left unstuffed, so the head hangs — that's the 'lying flat' pose.

faq.question: How are the webbed feet made?
faq.answer: Chain spurs: ch 7 back with a sl st anchor, then two (ch 2, sl st) points, finishing along the leftover chain's back bumps.

title: Avocado Buddy Charm
description:
图解仅供参考哦

**标签**: #钩针图解 #钩针玩偶 #分享一个喜欢的钩织作品 #钩针 #图解 #钩针挂件 #钩针日常 #手工钩织 #钩针小物 #图解分享
author: 十六

patterns.englishText:
Avocado Buddy Charm — Body (Part 1)

Materials: Susu 4-ply combed cotton — dark green #41 (skin), light green #40 (flesh), brown #24 (pit & limbs), pink #14 (blush), black #06 (eyes/mouth). Tools: 2.0mm hook, tapestry needle, stuffing, 8mm black safety eyes, green braided cord, metal ring.

Body (dark green skin + light green flesh)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6, dark green)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12, dark green)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18, dark green)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (24) — change to light green
Rnds 5-8: Sc in each st around (24, light green). Attach the eyes, embroider blush and mouth, and stuff now.
Rnd 9: *2 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (18, back to dark green)
Rnd 10: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12, dark green)
Rnd 11: Dec 6 times; close (6, dark green).

patterns.englishText:
Avocado Buddy Charm — Pit, Limbs & Assembly (Part 2)

Pit (brown)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnds 3-4: Sc around (12)
Rnd 5: Dec 6 times (6); stuff lightly.
Sew to the center of the light-green flesh.

Arms (make 2, brown)
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnds 2-3: Sc around (4)
Rnd 4: (Sc, inc) twice (6)
Rnds 5-6: Sc around (6)
Rnd 7: Dec 2 times; close.
Sew to the sides of the body.

Feet (make 2, brown)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnds 3-4: Sc around (12)
Rnd 5: Dec 6 times; close.

Assembly
1. Sew the pit onto the flesh area and the limbs to their spots.
2. Check the face (eyes, blush, mouth) and adjust the stuffing.
3. Thread the green cord through the metal ring, sew to the top — done!

patterns.englishText:

These covers wrap around a button: the starting chain ring encloses the button, then you work both sides around it.

Dog (Goofy-style)

Rnd 2: In yellow 12 inc / in blue 8 inc
Rnd 3: 24 sc / 16 sc
Rnd 4: 12 dec / 8 dec — close each side over the button
Head: Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: 6 inc (12); Rnd 3: 12 sc; Rnd 4: (5 sc, inc) twice (14); Rnds 5-8: 14 sc
Hat: Row 1: Ch 5, from 2nd ch: 3 sc, 3 sc in next st, 2 sc, inc; Row 2: sl st, sc, sc, (ch, sl st)
Muzzle: Ch 8, from 3rd ch: 5 hdc, 2 hdc in next st (TW=hdc-3? see note), hdc, 2 sl st, hdc, hdc-inc
Ears: Ch 8, from 2nd ch: 3 sc, 3 hdc, 3 hdc in next st, 3 hdc, 3 sc (around the chain)
Eyes: Ch 4, from 2nd ch: 2 sc, 3 sc in next st, 2 sc
Arms/Legs: Rnds 1-4: 6 sc around.

Cat (body worked the same as the other characters)
Head: Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR; Rnd 2: 8 inc (16); Rnd 3: (sc, inc) 8 times (24); Rnds 4-9: 24 sc; Rnd 10: 12 dec
Arms/Legs: Rnds 1-4: 6 sc (change colors as you like)
Ears: Ch 3, from 2nd ch: sc, hdc
Tail: Ch 11.

title: Puppy and Star Charms
description:

🧶线材；四股棉

**标签**: #星星元素 #钩针小物 #钩针挂件 #小狗钩织 #一起来钩织 #手工钩织 #星星钩针 #钩织使我快乐 #钩针教程 #钩针图解
author: 半糖正常冰-

patterns.englishText:
Puppy Charm — Flat Dog Silhouette (make 2 panels)

Ear
Ch 3, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc.

Head
Ch 7 from where you are, from 2nd ch: 8 sc
Rows H1-H4: ch 1, turn, 8 sc.

Body
Foundation: ch 13; working into the back bumps: 2 sl st, inc (this makes the tail), 10 sc — make sure the last sc lands at the head end; sl st
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, skip 1, 10 sc
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 12 sc (last sc at the head end), sl st
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, dec, 11 sc
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, inc, 11 sc
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, inc, 11 sc

Back Leg
Row 1: Ch 1, 2 sc, dec
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, turn, 3 sc
Row 4: Ch 2, turn, skip 1, working into the front half-loops: inc, 3 sc
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, 4 sc, sl st. Cut yarn.

Front Leg
Join yarn at the 4th stitch from the left under the body:
Row 1: Dec, 2 sc
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, turn, 3 sc
Row 4: Ch 2, turn, skip 1, inc, 3 sc
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, 4 sc, sl st.

Finish: make 2 identical panels, then sc them together around the edge — use dec or inc at the corners as needed to keep it flat. Stuff lightly with pearl cotton before closing.

小狗挂件织片 耳朵部分:起3ch,倒2回钩sl,x 脑袋部分:原地7ch,倒2钩8x H1-H4:立1ch,翻转钩8x
身体部分:起13ch,背面回钩2sl,v(完成尾巴部分),10x【确保最后一针x在头部】,sl 立1ch,翻转,倒2钩10x 立1ch,翻转,钩12x【最后一针x在头部】,sl 立1ch,翻转,1A,11x 立1ch,翻转,1V,11x 立1ch,翻转,1V,11x
后腿部分:立1ch,2x,1A 立1ch,翻转,3x 立1ch,翻转,3x 立2ch,翻转,倒2,挑上半边钩1v,3x 立1ch,翻转,4x,sl【断线】
前腿部分:【找到身体下,从左到右第4个针目处】带线起针,1A,2x 立1ch,翻转,3x 立1ch,翻转,3x 立2ch,翻转,倒2,钩v,3x 立1ch,翻转,4x,sl
完成2片一样的织片后,用x缝合,拐角处用A或V灵活应对 内部可塞适量珍珠棉
patterns.notes: Flat silhouette puppy charm by @半糖正常冰-. Worked in rows as one connected piece: ear → head → body → legs. Yarn: 4-ply cotton, 2.5mm hook. Pair with the star pendant from the same post.

patterns.englishText:
Star Pendant — Five-Point Star (two methods)

Method 1 (recommended by the designer)
Rnd 1: Ch 3 (standing), 10 dc in MR (10)
Rnd 2: Sc, then repeat 5 times: (hdc, dc, ch 1, sl st, ch 1, dc, hdc) — each group forms one star point.

Method 2 (the one shown crocheted)
Rnd 1: Ch 3 (standing), 14 dc in MR (14)
Rnd 2: Repeat 5 times: ch 5, then from 2nd ch: sc, hdc, dc, sl st, skip 2 sts of the base round, sl st into the next st — each chain spike is one star point.
patterns.chineseText:
五角星挂件织片 方法1 R1:立3ch,10F R2:X,(T,F,ch,E,ch,F,T)重复5次
方法2 R1:立3ch,14F R2:5ch,倒2,钩X,T,F,E,空2针,引拔(重复5次) 我钩的方法2,更推荐方法1
patterns.notes: Companion star for the puppy charm. In this author's key: X=sc, T=hdc, F=dc, E=sl st. Designer notes she crocheted Method 2 but recommends Method 1 for a neater star.

meta.intro: A quick zero-waste project: a flat puppy silhouette and a five-point star, each made from two panels sc'd together — done in minutes from leftover yarn.

faq.question: How is the puppy shaped?
faq.answer: It's one connected flat piece — ear, head rows, body rows, then back and front legs worked off the body edge; make two and join with sc.

faq.question: Which star method should I use?
faq.answer: The designer recommends Method 1 (10 dc ring + 5 stitch-graded points); Method 2 uses ch-5 spikes instead.

patterns.englishText:
Persimmon & Apple Charms — Flat Fruit Pendants

Persimmon / Apple Body (flat medallion)
Rnd 1: 7 sc in MR (7)
Rnd 2: 2 inc, hdc-inc, inc, hdc-inc, 2 inc
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc) 7 times
Rnd 4: Sc, inc, sc, hdc-inc, hdc, hdc-inc, sc, inc, sc, 2 sl st, sc, inc, sc, hdc-inc, hdc, hdc-inc, sc, inc, sc, sl st — the two sl-st dips form the top and bottom indents of the fruit.

Persimmon Calyx
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR
Rnd 2 (eight leaf points): [Ch 4, from 2nd ch: sc, 2 hdc] / [Ch 5, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc, 2 hdc] — alternate the two lengths as listed: 4ch, 5ch, 5ch, 4ch, 4ch, 5ch, 5ch, 4ch, each anchored with a sl st into the next base st.

Strawberry
Rnd 1: Ch 5, from 2nd ch: 3 sc, 3 sc in next st, 2 sc, inc (working around the chain)
Rnd 2: Inc, 2 sc, 3 inc, 2 sc, 2 inc
Rnd 3: (Sc, hdc), 2 dc, hdc, 2 sc, 2 inc, 2 sc, hdc, 2 dc, (hdc, sc), 2 inc
Strawberry leaves: 6 sc in MR; then *ch 2, sc from 2nd ch, sl st into next st*, repeat 4 times; for the 5th leaf: ch 3, 2 sc from 2nd ch, sl st.

Apple Leaf: Ch 6, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc, hdc, sc, sl st.
Apple Stem: Ch 9, from 2nd ch: 3 sc, 2 hdc, 3 sc; fold in half.

meta.intro: Flat persimmon and apple charms with a strawberry variant — lucky fruit pendants ('may all go well, peace be with you') with leafy calyxes and knotted cords.

faq.question: How do the fruits stay flat with a dent?
faq.answer: The medallion mixes sc, hdc and two sl-st dips in Rnd 4 — the sl sts pull in the top and bottom like a real persimmon.
