title: Tucked-Paws Calico Cat Brooch
description:
手绘图解，🚫盗图

**标签**: #一起来钩织 #钩针图解 #钩针小物 #钩针日常 #三花猫果然是大美女 #三花脸猫 #钩针 #图解分享 #万物皆可猫 #图解
author: 烤个地瓜

patterns.englishText:
Tucked-Paws Calico Cat Brooch — Symbol Chart (Base)

A flat, side-lying cat worked as one piece from a foundation chain, read directly from the hand-drawn chart:

Construction: the row of chain ovals across the middle is the foundation chain. Work sc (X) around both sides of it in an oval, shaping with inc (V) at the head and rump ends and dec (A / dotted marks) where the outline curves in — exactly as each symbol is placed in the chart.
Color blocks: the piece is mostly yellow (cream body); the orange X-blocks on the upper back and the dark grey X-blocks by the shoulder/face are the calico patches — change color for those stitches as charted (intarsia, carry the unused color).
Tail: the dark grey chain at lower left — a small ring start, then the chained/sc tail curling out (2 sc, inc symbols along it), tipped with the grey fan (3-4 hdc cluster) at the end.
Ears: the two small triangles at the top right — short rows of sc/hdc (orange one with an hdc fan and ch at the tip, grey-dotted one beside it); sl st (dots) anchor the ear tips.
Cheek/haunch fans: the large yellow V and radiating stitches on the right form the increased fan for the cat's rear haunch where the paws tuck under.

Work the matching face details from the companion chart, then back the piece for a brooch.
patterns.chineseText: （手绘符号图）揣手手三花猫胸针图解：侧躺猫咪整体织片。从左下深灰色尾巴起（环形6针，沿尾巴符号2x,v等渐变），沿黄色身体主体一圈圈钩短针X与加针V、减针A塑形；中央一排锁针链为起始行，身体两侧对称；橙色与深灰色区域为三花花色的色块（按图换色）；右上角橙色/深灰符号为耳朵（短针+中长针小三角，耳尖点为引拔收针）；黄色大V符号标记脸颊/后腿的加针扇形。
patterns.notes: Hand-drawn original chart by @烤个地瓜 (marked 手绘图解 🚫盗图 — no reposting; check rights before publishing). Chart is displayed to the reader; this description explains reading order: foundation chain center, oval sc rounds with charted inc/dec, calico color blocks, chained tail, triangle ears.

patterns.englishText:
Tucked-Paws Calico Cat Brooch — Face Placement Chart

The same side-lying calico cat chart with the finished face marked in place. Crochet the base piece first, exactly as in the companion chart: sc (X) worked around both sides of the central foundation chain, with inc (V) and dec shaping as charted, the calico color blocks in orange and grey, the chained sl-st tail and the sc/hdc triangle ears.

Then place the features:
Eyes: two black dots embroidered close together on the face block, just right of the grey patch.
Blush: a small pink oval under each eye.
Whiskers: three fine black strands fanning out on each side of the muzzle.
Mouth: a small curved line centered below the eyes.
Finish by backing the piece with felt and a brooch pin.
patterns.chineseText: （手绘符号图-带五官）同一侧躺三花猫图解的成品示意版：在基础织片符号上标出眼睛（两颗黑色圆点，位于脸部中央偏右）、粉色腮红椭圆、黑色胡须线（左右各三根）和微笑嘴线的位置。
patterns.notes: Face-placement version of the calico brooch chart by @烤个地瓜 (no-repost notice — check rights). Display together with the base chart.

meta.intro: A calico cat brooch with tucked-in paws, worked flat from a hand-drawn symbol chart — orange and grey patches, a curling tail and embroidered whiskers.

patterns.englishText:
No-Sew Hash Brown — McDonald's Style Hash Brown in a Sleeve

Hash Brown
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnds 4-12: Sc in each st around (18) — a flattened oval
Rnd 13: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)

'M' Logo: with yarn held double, ch 46; shape into the M and sew the extra ends in.

Paper Sleeve
With red:
Row 1: Ch 11, from 2nd ch: 9 sc, 3 sc in next st, 8 sc, inc (working around the chain)
Row 2: (Ch 3 counts as first dc), 2 hdc, 4 sc, 2 hdc, 3 dc, 2 hdc, 4 sc, 2 hdc, 2 dc
Change to white:
Row 3: 2 sc, 6 hdc, 5 sc, 6 hdc, 3 sc
Rows 4-9: 22 sc
Row 10: (Ch 3 counts as first dc), hdc, 2 sc, 4 sl st, 2 sc, hdc, 11 dc — the scalloped sleeve opening.

author: Selena615

patterns.englishText:
Raffia Mini Hat Charms — Three Brim Styles (Part 1)

Style 1 (classic sun hat)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnds 5-8: Sc around (24) — the crown
Rnd 9: 2 dc in each st around (48) — the flared brim
Rnd 10: *Ch 2, skip 1, sl st*, repeat 8 times around the brim edge.

Style 2 (lacy flower brim)
Rnd 1: 12 sc in MR
Rnd 2: 2 hdc in each st (24)
Rnd 3: 24 sc
Rnd 4: 24 hdc in BLO
Rnd 5: 24 hdc — crown done
Brim R6: in one st (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc), skip 2, in one st (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc), repeat around
Brim R7: into each ch-2 hole of the previous round work 6 dc, then sc between shells: *6 dc, sc*, repeat — the petal scallops.

Style 3 (tall crown)
Rnd 1: 10 hdc in MR
Rnd 2: Hdc-inc in each st (20)
Rnd 3: *Hdc, hdc-inc*, repeat 10 times (30)
Rnds 4-5: Hdc around, no inc/dec
Brim: same as Style 2.

Hook: 2.2/2.5mm. Keep your tension tight — the hats look much crisper.

patterns.notes: Three mini straw-hat pendant variations in raffia. Key: X=sc, V=inc, T=hdc, F=dc, K1=skip 1. Finish with a faux-leather cord bow and beads.

patterns.englishText:
Raffia Mini Hat Charms — Tiny Necklace Versions (Part 2)

Mini Style 1
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: FLO sc around, no inc/dec (18) — turns the crown edge
Rnds 5-6: Sc around, no inc/dec
Brim R7: 2 dc in every stitch around (36)
Brim R8: *Ch 2, skip 1, sl st*, repeat around.

Mini Style 2
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnds 4-6: 18 sc
Brim: same as Mini Style 1.

Hook 2.2mm, slightly tight tension; finish with an invisible join (无痕引拔).

faq.question: What's the key to a crisp hat?
faq.answer: Tight tension — the designer stresses 手要紧 (keep it tight) and an invisible join for the final round.

patterns.englishText:
Long-Neck Yellow Duck — Silly Goose-Neck Duck Charm

Body + Neck (one piece, yellow)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnds 4-6: Sc around (24)
Rnd 7: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 8: Sc around (18)
Rnd 9: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 10: Sc around (12)
Rnd 11: Dec 6 times (6) — stuff the body
Rnds 12-42: 6 sc around — the very long neck (leave lightly stuffed or unstuffed so you can tie it in a knot!)

Head (orange beak base → yellow)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: Change color: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30) — continue for the head per the photo

Eyes: 12 sc in MR (black); Eye whites: 8 sc in MR.
Wings: 8 sc in MR, ch 2, sl st from 2nd ch, join with sl st to the first st of the ring.
Webbed Feet: Ch 8, from 2nd ch: 3 sl st; then (ch 3, from 2nd ch: 3 sl st) twice; finish with a sl st — three floppy toes.

Mangosteen Cat — Purple Shell, Calyx & Cream Cat

Mangosteen Shell (make 2, grape purple)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Inc, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (36)
Rnd 7: *5 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (42)
Rnds 8-11: Sc around (42)
Rnd 12 (change to watermelon red, BLO): *5 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (36)
Rnd 13 (BLO): 36 sc
Rnds 14-16: 36 sc
Rnd 17: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 18: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 19: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 20: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Fasten off; thread through the front loop of every other st and cinch.

Calyx (willow green)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR
Rnds 2-3: 8 sc
Rnd 4 (FLO): repeat twice: [sl st, ch 3, q1], [q1, ch 3, sl st], [sl st, ch 2, q2], [q2, ch 2, sl st]
Special sts: q1 = 2 unfinished sl sts closed together; q2 = 2 unfinished hdc closed together; [ ] = all worked into the same stitch.

Cat Ears (make 2, cream)
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Inc, (sc, inc) twice (8)
Fasten off the first ear; keep yarn on the second.

Cat Head (cream)
Rnd 1 (22): with the live ear, sl st in its first st, ch 1, sl st into the first st of the other ear's Rnd 2, then (3 sc, 2 inc, 4 sc) around both ears twice
Rnd 2: 2 sc, inc, 15 sc, inc, 3 sc (24)
Rnd 3: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 4: 3 sc, inc, 20 sc, inc, 5 sc (32)
Rnd 5: Sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 20 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 3 sc (36)
Rnds 6-7: 36 sc
Rnd 8: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 9: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 10: *Dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 11: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Fasten off; close through front loops of every other st.

patterns.englishText:
Mini Taco — Tortilla, Lettuce & Sausage

Tortilla (tan, a flat circle folded in half)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)

Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (40)
Rnd 6: BLO, *2 sc, inc, sl st + cut after 2 sc*, repeat 8 times — the BLO edge helps the taco fold.

Lettuce (green ruffle)
Row 1: Ch 7, from 2nd ch: 5 sc
Row 2: Hdc-inc, 4 hdc, hdc-inc
Row 3: Ruffled edge — repeat (ch 5, sl st) along, then: 3 sc in one st (W), 4 sc, inc, hdc-inc, 4 hdc, hdc-inc, hdc.

Sausage (orange-yellow)
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Inc, 3 sc, inc (7)
Rnds 3-9: 7 sc around
Rnd 10: Dec, 3 sc, dec (5). Stuff lightly, close.
Embroider the red ketchup squiggle with red yarn.

patterns.notes: Taco from the mini vegetable/fruit charm set by @雪糕凉不凉. Key: T=hdc, Tv/TV=hdc-inc, W=3 sc in one st. Fold the tortilla around lettuce + sausage and tack in place.

patterns.englishText:
Popcorn-Stitch Pineapple — Bumpy Mini Pineapple

Body (yellow)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnds 3-6: 12 popcorn stitches per round — work 5 dc in each stitch (for the first popcorn of a round: ch 3 + 4 dc), close each popcorn
(If popcorn stitch is new to you: it's 5 dc in one st, then remove hook, insert through the first dc and pull the loop through to pinch the bump.)
Rnd 7: 6 popcorn decreases — work one popcorn over every 2 stitches (merging them)
Sl st, ch, cut. Remember to stuff before closing!

Leaves (green)
Rnd 1: Changing to green on top of body Rnd 7, work 6 sc
Rnd 2: *Ch 7, from 2nd ch: sl st, 2 sc, 2 hdc, dc, sl st into the next st*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 3: Same as Rnd 2, but insert the hook between the leaves of the previous round and work 6 more leaf points — this makes the crown nice and full.
Sl st, cut, weave in the end — done!
patterns.chineseText:
菠萝 主体 R1:环形起针,6个短针 R2:6组短针加针 R3-R6:12组爆米花针(每个针目里钩5个长针,第一针钩3个起立针+4个长针) R7:6组爆米花减针(每2个针目合并钩一个爆米花针) 钩完后引拔锁针断线(记得塞棉花)
叶子 R1:在菠萝主体的R7基础上换成绿色线,钩6个短针 R2:7CH,倒2回钩SL,2X,2T,F,在下一针引拔,重复钩织6组 R3:同第2圈,找到叶子中间插针,再钩6组(这样叶子会比较茂盛) 钩完后引拔锁针断线,把线藏进去就完成啦
patterns.notes: Pineapple from the mini veggie/fruit set, original by @吾mo怪. The popcorn-stitch rounds create the knobby pineapple skin; two stacked leaf rounds make a full crown.

patterns.englishText:
Carrot Charm — Long Carrot with Leafy Top

Body (orange, worked tip-down)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: (Sc, inc) 3 times (9)
Rnd 3: 9 sc
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc) 3 times (12)
Rnd 5: 12 sc
Rnd 6: (3 sc, inc) 3 times (15)
Rnd 7: 15 sc
Rnd 8: (4 sc, inc) 3 times (18)
Rnd 9: 18 sc
Rnd 10: (5 sc, inc) 3 times (21)
Rnd 11: 21 sc
Rnd 12: (6 sc, inc) 3 times (24)
Rnds 13-18: 24 sc
Rnd 19: *2 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 20: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12) — stuff now
Rnd 21: Dec 6 times (6). Close.

Leaves (make 6 chain fronds)
1: Ch 15, hdc back starting from the 3rd ch
2: Ch 16, hdc back from 3rd ch
3: Ch 16, hdc back from 3rd ch
4: Ch 17, hdc back from 3rd ch
5: Ch 18, hdc back from 3rd ch
6: Ch 18, hdc back from 3rd ch
Sew or fabric-glue the fronds into the top; finish by embroidering the little white carrot lines around the body.
patterns.chineseText:
胡萝卜 主体 R1:环起6x R2:3(x,v) R3:9x R4:3(2x,v) R5:12x R6:3(3x,v) R7:15x R8:3(4x,v) R9:18x R10:3(5x,v) R11:21x R12:3(6x,v) R13-R18:24x R19:6(2x,A) R20:6(x,A)这时候可以塞棉花了 R21:6A
叶子*6 1:15ch倒回第3针钩T(中长针) 2:16ch倒回第3针钩T 3:16ch倒回第3针钩T 4:17ch倒回第3针钩T 5:18ch倒回第3针钩T 6:18ch倒回第3针钩T 叶子和主体缝合,或者用织物胶水粘合,最后用白色线缝一下胡萝卜纹路 图解来自@Robi
patterns.notes: Carrot from the mini veggie/fruit set; chart credited to @Robi. The graduated chain fronds bunch into a leafy top.

patterns.englishText:
Chili Pepper & Mesh Produce Bag

Chili Pepper (red)
Rnd 1: 3 sc in MR (3)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (6)
Rnd 3: 6 sc
Rnd 4: 6 sc
Rnd 5: (2 sc, inc) twice (8)
Rnds 6-8: 8 sc
Rnd 9: (3 sc, inc) twice (10)
Rnds 10-11: 10 sc
Rnd 12: (4 sc, dec) twice (8)
Rnd 13: Sc, dec — stuff as you go
Change to green: dec 4 times; then ch 5, sl st back along 4 sts (the stem), cut.

Mesh Produce Bag (net bag)
Rnd 1: Wrap yarn twice into a ring; (ch 7, sc into the ring) 7 times, ch 3, sl st (8 loops)
Rnd 2: (Ch 9, sl st into the 4th ch of the previous round's ch-7 loop) 7 times; for the last group ch 4 and sl st into the previous round's sl st
Rnds 3-6: Repeat Rnd 2, slip-stitching into the middle (5th) chain of each loop below
Rnd 7 (handle setup): (Ch 9, sl st into the 5th ch of the loop below) twice, ch 4, sl st into the 5th ch
Rnd 8: Turn, ch 9, sl st into the middle below, ch 4, sl st
Rnd 9: Turn, ch 14, sl st in the middle, cut — this is one strap; rejoin yarn on the other side and repeat Rnds 7-9 for the second strap.
patterns.chineseText:
小辣椒🌶️ R1:3x R2:3V R3:6X R4:6x R5:(2X,v)*2 R6-R8:8X R9:(3x,V)*2 R10-R11:10X R12:(4x,a)*2 R13:x,a 换绿色线4A 5ch,倒二引拔4针,断线,边钩边塞棉花
装菜网兜袋子 R1:环起绕两圈线,(7CH,X)*7,3CH,E R2:(9CH,在上一圈7CH第4个辫子上引拔)*7,最后一组起4CH,在上一圈E上钩E R3~R6:重复R2的钩织方法,在上一圈中间第5个辫子上引拔 R7:(9CH,上一圈第5个辫子引拔)*2,4CH,第五个辫子上E R8:翻转,9CH,上一圈中间引拔,4CH,E R9:翻转,14CH,中间引拔断线,这里就是包带另一边重新起线,重复R7~R9
patterns.notes: Chili and the string mesh bag that holds the whole veggie set. The bag is pure chain-loop mesh; straps are chained on both sides.

patterns.englishText:
Banana Charm — Flat Banana in Rows

Banana Body (yellow, worked flat in rows of dc)
Row 1: Ch 18; from 2nd ch: 2 sl st, 13 dc, 2 sl st
Row 2: Turn: 2 sl st, 7 dc, dc-inc, 5 dc, 2 sl st
Rows 3-7: Turn: 2 sl st, 14 dc, 2 sl st
Row 8: 2 sl st, 7 dc, dc2tog, 5 dc, 2 sl st
Leave a long tail; the sl-st edges curve the strip — seam it into the banana shape.

Banana Bottom: Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR.
Banana Top: Rnds 1-2: 6 sc.
Stem: Ch 6, from 2nd ch: 5 sc; turn, Rows 2-3: 5 sc; fold in half and sew.
patterns.chineseText:
香蕉主体🍌 R1:18ch,倒2钩2sl,13t,2sl R2:翻转2sl,7t,tV,5t,2sl R3-R7:翻转,2sl,14t,2sl R8:2sl,7t,TA,5t,2sl 留长线缝合
香蕉底 R1:5x 香蕉头 R1-R2:6x
香蕉梗 R1:6ch,倒2回钩5x,翻转R2-R3:5X 对折缝合
patterns.notes: Flat-worked banana: the slip-stitch row ends pull the strip into a curve. Sew the seam, add the little end caps and folded stem. In this author's shorthand t=dc, tV=dc-inc, TA=dc2tog.

patterns.englishText:
Mini Green Onion — Scallion Charm

With white:
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnds 2-9: 8 sc around — the white stalk
Change to light green:
Rnds 10-12: 8 sc
Change to dark green:
Rnd 13: 4 sc, then sl st the round closed — this splits the top
First leaf: working on 4 sts, crochet 4 more rounds upward (5 rounds total), cut.
Second leaf: rejoin on the remaining 4 sts, sl st around, work 2 more rounds (3 total), cut.
The two green tubes form the split scallion leaves.
patterns.chineseText: mini一根葱 白线 R1:环起8X R2-R9:8X 换线,浅绿 R10-R12:8X 换线,深绿 R13:4X 首尾引拔,往上钩4圈,共5圈,断线4X,首尾引拔,往上钩2圈,共3圈,断线
patterns.notes: Skinny scallion: one white stalk that splits into two green hollow leaves of different heights. Don't stuff the leaves.

patterns.englishText:
Vegetable Basket — Oval Basket with Handles

Row/Rnd 1: Ch 10; from 2nd ch: 8 sc, 3 sc in the end st, then 7 sc down the other side, inc (20)
Rnd 2: Inc, 7 sc, 3 inc, 7 sc, 2 inc (26)
Rnd 3: Sc, inc, 7 sc, (sc, inc) 3 times, 7 sc, (sc, inc) twice (32)
Rnd 4: 2 sc, inc, 7 sc, (2 sc, inc) 3 times, 7 sc, (2 sc, inc) twice (38)
Rnds 5-7: 38 sc — the basket base and lower wall
Rnd 8: Dec, 6 sc, dec, 6 sc, dec, 5 sc, dec, 6 sc, dec, 3 sc, dec (32)
Rnd 9: FLO, 32 sc — the fold ridge for the rim
Rnd 10: 32 sc
Rnd 11: 13 sc, inc, 16 sc, inc, sc (34)
Rnd 12: 34 sc
Rnd 13: Turn the piece inside-out and crochet in the other direction (this rim section folds down): FLO, 32 sc
Rnd 14 (handles): 2 sc, ch 15, skip 2, 14 sc, ch 15, skip 2, 12 sc
Rnd 15: 58 sl st around, including along the handle chains
Fasten off; sew a contrasting line around for the basket detailing.
patterns.chineseText: 菜篮子🧺 R1:锁针起针10CH,倒二回钩8X,(3X),7X,V R2:V,7X,3V,7X,2V R3:X,V,7X,3*(X,V),7X,2*(X,V) R4:2X,V,7X,3*(2X,V),7X,2*(2X,V) R5-R7:38X R8:A,6X,A,6X,A,5X,A,6X,A,3X,A R9:FLO,32X R10:32X R11:13X,V,16X,V,X R12:34X R13:翻转,把织物翻过来,换一个方向钩,因为这一部分要翻下来的FLO,32X R14:2X,15CH,K2,14X,15CH,K2,12X R15:58SL 断线收尾,缝上造型线
patterns.notes: Little woven-look basket that carries the mini vegetables; the FLO fold-over makes a rolled rim, and the two ch-15 arcs are the handles.

patterns.englishText:
Watermelon Wedge — Magnet Fridge Charm

Wedge (worked as a half-dome)
Rnd 1: With red, 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: Inc in each st (24)
Rnd 4: (Sc, inc) 12 times (36)
Rnd 5: (2 sc, inc) 12 times (48)
Rnd 6: 48 sc (red flesh)
Rnd 7: Change to cream yellow, 48 sc (the pale rind line)
Rnd 8: Change to green, 48 sc (the rind)

Flat Bottom (green, worked in dc rows and sewn on)
Row 1: Ch 10, 8 dc starting from the 3rd ch
Row 2: 8 dc
Row 3: Dc2tog, 4 dc, dc2tog
Rows 4-5: 6 dc
Row 6: Dc2tog, 2 dc, dc2tog
Row 7: 2 dc2tog
Row 8: Dc2tog
Work the other half of Row 1's chain the same way (a symmetrical melon-slice shape). Sew the flat piece into the inner half-loops of the dome; stuff and slip a magnet in before closing.
Embroider black seeds on the red flesh.
patterns.chineseText:
🍉西瓜 大红色线 R1:红色环起6x R2:6v R3:12v R4:(x,v)12 R5:(2x,v)12 R6:48x R7:奶黄48x R8:绿色48x
换绿色线钩西瓜底: R1:10ch倒三8T R2:8T R3:TA,4T,TA R4-5:6T R6:TA,2T,TA R7:2TA R8:TA R1另外半边相同,在主体内半针缝合 钩到差不多就可以塞棉花,和磁铁
patterns.notes: Watermelon slice fridge magnet. In this author's shorthand T=dc, TA=dc2tog. Insert the magnet with the stuffing before sewing shut.

patterns.englishText:
Mini Napa Cabbage — Leafy Cabbage Charm

Outer Leaves (make 3)
Row 1: With white, ch 6; from 2nd ch: 4 sc, 3 sc in the end st, 3 sc up the other side, inc
Row 2: Inc, sc; change to green: sc, dc, 3 dc in next st (tw), dc, sc; change back to white: sc, 2 inc
Row 3: With green, starting from the 2nd green stitch: *ch 3, sc*, repeat along the leaf edge to the second-to-last green stitch on the other side — the ruffled leaf edge.

Body (head of the cabbage)
Rnd 1: With white, 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: Join the three leaves in as you go — take the middle 3 sts of each leaf, with the leaf's outer face turned inward: (3 sc through leaf + body, sc) 3 times (12)
Rnds 4-6: 12 sc
Rnds 7-10: Change to green, 12 sc
Rnd 11: BLO, dec 6 times (6). Do not cut.
Ruffle edging: continue working (ch 3, sc) into all the leftover front loops of Rnds 10 and 11 until used up — the curly cabbage top.
patterns.chineseText:
mini大白菜🥬 白菜叶*3 R1:白色6ch倒二勾4x,W,3x,V R2:V,X,换绿色X,t,3tw,t,x换白色x,2v R3:绿色,从绿色第二个针目开始勾(3ch,x)重复至对面倒数第二个绿色针目
主体 R1:白色环起6x R2:6v R3:同三片菜叶一起勾,菜叶取中间三个针目,菜叶对外那面朝里,3x,x,3x,x,3x,x R4-6:12x R7-10:换绿色12x R11:内半针6a 不断线继续在R10和R11的外半针勾花边(3ch,x)重复勾完
patterns.notes: Mini napa cabbage: three ruffle-edged leaves are crocheted into the body as you work Rnd 3, then chain-loop ruffles finish the top. 'tw'/'W' = 3 sts in one stitch.

meta.intro: A whole market haul in miniature — taco, popcorn-stitch pineapple, carrot, chili, banana, scallion, watermelon magnet, napa cabbage, plus a woven basket and a string mesh bag to carry them.

faq.question: Which piece should a beginner start with?
faq.answer: The chili or scallion — simple tubes with color changes; the pineapple's popcorn stitch and the basket's fold-over rim are the trickiest parts.

faq.question: How is the mesh bag made?
faq.answer: Pure chain loops: 8 ch-7 loops around a ring, then rounds of ch-9 loops slip-stitched into the middle of each loop below, plus chained straps.

faq.question: How does the watermelon stick to the fridge?
faq.answer: A magnet goes in with the stuffing before the flat green base is sewn on.

title: Web-Slinging Spider-Man
description:
谁能拒绝软乎乎的迷你蜘蛛侠！自带蛛网道具，氛围感直接拉满🕸️
线材：萌四
钩针：2.0mm
图解分享来自@果果🍒

**标签**: #手工的夏天 #蜘蛛侠钩织 #钩针挂件 #手工钩织 #钩针图解 #钩针玩偶 #手作好物
author: 织个小宇宙

patterns.englishText:
Web-Slinging Spider-Man — Mini Spidey with Spider Web

Stitch key from the chart: Ch = chain, SL = sl st, X = sc, V = inc, A = dec, T = hdc, F = dc, FLO = front loops only.

Head + Body (red)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: (Sc, inc, sc) 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: (3 sc, inc) 6 times (30)
Rnd 6: (2 sc, inc, 2 sc) 6 times (36)
Rnd 7: (5 sc, inc) 6 times (42)
Rnds 8-13: Sc around, no inc/dec (42)
Rnd 14: (5 sc, dec) 6 times (36)
Rnd 15: (2 sc, dec, 2 sc) 6 times (30)
Rnd 16: (3 sc, dec) 6 times (24)
Rnd 17: (Sc, dec, sc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 18: (Sc, dec) 6 times (12)
Rnd 19: FLO sc around (12) — neck ridge
Rnd 20: (Sc, inc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 21: (Sc, inc, sc) 6 times (24)
Rnd 22: (3 sc, inc) 6 times (30)
Rnds 23-25: Sc around (30)
Rnd 26: Change to blue, sc around (30)
Rnd 26b: (3 sc, dec) 6 times (24)
Rnd 27: (Sc, dec, sc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 28: (Sc, dec) 6 times (12)
Rnd 29: Dec 6 times, close and cut (6)

Spider Web
Rnd 1: 14 dc in MR (14)
Rnd 2: (1 dc, ch 3) 7 times
Rnd 3: (1 dc, ch 5) 7 times
Rnd 4: (1 dc, ch 7) 7 times
Rnd 5: (1 dc, ch 9) 7 times; fasten off

Web Strand: chain to the length you need.
End Balls (make 2): Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: (sc, inc) 3 times (9); Rnd 3: 9 sc; Rnd 4: (sc, dec) 3 times; leave tail to fasten the strand (thread the strand through hands/feet and the web BEFORE fixing the balls).

Arms: 6 sc around. Legs: 7 sc around. Rnds 1-4 red, Rnds 5-8 blue.

Eyes: with white, 5 sc in MR; turn, ch 1, 2 hdc in each st (5 hdc-inc); pull the ring tight; edge with one round of black sc.
patterns.chineseText:
吐丝蜘蛛侠 针法说明:Ch锁针,SL引拔,X短针,V短针加针,A短针减针,T中长针,F长针,Flo外半针
头+身体 红色 R1:环起6X R2:6V R3:(x,v)*6 R4:(x,v,x)*6 R5:(3x,v)*6 R6:(2x,v,2x)*6 R7:(5x,v)*6 R8-R13:不加不减42针 R14:(5x,a)*6 R15:(2x,a,2x)*6 R16:(3x,a)*6 R17:(x,a,x)*6 R18:(x,a)*6 R19:Flo(外半针)12x R20:(x,v)*6 R21:(x,v,x)*6 R22:(3x,)6 R23-R25:不加不减30针 R26:换蓝色不加不减30针 R26:(3x,a)*6 R27:(x,a,x)*6 R28:(x,a)*6 R29:6a收口断线
蜘蛛网 R1:14F R2:(1F,3ch)*7 R3:(1F,5ch)*7 R4:(1F,7ch)*7 R5:(1F,9ch)*7断线
蛛丝:所需长度辫子针 两头圆球 R1:6X R2:(x,v)*3 R3:9X R4:(x,a)*3留线固定珠丝(注意固定圆球前先穿过手脚和蛛网)
手:6x 腿:7x R1-R4:红色 R5-R8:蓝色

patterns.notes: Mini Spider-Man hanging from a crocheted web. Yarn: milk cotton 'Meng 4', 2.0mm hook. Diagram shared by @果果🍒. Note the chart lists two rounds labeled R26 (color change round, then decrease round) — follow them in order. Marvel character: consider IP implications before publishing.

meta.intro: A mini Spider-Man that hangs from his own crocheted web — red-and-blue suit, white spider-web disc and a silk strand with bead ends.
materials: Milk cotton 'Meng 4' in red, blue, white, black

faq.question: How is the web made?
faq.answer: 14 dc in a ring, then four rounds of (dc, ch-n) spokes with the chains growing from 3 to 9 — a quick lace disc.

faq.question: How does Spidey hang?
faq.answer: A chain strand runs through his hands/feet and the web, finished with two tiny 6-sc balls that lock the ends — thread it through before fixing the balls.

faq.question: Why does the pattern list R26 twice?
faq.answer: The original chart has a color-change round and a decrease round both labeled R26 — work them in order.

title: Pokopia Drifloon & Ditto
description:
图解已出啦！由于是翻译国外博主的，如果看到有错误，请礼貌指点哦！😘

**标签**: #钩针图解 #宝可梦 #飘飘球 #百变怪 #pokopia
author: EZOLC

patterns.englishText:
Pokopia Drifloon & Ditto — Part 1 (Drifloon; Ditto Body Start)

Drifloon (2.0mm hook + 4-ply milk cotton)
Body
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: (Sc, inc, sc) 6 times (24)
Rnds 5-8: Sc around (24)
Rnd 9: (Sc, dec, sc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 10: (Sc, dec) 6 times (12)
Rnd 11: BLO, dec 6 times (6)
Rnd 12: BLO, (ch 2, sl st) 6 times — the ruffled bottom edge

Mouth: ch 3, from 2nd ch: hdc, sl st; then (ch 2, from 2nd ch: sl st) 3 times. Work the blue sl sts into the positions of the red sl sts.
Hands: ch 3, from 2nd ch: hdc, sl st; ch 2, from 2nd ch: hdc, sl st. Blue sl sts worked into the red sl st positions.
Head Tuft (base): Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: (ch 2, 4 dc cluster, ch 2, sl st) 6 times.
Head Tuft (top): Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: 6 sc.

Ditto (1.5mm hook + milk cotton split to 2 strands)
Arm 1
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: (sc, inc) 3 times (9); Rnd 3: (sc, inc, sc) 3 times (12); Rnd 4: 3 dc, 6 sc, 3 dc; Rnd 5: 3 dc, 6 sc, 3 dc (24)
Arm 2
Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: dc-inc, sc, 2 inc, sc, dc-inc (10); Rnd 3: 2 dc-inc, sc, 2 dec, sc, 2 dc-inc (12)
Body piece 1: Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: (inc, sc, inc) twice (10)
Body piece 2: Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: (inc, sc, inc) twice (10); Rnd 3: (4 sc, inc) twice (12)
Do not cut — join with body piece 1:
Rnd 4: Inc, 9 sc, 2 inc, 9 sc, inc (26)
Rnd 5: Inc, 11 sc, 2 inc, 11 sc, inc (30)
Join Arm 1 and continue: Rnd 6: 26 sc, 2 inc, 14 sc (44); Rnd 7: 28 sc...
Join Arm 2 and continue: Rnd 7 (cont.): 5 sc, 2 inc, 21 sc (58)
Rnd 8: 4 sc, 2 dec, 25 sc, 2 dec, 21 sc (54)
Rnd 9: 54 sc
Rnd 10: 4 sc, dec, 25 sc, dec, 21 sc (52)
Rnds 11-12: 52 sc
Rnd 13: 4 sc, dec, 23 sc, dec, 21 sc (50)
Rnd 14: 50 sc
Rnd 15: 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 21 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 19 sc (54)
Rnd 16: 54 sc
Rnd 17: (4 sc, inc, 4 sc) 6 times (60)
Rnd 18: (9 sc, inc) 6 times (66)
Rnd 19: (5 sc, inc, 5 sc) 6 times (72)
Rnds 20-23: 72 sc
patterns.chineseText:

patterns.notes: Part 1 of 2. Translated from a Chinese translation of an international pattern (per the poster @EZOLC). Drifloon is the small balloon Pokémon; Ditto's blobby body joins two body pieces and both arms as it grows. Continues in Part 2 with the three-section closing. Pokémon IP — consider rights before publishing.

patterns.englishText:
Pokopia Drifloon & Ditto — Part 2 (Ditto Three-Lobe Closing)

After Rnd 23 (72 sts), divide the opening into three sections (A, B, C) and close each separately to create Ditto's blobby lobes:

Section A — sts 1-16 and 65-72 (24 sts):
Rnd 24A: 16 sc, skip the middle 48 sts, 8 sc (24)
Rnd 25A: (Sc, dec) 8 times (16)
Rnd 26A: Dec 8 times (8). Close.

Section B — sts 17-28 and 53-64 (24 sts):
Rnd 24B: 16 sc, skip 24, 8 sc (24)
Rnd 25B: (Sc, dec) 8 times (16)
Rnd 26B: Dec 8 times (8). Close.

Section C — sts 29-52 (24 sts):
Rnd 24C: 16 sc, skip 24, 8 sc (24)
Rnd 25C: (Sc, dec) 8 times (16)
Rnd 26C: Dec 8 times (8). Close.

Eye placement: Drifloon — between Rnds 5-6; Ditto — between Rnds 8-9.

patterns.notes: Part 2 of 2 for the Drifloon + Ditto set. Stuff each lobe before closing. 'Skip' rounds mean working only that section's stitches while leaving the others on hold for the next section.

meta.intro: Drifloon and Ditto from Pokémon Pokopia — a striped balloon ghost with a ruffled base, and a blobby Ditto whose arms and lobes are joined as you crochet.

faq.question: How does Ditto's blobby shape work?
faq.answer: Two body pieces and two arms are crocheted separately, then joined into one big round as you go; after Rnd 23 the 72-st opening is split into three sections (A/B/C) that each close separately into lobes.

faq.question: Where do the eyes go?
faq.answer: Drifloon between Rnds 5-6, Ditto between Rnds 8-9.

faq.question: Who made this pattern?
faq.answer: It's the poster's Chinese translation of an international pattern; check the original designer's terms before republishing.

（蛋糕卷起8个辫子针，然后重复钩长针或长长针到合适的长度卷起来就完成啦）

**标签**: #治愈系美食 #钩针小物 #钩针图解 #钩针日常 #小蛋糕 #毛线编织 #我的手工日常 #带上兴趣出门去 #可爱小物 #伦敦生活
author: lili_0330

patterns.englishText:
Raspberry Basque Cake — Mini Cheesecake Charm

Cake (light pink)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 5: BLO, 32 dc (32)
Rnds 6-7: *2 FPdc, 2 dc*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 8: Change to pale yellow; *2 FPdc, 2 dc*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 9: BLO, *2 sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 10: *Sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (16)
Rnd 11: Dec 8 times (8). Stuff and close.

Cream Swirl
Ch 11, from 2nd ch: 4 dc in each of the 10 ch; join ends into a ring — the ruffle sits on top.

Raspberry
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: (sc, inc) 3 times (9); Rnd 3-4: (sc, dec) 3 times (6). Stuff lightly, close.

Leaf: ch 3, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc.
patterns.chineseText:
树莓巴斯克(@Mowlica) 蛋糕 R1.浅粉色环起8x-8 R2.8v-16 R3.8*(x,v)-24 R4.8*(x,v,x)-32 R5.(内半针)32f R6-R7.8*(2外钩f,2f)-32 R8.换浅黄色8*(2外钩f,2f)-32 R9.(内半针)8*(2x,a)-24 R10.8*(x,a)-16 R11.8a
奶油 锁针起11ch,倒2钩10*(4f),首尾连接
树莓 R1.6x R2.3(x,v)-9 R4.3(x,a)-6
叶子 锁针起3ch,倒二sl,x
patterns.notes: Basque burnt cheesecake charm by @Mowlica. FPdc columns give the fluted cake sides. Assemble: cream ruffle on top, raspberry and leaf on the cream.

patterns.englishText:
Universal Mini Cupcake — Base Cake & Piped Cream Flower

Cake Body (change colors as you like)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 8 times (32)
Rnd 5: BLO, 32 dc
Rnds 6-8: *FPdc, dc*, repeat 16 times (32) — ribbed cake sides
Rnd 9: BLO, *2 sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (24)
Rnd 10: *Sc, dec*, repeat 8 times (16)
Rnd 11: Dec 8 times. Stuff, close.

Cream Base (dome)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnds 3-4: BLO, 12 sc
Rnd 5: BLO, dec 6 times (6)

Piped Cream Petals (worked into the front loops reserved on the cream dome)
Into the 1st st of Rnd 4 work 4 sc, into the 1st st of Rnd 3 work 4 dc, into the 1st st of Rnd 2 work 4 hdc — that completes the first petal; do not cut. Skip one stitch, then work back down: 4 hdc in the 3rd st of Rnd 2, 4 dc in the 3rd st of Rnd 3, 4 sc in the 3rd st of Rnd 4; skip one st, 4 sc in the 5th st of Rnd 4... continue zigzagging up and down around the dome until all front loops are used (see the arrow sketch in the chart).

Blueberry: 6 sc in MR, thread the tail through all 6 loops and cinch.
Leaf: ch 3, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc.
patterns.chineseText:
小蛋糕(@Maolika) 通用蛋糕体,根据个人喜好换线 R1.环起8x-8 R2.8v-16 R3.8*(x,v)-24 R4.8*(x,v,x)-32 R5.(内半针)32f R6-R8.16*(外钩f,f)-32 R9.(内半针)8*(2x,a)-24 R10.8*(x,a)-16 R11.8a
奶油主体 R1.圈起6x R2.6v-12 R3-R4.(内半针)12x R5.(内半针)6a
奶油花(入针位置都是奶油主体预留的外半针) R4的第一针钩4x,R3的第一针钩4t,R2的第一针钩4f(到这里第一瓣就钩好了,不断线继续钩织)空一针,R2的第三针钩4f,R3的第三针钩4t,R4的第三针钩4x,空一针,R4的第五针钩4x……以此类推钩完剩下的部分
小蓝莓 R1.6x,余线穿过6个线圈拉紧
叶子 锁针起3ch,倒二sl,x
patterns.notes: The universal cupcake base used by several of the little cakes in this post, by @Maolika. The cream flower is piped by working vertical petal columns (4f/4t/4x) into reserved front loops, zigzagging up and down — follow the red-arrow order sketch.

patterns.englishText:
Cream Pudding — Crème Caramel Charm with Cherry

Pudding (yellow)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: (Sc, inc, sc) 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: (3 sc, inc) 6 times (30)
Rnd 6: BLO, 30 dc
Rnds 7-8: (2 FPdc, dc) 10 times (30)
Rnd 9: (2 FPdc, dc-inc) 10 times (40)
Change to brown:
Rnds 10-11: (2 FPdc, 2 dc) 10 times (40)
Rnd 12: BLO, (dec, 2 sc) 10 times (30)
Rnd 13: (3 sc, dec) 6 times (24)
Rnd 14: (Sc, dec, sc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 15: (Sc, dec) 6 times (12). Stuff, close.

Cherry
Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: 6 inc (12); Rnd 3: 12 sc; Rnd 4: 6 dec. Close.

Cream Dollop
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2: BLO, 6 inc (12)
Rnd 3: BLO, 12 sc
Rnd 4: BLO, 6 dec (6)
Then work petals into the three rounds of reserved front loops: 2 dc in the 1st st of Rnd 2, 3 dc in the 2nd st of Rnd 3, 2 dc in the 3rd st of Rnd 4, 2 dc in the 4th st of Rnd 4, 3 dc in the 3rd st of Rnd 3, 2 dc in the 2nd st of Rnd 2, 2 dc in the 3rd st of Rnd 2... continue cycling up and down around the dome (see the order sketch).
patterns.chineseText:
奶油布丁(@毛利卡) (黄色线) 1.6X-6 2.6V-12 3.6(X,V)-18 4.6(X,V,X)-24 5.6(3X,V)-30 6.(内半针)30F 7-8.10(2外钩F,F)-30 9.10(2外钩F,FV)-40 (棕色线) 10-11.10(2外钩F,2F)-40 12.(内半针)10(A,2X)-30 13.6(3X,A)-24 14.6(X,A,X)-18 15.6(X,A)-12
樱桃 1.6X 2.6V 3.12X 4.6A
奶油 R1.6X R2.(内半针)6V R3.(内半针)12X R4.(内半针)6A 在3圈外半针上钩织:R2的第一针钩2F,R3的第二针钩3F,R4的第三针钩2F,R4的第4针钩2F,R3的第3针钩3F,R2的第2针钩2F,R2的第3针钩2F…如此循环
patterns.notes: Handwritten pudding pattern by @毛利卡. FPdc ridges form the pudding's fluted sides; the caramel top is the brown section. Stack: pudding, cream dollop, cherry on top.

patterns.englishText:
French Tart — Universal Tart Shell & Filling

Tart Shell
Rnd 1: 14 dc in MR (14)
Rnd 2: Dc-inc in each st around (28)
Rnd 3: *Dc, dc-inc*, repeat 14 times (42)
Rnd 4: BLO, 42 sc
Rnds 5-7: Sc in each st around (42)

Filling (cream color)
Rnd 1: 14 dc in MR (14)
Rnd 2: Dc-inc in each st around (28)
Rnd 3: *Dc, dc-inc*, repeat 14 times (42)
Rnd 4: BLO, 42 sc
Rnds 5-6: Sc in each st around (42)

Finish: fit the filling into the shell like a lid, add a little stuffing, and sew together with a single strand of the shell color.
patterns.chineseText:
法式挞 通用挞皮 R1:14F R2:14FV R3:14(F,FV) R4:内半针42X R5-7:42X
通用内馅 R1:14F R2:14FV R3:14(F,FV) R4:内半针42X R5-6:42X
将内馅和挞皮扣在一起,塞少量填充棉,用单股挞皮色的线缝合
patterns.notes: The base tart used for the fancy tarts in this set (by 三朵雲和毛线). The BLO round turns the crisp edge of the tart rim.

patterns.englishText:
Chestnut Tart & Lemon Cheese Tart — Toppings

Chestnut Tart cream (petal strips)
Strip 1: Ch 6, from 2nd ch: (sc, hdc), 4 dc-inc, (hdc, sc)
Strip 2: Ch 10, from 2nd ch: (sc, hdc), 4 dc-inc, (hdc, sc)
Repeat the second strip 10 more times — 12 strips total. Arrange and sew the ruffled strips onto the filling surface (Mont Blanc style).

Chestnut
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: 6 inc (12); Rnd 3: (sc, inc) 6 times (18); Rnd 4: dec 9 times (9). Stuff, close.

Lemon Cheese Tart cream (worked flat in rows)
Row 1: Ch 6, from 2nd ch: 5 sc
Row 2: BLO, 5 sc
Row 3: FLO, 5 sc
Repeat Rows 2-3 three times, then without cutting, ch 2 and work dc-inc into every unworked half-loop along the ridges — makes the wavy cream border.

Lemon Slice (flat)
Rnd 1: 6 dc in MR, do not join
Rnd 2: Dc-inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: (Dc, dc-inc) 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: Change color, (sc, sc-inc, sc) 6 times (24)
Embroider the segment lines with single-strand white.
patterns.chineseText:
栗子挞 奶油部分 起6ch,倒2回钩(X,T),4FV,(T,X) 10ch,倒2回钩(X,T),4FV,(T,X) 重复第二个步骤10次,共钩12片 然后整理一下缝合至内馅表面
栗子: R1:6X R2:6V R3:6(X,V) R4:9A
柠檬芝士挞 奶油部分(片钩) R1:6ch,倒2回钩5X R2:内半针5X R3:外半针5X 重复R2R3 3组后不断线起2ch 在每个没有钩的半针上钩FV
柠檬(片钩): R1:6F不引拔 R2:6FV R3:6(F,FV) R4:换色6(X,XV,X) 用白色单股线缝出纹路
patterns.notes: Two topping sets for the universal French tart base: a Mont Blanc chestnut tart (ruffle strips + chestnut) and a lemon cheese tart (ridged cream band + lemon slice).

patterns.englishText:
Fancy Tart — Joined Shell & Filling Variant

Tart Shell
Rnd 1: 14 dc in MR (14)
Rnd 2: Dc-inc in each st around (28)
Rnd 3: BLO, 28 dc
Rnd 4: *FPdc-inc, dc*, repeat 14 times

Filling
Rnd 1: 14 dc in MR (14)
Rnd 2: Dc-inc in each st around (28)
Rnd 3: *Hdc, hdc-inc*, repeat 14 times (42). Place wrong side up.

Joining: without cutting the shell yarn, crochet shell and filling together through the matching edge stitches: *2 FPdc, dc-inc*, repeat 14 times — for each dc-inc, pick up the two back loops of the filling edge separately. Stuff lightly along the way; don't overfill.
patterns.chineseText:
花式挞 通用挞皮 R1:14F R2:14FV R3:内半针28F R4:14(外钩FV,F)
通用内馅 R1:14F R2:14FV R3:14(T,TV) 反面朝上
挞皮不断线与内馅外圈针目对应钩织14(2外钩F,FV),(长针加针时分别挑内馅外半针两个针目),中途塞填充棉,不要塞得太满
patterns.notes: A fancier tart where the shell and filling are crocheted together with a post-stitch border instead of sewn. From the same tart series.

patterns.englishText:
Blueberry Tart — Whipped Cream Top & Blueberries

Cream Top
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *Sc, ch 3, skip 1*, repeat 8 times
Rnd 4: *Sc, ch 3, bobble of 8 unfinished dtr closed together, ch 3*, repeat 8 times — work each sc into the sc of Rnd 3 and each dtr-bobble into the ch-3 space of Rnd 3. The big bobbles are the cream puffs.

Blueberries (make 5)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2: (Sc, inc) 3 times (9)
Rnd 3: (Sc, dec) 3 times (6)
Close through the back loops; then run the tail in and out through each front loop 3 times to pull the berry into shape.
patterns.chineseText:
蓝莓味 奶油部分: R1:8X R2:8V R3:8(X,3ch,KI) R4:8(X,3ch,8个未完成长长针,3ch),短针在R3的短针处入针,长长针在R3的3ch上入针
蓝莓5个: R1:6X R2:3(X,V) R3:3(X,A) 挑内半针收口,每个外半针来回穿线3次
patterns.notes: Blueberry topping set for the tart base. The 8-dtr closed clusters make the piped-cream puffs; sew the five berries between them.

patterns.englishText:
Strawberry Tart — Triple Cream Band & Strawberry

Cream Band (three-layer ruffle)
Row 1: Ch 40
Row 2: 39 hdc worked into the back bumps starting from 2nd ch; do not cut
Row 3: 39 hdc into the front loops of Row 1; do not cut
Row 4: 39 hdc into the back loops of Row 1; fasten off — three ruffle layers share one foundation chain.

Strawberry Top (calyx)
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (10)
Rnd 3: *Ch 4, sl st, sc, hdc, hdc*, repeat 5 times — five leaf points

Strawberry
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2: (Sc, inc) 3 times (9)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc, sc) 3 times (12)
Rnd 4: (3 sc, inc) 3 times (15)
Rnd 5: (2 sc, inc, 2 sc) 3 times (18)
Rnd 6: (5 sc, inc) 3 times (21)
Rnd 7: (3 sc, inc, 3 sc) 3 times (24)
Rnd 8: (7 sc, inc) 3 times (27)
Rnds 9-10: 27 sc
Rnd 11: 13 dec, sc (14)
Rnd 12: 7 dec (7). Stuff, close.
Embroider the seeds with doubled white thread.
patterns.chineseText:
草莓味 奶油部分: R1:起40ch R2:倒2里山钩织39个T,不断线 R3:R1的外半针上钩39个T,不断线 R4:R1的内半针上钩39个T,断线
草莓蒂: R1:5X R2:5V R3:5(4ch,SL,X,T,T)
草莓: R1:6X R2:3(X,V) R3:3(X,V,X) R4:3(3X,V) R5:3(2X,V,2X) R6:3(5X,V) R7:3(3X,V,3X) R8:3(7X,V) R9-10:27X R11:13A,X R12:7A 用双股白色线缝出草莓籽
patterns.notes: Strawberry topping set: a three-layer hdc ruffle band (all worked off one foundation chain: back bump, then front loops, then back loops) plus a classic amigurumi strawberry with calyx.

meta.intro: A full patisserie tray of mini crocheted cakes — Basque cheesecake, cupcakes with piped cream, crème caramel, French tarts in four flavors and a strawberry shortcake band, with eight pattern pages covering every topping.
materials: White thread for seeds and details

faq.question: Do the cakes share a base?
faq.answer: Yes — most use the universal 8-st-start cake body with FPdc ribbed sides; toppings and colors change per flavor.

faq.question: How is the piped cream made?
faq.answer: Petal columns (4 sc / 4 dc / 4 hdc) are worked into reserved front loops of the cream dome, zigzagging up and down around it — the charts include an arrow sketch of the order.

faq.question: What's in the blueberry tart's puffs?
faq.answer: Bobbles of 8 unfinished dtr closed together, one per ch-3 space.

title: Raffia Mini Charms
description:
棉草线钩织的小挂件更适合用来搭配衣服项链
🧶@小毛团官方 棉草线
🎨荞麦2️⃣0️⃣

**标签**: #一起来钩织 #钩针小物 #钩针挂件 #拉菲草 #棉草线 #小草帽 #编织包 #龟背竹 #四叶草
author: 明天见

patterns.englishText:
Raffia Mini Charms — Woven Bag, Sun Hat & Four-Leaf Clover

Mini Woven Bag
Rnd 1: 14 dc in MR (14)
Rnd 2: 2 dc in each st (28)
Rnds 3-4: One round of jasmine stitch (puff-loop stitch) each
Rnd 5: Sc around
Rnd 6: Sc around; for the handle in the middle, work a double chain strand and attach both ends.

Sun Hat
Rnd 1: 12 sc in MR (12)
Rnd 2: Hdc-inc in each st (24)
Rnd 3: BLO, 24 sc
Rnds 4-5: 24 sc — the crown
Rnd 6: FLO, *dc, dc-inc*, repeat around — the brim
Rnd 7-8: finish with *sl st, ch* repeated around the brim edge.

Four-Leaf Clover
Rnd 1: In a ring: (ch 15, sl st) 4 times — four big loops
Rnd 2: Into each ch-15 loop work: 3 sc, 2 dc, 3 hdc, 3 sl st, hdc, dc, sc, dc, hdc, 3 sl st, 3 hdc, 2 dc, 3 sc — shapes each heart-shaped leaf
Rnd 3 (stem): ch 15, from 2nd ch: sc, 13 sl st.
patterns.chineseText:
编织包 R1:14F R2:28F R3-R4:一圈茉莉花针 R5:X R6:X,中间的提手是双辫子针
帽子 R1:12X R2:12TV R3:24X内半针 R4-5:24X R6:(F,FV)外半针 R8:(sl,ch)循环
四叶草 R1:环起4(15ch,sl) R2:在15ch的空隙处钩(3X,2T,3F,3E,F,T,X,T,F,3E,3F,2T,3X) R3:15ch,倒2回钩X,13sl
patterns.notes: Three small raffia/cotton-straw charms for necklaces or bag pendants. Stitch key: F=dc, T=hdc(as V pairs), E=sl st, X=sc; 茉莉花针 = jasmine/puff loop stitch. Yarn: 小毛团 cotton-straw, 2.5mm hook, color buckwheat 20.

patterns.englishText:
Micro-Crochet Monstera Leaf — Split-Leaf Charm

Worked in No. 80 white lace thread with a 0.5mm hook; dye to the shade you like after crocheting.

Ch 12 to start.
Step 1: From 2nd ch: sc, hdc, 2 sl st.
Step 2: 2 sc, then 4 elongated sl sts — pull up a long loop and sl st into the 3rd st of Step 1 (forms the first split); ch 1, then into the big loop work (2 dc, 3 sc).
Step 3: 2 sc, 5 elongated sl sts joining into the 3rd st inside the Step-2 loop; ch 1, into the big loop work (hdc, 3 dc, hdc, 3 sc).
Step 4: 2 sc, 6 elongated sl sts joining into the 5th st inside the Step-3 loop; ch 2, into the big loop work (5 dc, hdc, 3 sc).
Step 5: 2 sc, 6 elongated sl sts joining into the 5th st inside the Step-4 loop; ch 1, into the big loop work (hdc, 5 dc, hdc, 3 sc).
Step 6: (Sc, sl st, sc), 11 sc up the other side, ch 1, then from 2nd ch repeat Steps 1-5 to mirror the second half of the leaf.
Stem: chain to the desired length, sc back along the chain, weave in ends.
patterns.chineseText: 龟背竹钩针图解 微钩用80号白色蕾丝线,可乐钩0.5mm,染色至喜欢效果即可 起12ch ①倒2,X,T,2SL ②2X,4SL拉长线圈引拔至①的第3个针目,ch,在大圈内钩(2T,3X) ③2X,5SL拉长线圈引拔至②大圈内的第3个针目,ch,在大圈内钩(T,3F,T,3X) ④2X,6SL拉长线圈引拔至③大圈内的第5个针目,2ch,在大圈内钩(5F,T,3X) ⑤2X,6SL拉长线圈引拔至④大圈内的第5个针目,ch,在大圈内钩(T,5F,T,3X) ⑥(X,SL,X),11X,ch,倒2重复①~⑤步骤,最后叶柄钩辫子针至合适长度回钩短针藏线即可
patterns.notes: Micro-crochet split-leaf monstera charm. The elongated slip-stitch loops form the characteristic leaf splits; each 'big loop' section fills one lobe. Dye after finishing for an ombre effect.

meta.intro: Cotton-straw mini charms for necklaces: a jasmine-stitch woven bag, a brimmed sun hat, a four-leaf clover and a micro-crochet monstera leaf.
materials: No.80 lace thread + 0.5mm hook for the monstera

faq.question: What is jasmine stitch?
faq.answer: A puff-loop stitch used for two rounds of the mini bag — it gives the woven basket texture.

faq.question: How are the monstera's splits made?
faq.answer: Elongated slip-stitch loops that anchor back into earlier stitches create each split; the lobes are then filled with graded dc/hdc groups.

faq.question: Why dye after crocheting?
faq.answer: The micro leaf is worked in white lace thread and dyed afterwards so the color gradient sits exactly where you want.

patterns.englishText:
Long Dachshund Dog — Sausage Dog in a Striped Sweater

Body (brown)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: (Sc, inc) 3 times (9)
Rnds 3-12: 9 sc around
Change to blue: Rnds 13-14: 9 sc
Change to white: Rnds 15-16: 9 sc
Continue alternating 2 rounds blue / 2 rounds white through Rnd 40 (the sweater)
Rnds 41-48: 9 sc (back to brown)
Leave a long tail, close and sew.

Head
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: (Sc, inc) 6 times (18)
Rnds 4-6: 18 sc
Rnd 7: 4 dec, 10 sc (14)
Rnd 8: 2 dec, 10 sc (12)
Change to color #35 (light snout color):
Rnd 9: Dec, 9 sc (11)
Rnd 10: Dec, 8 sc (10)
Rnd 11: Dec, 7 sc (9)
Rnd 12: Dec, 6 sc (8). Fasten off, hide tail.

Snout Patch (brown, worked in rows)
Row 1: Ch 4
Row 2: From 2nd ch: 3 sc, ch 1, turn
Row 3: 3 sc, ch 1, turn
Row 4: 3 sc, turn
Row 5: 2 sc, ch 1, turn
Row 6: 2 sc, turn
Row 7: Sc, ch 1, turn
Row 8: Sc; leave a long tail and sew onto the nose.

Ears (make 2)
Row 1: Ch 9
Row 2: From 2nd ch: 4 sc, dc, 2 tr(f=hdc? see note), working 3 sts into the last ch
Row 3: Continue down the other side: 2 hdc, dc, 3 sc, sl st. Leave tail, sew to both sides of the head.

Legs (make 4)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnds 2-4: 6 sc, sl st. Leave tail, sew to the front and back of the body.

Tail
Row 1: Ch 6
Row 2: From 2nd ch: 2 sc, dc, hdc, sl st. Leave tail, sew in place.

Lying-Down Tigger — Winnie the Pooh Tiger Mini Plush

Head

Rnds 6-7: Sc in each st around (18)

Rnd 4: 6 sc, 2 inc, 6 sc (16)

title: Cat Face Medallion
description:
g点位置环形起针，沿黑色画线方向钩

**标签**: #钩针图解 #针织手作 #一起来钩织 #图解 #织女 #钩针 #钩织的乐趣 #编织图解 #钩针教程 #图解分享
author: 童话萌窝编织坊

patterns.englishText:
Cat Face Medallion — Symbol Chart (Base Piece)

This is a flat cat-head medallion worked in one continuous spiral from the center out.

Construction from the chart:
Start: MR at the marked center point (g); ch 1 and begin the spiral.
Rnd 1: Work sc into the ring; the short chain arm to the right of the center (the row of ch ovals) sets up the muzzle offset.
Spiral rounds: continue around following the guideline, increasing as for a flat circle (inc spaced evenly each round). Stitch heights vary by area exactly as charted: sc near the center, hdc/dc through the mid rounds, and tr (the tallest bars) across the lower cheeks and chin to widen the face; return to shorter stitches at the sides so the piece stays flat and round.
Color: the face center is worked in yellow, shifting to orange for the outer rounds (the tabby outer coat).
Ears: worked at the two upper corners — rows of sc with an inc at the outer edge and x-marked decs toward the inner edge, finishing with a sl st and a dot (fasten off) at each ear tip; the small yellow oval clusters inside the ears are the ch turning sts of the short ear rows.

Use the chart image for exact stitch placement — every bar is one stitch, dashes mark dc (1 dash) vs tr (2 dashes), V = inc, X = sc.
patterns.chineseText: （手绘符号图）猫头片钩织图解：g点位置环形起针，沿螺旋方向一圈圈往外钩；中心为锁针+短针，向外过渡为中长针/长针/长长针（图中以针脚长短表示），底部脸颊和下巴用较长针目加宽；两只耳朵在头顶两侧，用短针配合加减针塑形，耳尖引拔收针。橙色为外圈毛色，黄色为脸部中心色。
patterns.notes: Hand-drawn spiral chart by @烤个地瓜, who notes: start the MR at point g and crochet following the black guideline direction. Companion images show the spiral direction overlay and the finished face placement. Best used together with the displayed chart.

patterns.englishText:
Cat Face Medallion — Spiral Direction Overlay

Same cat-head chart as the base piece, with the working direction drawn on top.

How to read it:
The heavy black line is your path: begin with the MR at the center (marked point), sc into the ring, then crochet continuously outward in a counter-clockwise spiral — do not join rounds; just keep following the line to the outer edge.
The short straight black segment at the center-right is the initial ch arm for the muzzle offset; work back along it in sc before starting the spiral.
The blue dots mark where each ear begins and ends: when the spiral reaches an upper corner, work the short sc rows of the ear (inc at the outer edge, dec toward the center, per the base chart), sl st back onto the head edge at the second blue dot, then continue the spiral.
Stitch heights along the spiral are those of the base chart: sc at the center, hdc/dc mid-way, tr across the chin/cheek area, orange outer rounds over a yellow center.
patterns.chineseText: （手绘符号图-带方向线）同一猫头片图解，叠加黑色螺旋线标明钩织行进方向：从中心g点起针，逆时针螺旋向外，一直钩到外缘；蓝色点标记耳朵的起针/结束位置。
patterns.notes: Direction-overlay version of the cat medallion chart — the black spiral shows the continuous working path, blue dots mark ear start/stop points. Display together with the base chart.

patterns.englishText:
Cat Face Medallion — Face Placement Guide

Same spiral cat-head chart with the finished face marked in place:
Eyes: two round black beads (or safety eyes) placed just above the center ring, roughly 4 sts apart — one on each side of the yellow center.
Nose/mouth: a black X embroidered directly below the center of the magic ring.
Whiskers: three straight black strands on each cheek, anchored near the eye line and fanning outward past the medallion edge.
Work the medallion exactly as in the base chart (spiral from MR, sc center graduating to dc/tr at the chin, orange outer rounds), then add the features last.
patterns.chineseText: （手绘符号图-带五官）同一猫头片图解的成品示意：标出眼睛（两颗黑色圆珠，位于中心圈上方两侧）、鼻子/嘴（中心下方黑色X形刺绣）和胡须（两颊各三根黑线）的位置。
patterns.notes: Feature-placement version of the cat medallion chart. Attach eyes before closing if using safety eyes; whiskers are simply threaded and trimmed.

meta.intro: A flat cat-face medallion crocheted in one continuous spiral from a hand-drawn chart — mixed stitch heights sculpt the cheeks and chin, and the ears grow right off the edge.

faq.question: How do I follow the spiral chart?
faq.answer: Start the magic ring at the marked g point and crochet outward along the black guideline without joining rounds; the overlay image shows the exact path and the blue dots mark where each ear starts and ends.

faq.question: Why do the stitch heights change?
faq.answer: Taller stitches (dc/tr) at the chin and cheeks widen the face into a cat silhouette while the piece stays flat.

patterns.englishText:
Pill Pouch Charm — Base Pouch (Front & Back Panels)

Front Panel (with opening)
Row 1: Ch 8, starting from 2nd ch: inc, 5 sc, inc (9)
Row 2: Inc, 7 sc, inc (11)
Rows 3-4: 11 sc
Row 5: Inc, 9 sc, inc (13)
Row 6: 13 sc
Row 7: Inc, 11 sc, inc (15)
Row 8: 15 sc
Rows 9-11: 4 sc only (do not cut yarn); rejoin yarn on the other side and work two rows of 4 sc there, cut — this creates the slit opening
Row 11 (cont.): continuing with the live yarn, ch 7 across the gap, 4 sc (bridges the opening)
Row 12: 15 sc
Row 13: Dec, 11 sc, dec (13)
Row 14: Dec, 9 sc, dec (11)
Edging: sc all the way around the panel; when you reach the middle 7 sts of Row 1 at the top of the head, work: sc, 2 tr, tr-inc, 2 tr, sc (this shapes the character's head bump).

Back Panel: same chart, but Rows 9-11 are plain 15 sc (no slit).
Make both panels, then sl st them together around the edge, leaving the marked opening. Optionally add a snap button.

patterns.englishText:
Pill Pouch Charm — Character Variations (Ears, Faces & Details)

All characters use the same base pouch; work these details onto the top edge / panels.

Top fin: (ch 1, dc), (dc, sc), dc-inc, (dc, ch 1, sl st)

Pompompurin (colors 16, 26)
Ears 6 sts apart. Left ear: sl st, sc, dc, 2 hdc, (2 hdc, ch 2, sl st); work the right ear mirrored.
Beret: ch 7, from 2nd ch: inc, 2 sc, ch-2 sl st picot, 2 sc, 3 sc in next st, 5 sc
Paws: ch 4, from 3rd ch: dc, sc.

Siamese Cat (color 19)
Ears 4 sts apart: sl st, sc, (dc, hdc, dc), sc, sl st
Paws: ch 4, from 3rd ch: dc, sc.

Muzzle, white: ch 5, from 2nd ch: 3 sc, 3 sc in next st, 2 dc, inc
Nose, red (2 strands, 1.4mm): (sc, 2 dc, 2 sc, 2 dc, sc)
Eyebrows: ch 3, from 2nd ch: 2 sl st.

Alien / Three-Eyed Monster (color 48; 3mm eyes)

Left ear: (ch 3, from 2nd ch: sc, dc, hdc), (hdc, ch 2, sl st)
Right ear: (ch 2, hdc), (hdc, ch 3 from 2nd ch: sc, dc, sl st)
Antenna (top of head): ch 4, from 3rd ch: dc, sc
Eyes: 6 sc in MR. Paws: ch 4, from 3rd ch: dc, sc.

faq.question: How does the pill get in?

faq.question: Are both panels the same?

description:

author: 小满家钩织

patterns.englishText:
Octopus Charm — Curly-Tentacle Amigurumi Octopus

Body
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnds 5-6: Sc in each st around (24)
Rnd 7: *4 sc, dec*, repeat 4 times (20)
Rnds 8-9: Sc in each st around (20)
Rnd 10: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 4 times (16)
Rnd 11: Sc in each st around (16)
Rnd 12: *2 sc, dec*, repeat 4 times (12)
Rnd 13: *4 sc, dec*, repeat twice (10)

Tentacles (worked in front loops only around the opening)
*Sl st, ch 10, then working back along the chain: 7 sc, 2 inc*, repeat 8 times; sl st into the one remaining stitch at the end.
Stuff lightly, then thread the long tail through the remaining back loops and cinch closed, sewing shut.

Eyes (make 2)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR.

须须 (SL.10CH.7X.2V)*8(外半针) 最后还剩一针直接引拔 留长线内半针收口缝合

patterns.notes: Yarn: Susu 4-ply combed cotton, Clover 2.3mm hook, colors 45/06. The chain-back tentacles curl naturally; the 2 inc at each chain end adds the curl. Diagram credited to @晴天手作家.

meta.intro: A squishy little octopus with eight naturally-curling tentacles, made from chain-back strips worked into the body's front loops.

faq.question: How do the tentacles curl?
faq.answer: Each is a ch-10 worked back with 7 sc and 2 inc — the increases at the end make the strip spiral on its own.

faq.question: Where are the tentacles attached?
faq.answer: They're crocheted directly into the front loops around the body opening; the back loops are then cinched closed.

description:

patterns.englishText:
Raffia Mushroom Charm — Cap

Mushroom Cap (brown raffia with cream speckles)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: Sc in each st around (18)
Rnd 5: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 6: Sc in each st around (24)

Switch to the cream yarn at random stitches for the speckled shiitake look (or carry the cream yarn and work scattered contrast stitches).

patterns.notes: Cap of the little mushroom charm from the summer raffia charm set; the stem is in the companion diagram, sew cap and stem together at the end. Original pattern by @hhhhhhht.

patterns.englishText:
Raffia Mushroom Charm — Stem

Mushroom Stem (cream raffia)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: *Sc, inc*, repeat 3 times (9)
Rnd 3: Sc in each st around (9)
Rnd 4: *Sc, dec*, repeat 3 times (6)
Rnd 5: Sc in each st around (6)
Rnd 6: Sc in each st around (6)
Rnd 7: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 8: Hdc-inc in each st around (24) — this flares out to form the gills under the cap

Finish: sew the cap and stem together.
patterns.chineseText: 蘑菇柄 R1:6X R2:3(XV)共9针 R3:9X R4:3(Xa)共6针 R5:6X R6:6X R7:6V共12针 R8:12FV共24针 最后缝合盖和柄
patterns.notes: Stem + gill flare for the raffia mushroom. 'FV' = 2 hdc in each stitch. Sew to the cap from the companion diagram; add a cord loop to hang.

meta.intro: Summer raffia charms: a pinwheel-jasmine earphone pouch and a speckled shiitake mushroom — light, structured pendants for bags and keys.
materials: Raffia / cotton-straw yarn in brown and cream

faq.question: How is the mushroom gill flare made?
faq.answer: The stem tube increases to 12, then works 2 hdc into every stitch (24) — the sudden flare becomes the underside of the cap, which is sewn to the cap piece.

faq.question: Is raffia hard to crochet?
faq.answer: Keep tension moderate and use a slightly larger hook than for cotton; raffia holds shape well, which is why the mushroom needs no stiffener.

patterns.englishText:
Haaland Duck — Footballer Rubber Duck (Linlee-style)

Body (chick yellow + true red)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times, in BLO (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times, in BLO (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 6-9: Sc in each st around (30)
Rnd 10: *9 sc, inc*, repeat 3 times (33)
Rnd 11: *5 sc, inc, 5 sc*, repeat 3 times (36)
Rnd 12: 15 sc, 6 sc, 15 sc (36) — highlighted middle sts mark the face color area
Rnd 13: 17 sc, 2 sc, 17 sc (36)
Rnd 14: *5 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (42)
Rnd 15: *3 sc, inc, 3 sc*, repeat 6 times (48)
Rnds 16-17: Sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 18: *3 sc, dec, 3 sc*, repeat 6 times (42)
Rnd 19: *5 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (36)
Rnd 20: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 21: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 22: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 23: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Close by threading through the front loop of every other stitch.
Hair: work ch loops into the reserved front loops of Rnds 3-4 (3-4 rounds) for the blond hair.

Arms (make 2, red)
Left: Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: (sc, inc) 3 times (9); Rnd 3: inc, 2 sc, inc, sc, (sc, dc, ch-1 picot, sc), inc, 2 sc
Right: Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: (sc, inc) 3 times (9); Rnd 3: inc, 2 sc, inc, sc, (sc, ch-1 picot, dc, sc), inc, 2 sc — mirrored

Shirt Stripes (make 2, black or navy)
Horizontal stripe: ch 15, from 2nd ch: 14 sc
Vertical stripe: ch 9, from 2nd ch: 8 sc
Glue white yarn along the edges for the trim.

Beak (orange)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: 3 sc, dc, hdc, dc, 3 sc, dc, hdc, dc

faq.question: How is the blond hair made?

faq.question: What are the arm picots?

Rnd 4: Sc in each st around (18)

Rnds 6-7: Sc in each st around (24)
Rnd 8: Fasten off the first lobe; make a second lobe the same way (don't fasten off). Join: work one stitch through both lobes to merge, then sc around the remaining sts of both lobes (46)
Rnds 9-11: Sc in each st around (46)
Rnd 12: Dec once at each side (44)
Rnd 13: Sc around (44)
Rnd 14: Dec once at each side (42)
Rnd 15: *5 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (36)
Rnd 16: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 17: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 18: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 19: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 20: Dec 6 times (6). Stuff, close.

Legs (make 2)
Rnd 1: Ch 5, from 2nd ch: 3 sc, 3 sc in next st, 3 sc (working around the chain, 9)
Rnd 2: 3 sc, 3 inc, 3 sc (12)
Rnd 3: 3 sc, 3 hdc-dec, 3 sc (9)
Rnd 4: Sc, dc-dec, 2 hdc-dec, dc-dec, sc (6)

Row 1: Ch 16, from 2nd ch: inc, sc, 2 dc, 9 hdc, dc, 3 sts in next st, then down the other side: dc, 9 hdc, 2 dc, sc, inc, sl st
Row 2: Inc, 2 sc, tr-inc, 8 tr, tr-inc, 2 sc, 3 inc, 2 sc, tr-inc, 8 tr, tr-inc, 2 sc, inc

Feet (make 2)
Rnd 1: Ch 6, from 2nd ch: 4 sc, 3 sc in next st, 3 sc, inc (working around the chain)
Rnd 2: Inc, 3 sc, 3 inc, 3 sc, 2 inc
Rnd 3: Sc, inc, 3 sc, (sc, inc) 3 times, 3 sc, (sc, inc) twice (24)
Rnds 4-5: Sc around (24)
Rnd 6: 5 sc, 3 bobbles, 7 sc — the bobbles form the toes
Rnd 7: 4 sc, 2 bobbles, 6 sc
Rnd 8: 3 sc, 2 dec, 5 sc
Rnd 9: 4 sc, dec, 4 sc
Rnds 10-17: 9 sc around
Rnd 18: Sc, dec, 3 sc, dec, sc (7)
Rnd 19: Sc around (7)
patterns.notes: 'M' in the foot rounds = bobble stitch (toe bumps); 'w' = 3 sts in one stitch; 'TV' = 2 tr in one st. Sew leaves to the stem and legs to the base; embroider the smile.

patterns.englishText:
Chubby Eggplant — Fat Aubergine Plush

Body
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: Sc around (24)
Rnd 6: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 7-8: Sc around (30) — the eyes sit around here
Rnd 9: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (36)
Rnd 10: Sc around (36)
Rnd 11: (3 sc, inc) twice, (sc, inc) 10 times, (3 sc, inc) twice (50)
Rnd 12: 10 sc, (sc, inc, sc) 10 times, 10 sc (60)
Rnds 13-17: Sc around (60)
Rnd 18: *4 sc, dec, 4 sc*, repeat 6 times (54)
Rnd 19: Sc around (54)
Rnd 20: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 9 times (45)
Rnd 21: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 9 times (36)
Rnd 22: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 9 times (27)
Rnd 23: *Sc, dec*, repeat 9 times (18)
Rnd 24: Dec 9 times (9)
Rnd 25: (Sc, dec) 3 times; fasten off and hide the tail (6)

Leaf Cap & Stem (green)
Rnds 1-5: 5 sc around (a small tube — the stem)
Rnd 6: FLO inc in each of the 5 sts (10) — see the small chart
Rnd 7: *[Ch 4, dtr-bobble in same st, ch 4, sl st into the next st], sl st*, repeat 5 times — makes the five pointed sepal leaves.

Wings (arms, make 2)
Ch 5, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc, dc, hdc; fasten off. Sew to the sides around Rnds 9-12.
patterns.notes: IMPORTANT: designer 浅浅茉 forbids modification, re-publishing and commercial resale of this chart (禁止二改/公开/倒卖商用) — check rights before publishing. Stitch key from the chart: X=sc, V=inc, A=dec, CH=chain, SL=sl st, T=hdc(as keyed), 长长针枣形针=dtr bobble.

meta.intro: A whole shelf of Jellycat-style Amuseables: croissant, heart with legs, birthday-cake trinket box, pretzel, lemon and a chubby eggplant — six plush food friends with smiley faces.

faq.question: Which piece is the easiest to start with?
faq.answer: The heart — two simple lobes joined into one body, plus two small leg tubes.

faq.question: How does the pretzel get its shape?
faq.answer: It's one ~100-round skinny tube, thicker in the middle; you twist it into the knot and sew the crossings.

faq.question: Is the birthday cake really a box?
faq.answer: Yes — BLO rounds fold the fabric into a lidded box shape, with a dc round in leftover loops forming the cream ruffle.

faq.question: Note on the eggplant
faq.answer: The eggplant chart's designer forbids modification, re-publishing and resale — personal use only.

title: All-Is-Well Lucky Duck

Head

Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 6-9: Sc in each st around (30)
Rnd 10: 10 sc, 3 inc, 4 sc, 3 inc, 10 sc (36)
Rnds 11-13: Sc in each st around (36)
Rnd 14: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnd 15: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 16: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 17: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 18: Dec 6 times (6). FO.

Body
Rnd 1: 7 sc in MR (7)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (14)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 7 times (21)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 7 times (28)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 7 times (35)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc*, repeat 7 times (42)
Rnd 7: *5 sc, inc*, repeat 7 times (49)
Rnd 8: 21 sc, 7 inc, 21 sc (56)
Rnds 9-12: Sc in each st around (56)
Rnd 13: 17 sc, *sc, dec* 7 times, 18 sc (49)
Rnd 14: *5 sc, dec*, repeat 7 times (42)
Rnd 15: 14 sc, 7 dec, 14 sc (35)
Rnd 16: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 7 times (28)
Rnd 17: 3 sc, *sc, dec* 7 times, 4 sc (21)
Rnd 18: *Sc, dec*, repeat 7 times (14)
Rnd 19: Dec 7 times (7). FO.

Beak
Rnd 1: Ch 3, starting from 2nd ch from hook work 4 sc around the chain (4)
Rnd 2: (Sc, inc) twice (6)
Rnd 3: 3 sc, 3 inc (9)

Eyes (make 2)
6 sc in MR.

Wings (make 2)
Row 1: Ch 6, starting from 2nd ch: 3 sc, tr, 6 tr, tr, 2 sc, inc (working around the chain)
Row 2: 4 sc, 6 sc, 5 sc, one ch-2 picot.

Flag
Ch 6, starting from 2nd ch: 5 sc; work 13 rows of sc. Then sc a border all the way around the flag, crocheting over a piece of shaping wire along one edge (this becomes the flag pole edge).
patterns.notes: Chinese New Year style 'All Is Well' lucky duck sitting on a gourd-shaped body, holding a red flag. Assemble: sew head to body, attach beak, eyes, wings; mount flag on shaping wire.

meta.intro: A cheerful red 'all is well' lucky duck perched on a gourd-shaped body, holding a tiny crocheted flag — a Chinese New Year good-luck charm for bags or shelves.

faq.question: How is the flag kept upright?
faq.answer: The flag border is crocheted over a piece of shaping wire along one edge, so the pole edge stays stiff and can be bent into position.

faq.question: What are the duck's proportions?
faq.answer: The head starts from a 6-st ring and peaks at 36 sts; the gourd body starts from a 7-st ring and reaches 56 sts around, giving the bottom-heavy gourd look.

patterns.englishText:
Office-Worker Fish — Eyes, Fins, Belt, Briefcase & Mouth

Eyes (make 2, 1.8mm, cream; wrong side facing out)

Row 2: Inc, 3 sc, inc

Ch a length that fits around the body, join into a ring; Rnd 2: sc around.

Ch 3, starting from 2nd ch work 2 sc around the chain.

Ch 24, starting from 2nd ch: sl st, sc, 3 tr, 4 hdc, 5 sl st, 4 hdc, 3 tr, sc, sl st.

Row 1: Ch 18, sc back across (17)
Rows 2-11: 17 sc

Mouth (1.8mm, milk tea)
Ch 30, join into a ring; glue on with the wrong side facing out.

Eyebrows: cut from black felt and glue on.

faq.question: How do the legs stand?

Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (30)
Rnd 6: FLO sc around, no inc/dec; cut yarn (30)

Lettuce
Rnd 1: 15 tr in MR
Rnd 2: Sc inc in each st
Rnd 3: *Ch 3, sk 1, sl st*, repeat around (ruffled edge)

Patty and Tomato (same steps)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* around (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc* around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* around (30)

Cheese
Row 1: Ch 6, from 2nd ch: 5 sc, ch 1
Rows 2-5: Turn, 5 sc, ch 1
Rnd 6: Sc all the way around the square, 3 sc in each of the four corners

Pochacco (head)
Rnd 1: Ch 15, sl st to first ch to join into a ring
Rnd 2: 15 sc
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* 7 times, sc (22)
Rnd 4: Sc around, no inc/dec
Rnd 5: *Sc, inc, sc* 7 times, sc (29)
Rnds 6-7: Sc around
Rnd 8: *Sc, dec* around
Rnd 9: Sc around
Rnd 10: *Sc, dec* around; leave a long tail for sewing

Ears
Rnds 1-2: 6 sc around
Rnd 3: 3 sc, sl st

Feet: 6 sc in MR.

title: Stardew Valley Mini Chicken
description:
图解感谢🌷：@我要飞走了
鸡冠：锁针起5ch 倒二(x,f),(f,x),(sl,x,f),x
嘴巴：环起x,ch,x 拉紧

四股唯棉 51/08
🪡：3.0/2.0

author: 毛利卡

patterns.englishText:
Stardew Valley Mini Chicken — Fluffy Amigurumi Chicken

Yarn: fluffy/chenille yarn (less than 1 skein) + 4-ply milk cotton in red, brown, pale yellow, chick yellow. Hooks: 2.0mm (cotton), 5.0mm (fluffy yarn).
Note: this pattern is worked in joined rounds — each round starts with ch 1 and ends with a sl st.

Body
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in MR, sl st (6)
Rnd 2: Ch 1, inc in each st, sl st (12)
Rnd 3: Ch 1, 12 sc, sl st (12)
Rnd 4: Ch 1, inc, 10 sc, inc, sl st (14)
Rnd 5: Ch 1, inc, 12 sc, inc, sl st (16)
Rnd 6: Ch 6, starting from 2nd ch: 5 sc back along the chain, 16 sc, 5 sc along the other side of the chain, sl st (26)
Rnd 7: Ch 1, 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, 6 sc, (sc, inc) twice, 6 sc, 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, sl st (30)
Rnds 8-9: Ch 1, 30 sc, sl st (30)
Rnd 10: Ch 1, 5 sc, inc, 2 sc, (sc, inc) twice, 6 sc, (sc, inc) twice, 2 sc, 5 sc, inc, sl st (36)
Rnd 11: Ch 1, 36 sc, sl st (36)
Rnd 12: Ch 1, *4 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times, sl st (30)
Rnd 13: Ch 1, *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times, sl st (24)
Rnd 14: Ch 1, *2 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times, sl st (18). Stuff.
Rnd 15: Ch 1, *sc, dec*, repeat 6 times, sl st (12). Close up.

Wings (make 2)
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in MR, sl st (6)
Rnd 2: Ch 1, *sc, 3 sc in next st*, repeat 3 times, sl st (12)

Tail
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in MR, sl st (6)
Rnd 2: Ch 1, inc, 5 sc, sl st (7)
Rnd 3: Ch 1, 7 sc, sl st (7)

Comb (red)
Row 1: Ch 7, starting from 2nd ch: 6 sc
Row 2: Turn, ch 1, [sc, hdc], [hdc, sc], [sl st, sc, hdc], [hdc, sc], [sl st, sc, hdc], [hdc, sc] — forms the zigzag comb

Eyes
Row 1: Ch 4, starting from 2nd ch: 3 sl st

Feet (yellow)
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in MR, sl st
Rnd 2: Ch 1, [sc, hdc, sc], then [sl st, sc, hdc, sc] twice — forms three toes

Beak
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in MR, sl st (6)
Rnd 2: Ch 1, (sc, inc) 3 times, sl st (9)
Rnd 3: Ch 1, 9 sc, sl st (9)

Wattle (under beak)
Row 1: Ch 6, starting from 2nd ch: 4 sc, 3 sc in next st, 4 sc along the other side

meta.intro: The fluffy little chicken from Stardew Valley, crocheted in plush yarn with cotton details — comb, wattle, beak, wings and tiny feet all included.
materials: 4-ply milk cotton in red, brown, pale yellow, chick yellow

faq.question: Why are there two hook sizes?
faq.answer: The body uses thick fluffy yarn with a 5.0mm hook; the comb, beak, feet and eyes use fine cotton with a 2.0mm hook.

faq.question: This pattern uses joined rounds — why?
faq.answer: Each round starts with ch 1 and closes with a sl st, which keeps the color and shaping columns straight on the fluffy fabric.

title: Junimo
description:
感谢老师图解🥺@毛利卡

叶子部分有一点点改动：
（2股线）5ch，倒2钩x，2t，sl

**标签**: #星露谷物语 #祝尼魔 #钩织小物 #钩织挂件
author: Nonsense_

patterns.englishText:
Junimo — Stardew Valley Apple Spirit Charm

Body
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnds 4-7: Sc in each st around (18)
Rnd 8: Dec 9 times (9)
Working in front loops only, draw the opening tight to close. Leave a long tail, thread it through top and bottom of the ball and pull to create the apple-like dimple.

Leaf (use 2 strands of yarn)
Ch 5, then starting from 2nd ch from hook: sc, 2 dc, 3 dc in next st, 2 dc, sc (working around to the other side of the chain).
patterns.chineseText:
祝尼魔钩织
主体 R1.6x R2.6v R3.6(x,v) R4-R7.18x R8.9a 挑外半针拉紧收口 留长线穿过两头拉出凹陷
叶子(2股线) 锁针起5ch，倒二，x，2t，w，2t，x
patterns.notes: Tiny green Junimo from Stardew Valley. The poster modified the leaf slightly from the original: (2-strand yarn) ch 5, sc from 2nd ch, 2 dc, sl st. 'w' = 3 sts in one stitch. Cinch top to bottom for the dented apple shape, then sew leaf on top and embroider the face.

meta.intro: A tiny green Junimo from Stardew Valley — a dimpled apple-spirit ball with a single leaf, done in under an hour.
materials: Green yarn (2 strands for the leaf)

faq.question: How do you get the apple dimple?
faq.answer: After closing through the front loops, thread the long tail straight through the ball top to bottom and pull until the top dents in.

faq.question: Is the leaf hard?
faq.answer: No — it's a single ch-5 worked back with sc and dc on both sides; the poster's simplified version is ch 5, sc, 2 dc, sl st.

title: Badminton Shuttlecock Charm
description:
（正文即标签）

**标签**: #手工钩织 #羽毛球挂件 #钩针挂件 #钩针小物 #羽毛球钩织挂件 #钩针图解
author: 榴莲

patterns.englishText:
Badminton Shuttlecock Charm — Cork Base & Feather Mesh

Cork Base (head)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnds 5-7: Sc in each st around (24)
Rnd 8: Change color, 24 sc, FO (24)

Feather Section
First repeat Rnds 1-4 above (another small cup, 24 sts).
Rnd 5: Change to white and work in BLO, then follow the chart rows below. FO and sew the two cups together.

Feather mesh (from the symbol chart, worked flat around the rim; repeat per group):
Chart Row 1 (black): *1 tr, ch 1, skip 1 st*, repeat around; turn with ch 4.
Chart Row 2 (blue): *2 tr in the next tr (paired V), ch 1*, repeat; turn with ch 4.
Chart Row 3 (green): *tr in first tr of the pair, 1 dc worked horizontally around the bar between the pair (like a front-post dc — see note), tr in second tr of the pair*, repeat.
Chart Row 4 (orange): *(tr, horizontal post dc, tr) over the group, ch 1*, repeat; turn with ch 3.
Chart Row 5 (top, black): *ch 1, dc2tog over the group, ch 1, sl st between groups*, repeat around — this closes each feather tip.
patterns.chineseText:
羽毛球图解 R1:环起6x R2:6v R3:(x,v)6 R4:(2x,v)6 R5-7:24x R8:换线24x断线
羽毛部分：先重复以上R1～R4四圈 R5:换白色钩内半针(blo)，根据图解进行钩织，断线后将两部分缝合在一起
(符号图) 中间长针:横着穿过针目勾一个长针 类似外钩长针 羽毛球顶部羽毛图解：底排长长针+1锁针间隔；第2排每针目里2长长针成对，锁针间隔；第3排每组3针（两边长长针+中间横穿长针）；第4排同组3针加锁针间隔；顶排每组上倒2针并1针+两侧锁针+组间引拔
patterns.notes: Key note from the chart: the middle 'long stitch' of each feather group is worked sideways through/around the stitch, similar to a front-post dc. The mesh forms the open feather skirt; sew the white mesh cup to the colored cork cup.

meta.intro: A crocheted badminton shuttlecock that actually looks flight-ready: a rounded cork base topped with an open lace 'feather' mesh worked from a symbol chart.
materials: White yarn for the feather mesh
Contrast yarn for the cork base

faq.question: What is the special stitch in the feather chart?
faq.answer: The middle stitch of each feather group is a dc worked sideways around the stitch below, like a front-post dc — the chart calls it out in red.

faq.question: How are the two parts joined?
faq.answer: Both start as the same small cup (Rnds 1-4); the white mesh cup is sewn onto the colored cork cup after finishing.

title: Pineapple Cat
description:
翻盖又又见萌喵，这次是菠萝

用线：@苏苏姐家 4股唯棉
色号：09 鸡黄、16 淡黄、37 艾绿
最后用万明布料胶在菠萝叶子合适的位置粘一下造型～慢干胶很方便调整，粘好记得固定晾干噢

**标签**: #手工的夏天 #手工钩织 #菠萝 #猫咪 #钩针小物 #钩针挂件 #钩针玩偶 #钩针图解
author: 摸凹猫毛

patterns.englishText:
Pineapple Cat — Cat Head with Ears (Part 1)

Cat Ears (make 2, pale yellow)
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Inc, (sc, inc) twice (8)
Fasten off the first ear; keep the yarn attached on the second ear.

Cat Head (pale yellow)
Rnd 1 (22): With the ear that still has yarn attached, after sl st in its first st, ch 1, sl st into the first st of Rnd 2 of the other ear, then work (3 sc, 2 inc, 4 sc) around both ears twice — joining the two ears into one round (22)
Rnd 2 (24): 2 sc, inc, 15 sc, inc, 3 sc
Rnd 3 (30): *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 4 (32): 3 sc, inc, 20 sc, inc, 5 sc
Rnd 5 (36): Sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 20 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 3 sc
Rnds 6-7 (36): Sc in each st around
Rnd 8 (30): *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 9 (24): *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 10 (18): *dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 11 (12): *sc, dec*, repeat 6 times
Fasten off; thread through the front loop of every other stitch and cinch closed.
patterns.chineseText:
猫耳朵*2-淡黄 R1(5针):环起5x R2(8针):v,2(x,v) 一只耳朵断线，另一只不断线
猫猫主体-淡黄 R1(22针):不断线的耳朵在第1针引拔后，钩1ch，在另一只耳朵R2第1针引拔，2(3x,2v,4x) R2(24针):2x,v,15x,v,3x R3(30针):6(3x,v) R4(32针):3x,v,20x,v,5x R5(36针):x,v,2x,v,20x,v,2x,v,3x R6-7(36针):36x R8(30针):6(2x,a,2x) R9(24针):6(3x,a) R10(18针):6(a,2x) R11(12针):6(x,a) 断线，隔一针从外半针穿线收口
patterns.notes: Part 1 of the flip-top pineapple cat. IMPORTANT: the original designer (@摸凹猫毛) forbids commercial use, modification and video tutorials of this diagram — check rights before publishing. Yarn: Susu 4-ply cotton, chick yellow/pale yellow/mugwort green.

patterns.englishText:
Pineapple Cat — Pineapple Shell (Part 2, make 2)

Special stitch: q = bobble made of 4 unfinished dc closed together.

Pineapple Shell (make 2, chick yellow)
Rnd 1 (6): 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2 (12): Inc in each st around
Rnd 3 (BLO, 18): *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 4 (18): *Bobble, dc*, repeat 9 times
Rnd 5 (30): *Inc, sc, inc*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 6 (30): *Dc, bobble, dc*, repeat 10 times
Rnd 7 (42): *Sc, inc, sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 8 (42): *Dc, bobble, dc*, repeat 14 times
Rnd 9 (change to pale yellow, BLO, 36): *5 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 10 (BLO, 36): Sc in each st around
Rnds 11-13 (36): Sc in each st around
Rnd 14 (30): *2 sc, dec, 2 sc*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 15 (24): *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 16 (18): *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times
Rnd 17 (12): *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times
Fasten off; thread through the front loop of every other st and cinch closed.
patterns.notes: The bobble rounds form the pineapple texture. Two shells make the flip-open pineapple that hides the cat. Designer forbids commercial use/modification — check rights before publishing.

patterns.englishText:
Pineapple Cat — Leaves (Part 3, mugwort green)

Leaf Base (worked into the FLO of Shell Rnd 2)
Rnd 1 (9): *2 sc, dec*, repeat 3 times
Rnd 2 (BLO, 9): Sc around
Rnd 3 (6): *Sc, dec*, repeat 3 times
Rnd 4 (BLO, 6): Sc around
Rnd 5 (6): Sc around

Leaf Layer 1 — worked on Rnd 5, sl st 2 sts apart between leaves, make 2 leaves:
Ch 5, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc, dc, hdc

Leaf Layer 2 — worked in the FLO of Rnd 3, sl st 1-2 sts apart, make 3 leaves:
Ch 7, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc, dc, 3 hdc

Leaf Layer 3 — worked in the FLO of Rnd 1, sl st 1-2 sts apart, make 4 leaves:
Ch 7, from 2nd ch: sl st, sc, dc, 3 hdc
patterns.chineseText:
菠萝叶-艾绿 R1(在菠萝皮R2 flo钩,9针):3(2x,a) R2(blo,9针):9x R3(6针):3(x,a) R4(blo,6针):6x R5(6针):6x
第一层叶子，在R5钩，每片隔2针引拔，共钩2片:5ch,倒二钩sl,x,t,f
第二层叶子，在R3 flo钩，每片隔1-2针引拔，共钩3片:7ch,倒二钩sl,x,t,3f
第三层叶子，在R1 flo钩，每片隔1-2针引拔，共钩4片:7ch,倒二钩sl,x,t,3f
patterns.notes: Layered leaf crown for the pineapple top. From the post: glue the leaves into shape with slow-dry fabric glue and let dry. Designer forbids commercial use — check rights before publishing.

meta.intro: A flip-open pineapple that hides a smiling cat inside — bobble-textured shell, layered leaf crown, and a cream kitty head with joined ears.
materials: Susu 4-ply cotton: chick yellow 09, pale yellow 16, mugwort green 37
Fabric glue for shaping the leaves

faq.question: What makes the pineapple texture?
faq.answer: Alternating rounds of dc and 4-dc bobbles (the 'q' stitch) across Rnds 4-8 of the shell.

faq.question: How are the cat's ears attached so cleanly?
faq.answer: Both ears are crocheted first, then joined into the head's first round in one pass — no sewing.

faq.question: Can I sell items from this pattern?
faq.answer: The designer explicitly forbids commercial use, modification and video tutorials — treat it as personal-use only.

title: Shaun the Sheep Charm
description:
🐑咩～
🧶：@苏苏姐家 唯棉4股（06.21）
🪡：2.0
📖：图解来自@大蕊爱钩织

**标签**: #一起来钩织 #手工钩织 #钩针小物 #小羊肖恩 #钩针挂件 #钩针图解 #小羊 #钩针玩偶 #手工挂件 #钩织小物
author: 一棵仙人掌🌵

patterns.englishText:
Shaun the Sheep Charm — Head, Body, Limbs & Wool Loops

Head (make 1, black)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4: *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 6-10: Sc in each st around (30)
Rnd 11: *4 sc, dec*, repeat 5 times (25)
Rnd 12: 7 sc, (dec, sc) 4 times, 6 sc (21)
Rnds 13-14: Sc in each st around (21)
Change to white; work in BLO (the loop facing away from you):
Rnd 15: *3 sc, inc, 3 sc*, repeat 3 times (24)
Rnd 16: *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 17: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 18: Dec 6 times (6)
Wool on top of head: working into the leftover front loops, *ch 5, sl st in next st*, repeat — makes the curly fleece.

Arms (make 2, black)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR; Rnd 2: 6 inc (12); Rnd 3: 6 dec (6); Rnd 4: 3 dec (3). Close, ch 10, leave a long tail to sew.

Legs (make 2, black)
Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: 6 inc (12); Rnd 3: 12 sc; Rnd 4: 6 dec (6); Rnd 5: 3 dec (3). Close, ch 10, leave a long tail to sew.

Body (white — alternate one round of normal sc and one round of BLO sc throughout)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2 (BLO): 6 inc (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 4 (BLO): *Sc, inc, sc*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat 6 times (30)
Rnds 6-10: Sc around (30) — Rnds 6, 8, 10 in BLO; Rnds 7, 9 through both loops
Rnd 11: *3 sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (24)
Rnd 12 (BLO): *Sc, dec, sc*, repeat 6 times (18)
Rnd 13: *Sc, dec*, repeat 6 times (12)
Rnd 14 (BLO): 6 dec (6). Leave a long tail and sew to the head.
Body wool: working into all the reserved front loops, *ch 5, sl st in next st*, repeat until covered.

Ears (make 2, black)
Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: 6 inc (12); Rnd 3: *sc, inc* 6 times (18); Rnds 4-6: 18 sc; Rnd 7: *sc, dec* 6 times (12); Rnd 8: 6 dec (6).

Eyes: 8 sc in MR (white), add safety eyes or embroider pupils.

patterns.englishText:
Woven Raffia Handbag (Hinata Akiko) — Parts & Oval Base

Finished size: 14 x 27 cm, 6 cm gusset. Gauge: 21 sc x 16.5 rows = 10 cm.

Strips - Part A (make 20): foundation ch 33, work 5 rows of sc = 15.5 cm x 3 cm each. (On rows 2-4 crochet around a poly cord core.)
Handles (make 2): shrimp-stitch cord, 22 cm.

Oval Base (make 2): foundation ch 47, work in the round in sc:
Rnd 1: 96 sc (inc 1 at each end)
Rnd 2: 102 sc
Rnd 3: 108 sc
Rnd 4: 114 sc (inc 3 at each side)
Rnd 5: 120 sc
Symbols: oval = ch, X = sc, X-with-splay = 2 sc in one, filled oval = sl st.
patterns.chineseText: 日向明子手袋 图解 第1部分:材料生态拉菲草米色约120g,5/0钩针,聚酯芯;成品14×27×侧6cm;密度短针21目×16.5段=10cm。部件A×20:15.5cm(33目)×3cm(5段);底×2:22cm(47目)×2.5cm(5段);提手×2:虾辫22cm。底部针数表:R1:96(两侧各+1);R2:102;R3:108;R4:114(每段两侧各+3);R5:120。起针锁针47。
patterns.notes: Weaving-crochet bag: 20 flat sc strips are woven together over an oval base. Yarn: raffia/Eco Andaria beige ~120g, 5/0 hook, poly core in the strips. Base worked as a 5-round oval to 120 sc.

patterns.englishText:
Woven Raffia Handbag — Assembly

1. Base: hold the 2 base pieces together and sc around once = 120 sc, inserting the base board partway.
2. Join the 20 A-strips to the base rim with sl st (alternate joining ☆ into 5 sts of both base + strip, and ◆ = 1 sl st into base only), around = 120.
3. Weave: cross each pair of adjacent A-strips and pin (round 1). Then shift by one strip and cross the next pairs the opposite way (round 2). Repeat around.
4. Opening: Row 1 - *5 sc across one A-strip, ch 1*, repeat 20 times around to join the strip tops (pick up the ch as a bundle). Row 2 - 120 sc even, no inc/dec.
5. Remove pins/clips and sew on the two handles inside with matching yarn.
Symbols: oval = ch, X = sc.
patterns.chineseText: 日向明子手袋 图解 第2部分 组装:①底部2片一起短针一周120目,中途夹底板;把20片A用引拔缝到底(☆与◆交替一周120目);②相邻2片A交叉用别针固定一周(第1回);③错开1片再上下相反交叉(第2回);④钩入口:第1段'1片A上短针5+锁针1'重复20次一周连接,第2段不加减短针120目;⑤装提手。
patterns.notes: Assembly of the woven bag: attach strips to base, weave adjacent strips over/under, then crochet the top opening and attach handles. Opening = 120 sts.

meta.intro: A woven raffia handbag made from 20 flat crocheted strips woven over an oval base - a summery, sturdy tote.

faq.question: How is the woven look created?
faq.answer: Twenty single-crochet strips are attached around an oval base, then crossed over and under each other and secured at the top opening.

title: Raffia Openwork Bag

**标签**: 草包编织 棒针编织 钩针教程 图解分享 拉菲草 镂空包 夏天的味道 夏日穿搭 夏天包包 拉菲草包编织
