patterns.englishText:
Raffia Openwork Bag — Mesh Stitch Chart (worked as charted)

Foundation: ch 29 (a multiple for the repeat).
Row/Rnd 1: sc across (base row).
Pattern repeat (the bracketed section repeats around):
- 2 dc posts, ch loop, sc into the ch space of the row below, ch loop — forming an open square mesh
- alternate rows offset the dc posts so the openings stack into a diamond/net
Continue the repeat for the bag body height; the openwork lets light through (raffia mesh tote).
Symbols: oval = ch, X = sc, T-bar = dc.
patterns.chineseText: 棉草包 镂空针法 手绘符号图解。起29针(倍数),R1短针一行,之后重复方格镂空花样:长针柱+锁针空隙+短针,一组一组重复(重复段标注在左侧)。
patterns.notes: Hand-drawn chart for a raffia mesh tote. Start 29 sts; the boxed section (marked 重复 = repeat) is worked around/across for the whole body. dc posts + ch loops + sc form the open squares.

meta.intro: An openwork raffia mesh tote - light and breezy, perfect for summer outings.

faq.question: What is the stitch pattern?
faq.answer: An open square-mesh of dc posts and chain loops, worked over a starting chain of 29 (a multiple for the repeat).

patterns.englishText:
Vintage Granny Square Motif (Part 8) — Flower-in-Square (worked as charted)

Rnd 1: MR, ch 2, work ~16 dc into the ring, join (16) — center wheel
Rnd 2 (color B): join in a gap, form 8 small petals of dc groups around the center

patterns.chineseText: 经典复古祖母方格 符号图解。线材《我的孤独是一座花园》,配色黄子游/缟羽/雾山紫,4mm钩针。符号:辫子针=ch,短针X=sc,引拔针=sl st,中长针=hdc,长针=dc,长长针2针的枣形针=2-tr bobble。中心到外共约6圈,花心+8瓣花+方角。

title: Apple Motif Shawl
description:
🍎材料准备：中粗牛奶棉（主色红/粉2-3团，配色白1团，绿1团），总量约400-500g；3.0mm钩针1支；缝合针、剪刀、记号扣若干。

🍎起针方法：主色线活结→钩30-35锁针（肩宽调整，偏宽可加至38针）→返回第2针钩短针，每锁针钩1短针共29-34针→最后1针钩3锁针作起立针，翻面。

🍎主体钩织（苹果轮廓+花纹）：
- 第1行长针行：每短针上钩1长针，最后1针钩3长针（转角增针），3锁针翻面。
- 第2-8行：重复，转角同针钩3长针，扩大宽度形成苹果下半轮廓。
- 第9-12行：每行两端各减1针收窄，形成上半轮廓。
- 苹果花纹：换白线在中间钩5-6个圆形花纹（8锁针成圈，圈内16短针，第二圈"1短针+1锁针"×8）；换绿线在顶端钩2片叶子。

**标签**: 苹果干披肩钩织 苹果干 苹苹安安 治愈系

patterns.englishText:
Apple Motif — Round Symbol Chart (worked as charted)

Center (yellow): MR, ch 3, work about 11-12 dc into the ring, join
Body (main color): continue in dc, increasing each round so the circle widens into the rounded apple body
Edging (red): sc around the outer edge, working a small dip/notch at the top of the apple
Stem (brown): from the top notch, ch a short stem and add a tiny leaf (ch + picot), sc back down
Symbols: oval = ch, X = sc, T-bar = dc, dot = sl st.
patterns.chineseText: 苹果花片 符号图解(黄色花心+黑色长针身+红色短针边+棕色果柄)。
patterns.notes: Flat apple appliqué/motif used on the apple shawl. Colors: yellow center, main body, red outline, brown stem. Symbol chart carries exact counts.

patterns.englishText:
Apple Motif — Round-by-Round Guide (same motif, rounds outlined)

This is the same apple motif with each round highlighted to show the boundaries.
Rnd 1 (yellow): MR, ch 3, ~11-12 dc in ring, join
Rnd 2: dc around, increasing evenly (dc, 2 dc in next) to widen the body
Rnd 3: continue dc with increases to reach the apple's widest point
Edging: red sc around the whole outline with a top notch
Stem: brown ch stem plus a small ch/picot leaf
Follow the highlighted rounds for stitch placement.
patterns.chineseText: 苹果花片 符号图解(圈数用绿色描出:花心→身→边)。

faq.question: How is the apple shape made?
faq.answer: Worked flat in single and double crochet, increasing at the corners then decreasing at the top to form the rounded apple outline, with added flower and leaf motifs.

Six-Petal Flower Motif
Rnd 1: In a magic ring, ch 2, hdc, ch 2, then 5x (2-dc bobble, ch 2); pull the ring tight and sl st to the first hdc.
Rnd 2: ch 1 to start; in each of the 6 holes work: 6x (sc, ch 2, 3 sl st, ch 3, sc).

Five-Petal Flower Motif
Rnd 1: In a magic ring, ch 2, hdc, ch 2, then 4x (2-dc bobble, ch 2); pull tight and sl st to the first hdc.
Rnd 2: ch 1; in each of the 5 holes work: 5x (sc, ch 2, 3 sl st, ch 3, sc).

Assembly (join-as-you-go, joining flowers at their petals)
Base: 4 six-petal flowers.
Round 1: 3 six-petal flowers top and bottom, 3 five-petal flowers each side.
Rounds 2-6: 12 six-petal flowers each.
Total: 70 six-petal flowers + 6 five-petal flowers for the bag.
Strap: a line of six-petal flowers (about 8, adjust for length) - 18 six-petal flowers total.
patterns.chineseText: 多巴胺繁花包钩织图解(非原创,参考@知之织)。钩针3.0mm,包身约28×24cm,帆布束口内衬袋。6瓣花花片:R1环形起针2ch,F,2ch,5(2长针枣形针,2ch)拉紧与第一个F引拔;R2起立1ch,六个洞里钩6(x,2ch,3E,3ch,x)。5瓣花花片:R1环起2ch,F,2ch,4(2长针枣形针,2ch)拉紧引拔;R2起立1ch,五个洞里钩5(x,2ch,3E,3ch,x)。包底及包身:包底4个六瓣花;R1上下各3个六瓣花,左右各3个五瓣花;R2-6:12个六瓣花。共70个六瓣花+6个五瓣花。包带:8个六瓣花(可调),共18个六瓣花。
patterns.notes: Join-as-you-go flower-motif bag (dopamine colors). Each flower = bobble-petal granny joined to neighbors at the ch loops. F=hdc, E=sl st, bobble=2-dc cluster, x=sc. ~28x24cm body, 3.0mm hook, canvas liner. Strap flower count adjustable.

faq.answer: About 70 six-petal flowers plus 6 five-petal flowers for the body, and 18 more six-petal flowers for the strap.

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Necktie — Symbol Chart Part 1 (Rows 1-9, narrow tip)

Worked flat, starting from the pointed tip and widening.

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Necktie — Symbol Chart Part 2 (Rows 8-16, body)

Continues from the tip, finishing the widening and settling into the straight tie body.
Row 8-11: dc rows with ch-1 spaces (filet mesh) across the width; sc worked as a small diamond/cross motif in the center
Row 12-16: even rows of dc + ch-1 mesh, straight sides (no more increases), keeping the central sc accent

patterns.chineseText: 钩针领带 符号图解 第2部分(8-16단/行,过渡到领带主体)。

patterns.englishText:

The wide blade end of the tie.
Row 49-52: dc rows with ch-1 spaces (filet mesh) across the full width, edges shaped with inc/dec to flare the blade
Row 53-56: continue dc + ch-1 mesh, then finish the tip; edge stitches (dc, ch) close the blade point
Symbols: oval = ch, T with bar = dc, plus/cross = sc.
patterns.chineseText: 钩针领带 符号图解 第3部分(49-56단/行,宽端收尾)。

patterns.englishText:
Flying-Bird Pixel Coaster — 36 x 36 Tapestry Chart

Work a solid square of 36 sc across by 36 rows in single-crochet tapestry technique.

patterns.englishText:
Flying-Bird Pixel Coaster — Full 36 x 36 Color Grid

Complete pixel chart for the bird coaster: 36 columns x 36 rows.
Work in single-crochet tapestry, 1 sc per cell, following the two colors marked C13 and H2 to form the bird silhouette.
Rows are worked back and forth (right-side rows left-to-right, wrong-side rows right-to-left); read the chart accordingly.
patterns.chineseText: 飞鸟垫 完整像素格子图,36×36,C13/H2两色。

title: Prada-Style Bag
description:
图解2原创@Mochi Chan

**标签**: （无）
author: Elsa

patterns.englishText:
Prada-Style Bag — Body & Oval Base Chart (worked as charted)

Oval Base: start with a foundation ch, work sc/dc around both ends with even increases (V = 2 in one st) to form a flat oval; finish with a round of dc.
Body: pick up around the base and work the body upward in rows of dc (T-bars) with a top edging of sc (X).
Handles: on the top rows, leave two arch-shaped openings (skip a span and ch across, then sc back over the arch on the return) to form the built-in handle holes; sc around the handle arches to reinforce.
Symbols: X = sc, T with bar = dc, oval = ch, V = 2 sc in one st.
patterns.chineseText: Prada包 钩织图解:主体部分(短针边+长针身,两侧留提手拱形开口)+底部(椭圆,短针/长针加针钩成)。
patterns.notes: Structured tote resembling a Prada bag: flat oval base, dc body worked up from the base, with two integrated arch handles at the top edge. See image_2 (post-level) for the second diagram credited to @Mochi Chan.

patterns.englishText:
Prada-Style Bag — Oval Base (written) + Motif Charts

Oval Base
Rnd 1: Ch 28, from 2nd ch: 26 sc, 3 sc in the end st (W), 25 sc back along the other side, inc (V)
Rnd 2: inc, 25 sc, 3 inc, 25 sc, 2 inc = 56
Rnd 3: (inc, sc), 25 sc, 3(inc, sc), 25 sc, 2(inc, sc) = 62
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc), 25 sc, 3(2 sc, inc), 25 sc, 2(2 sc, inc) = 68
Rnd 5: (3 sc, inc), 25 sc, 3(3 sc, inc), 25 sc, 2(3 sc, inc) = 74
Rnd 6: (4 sc, inc), 25 sc, 3(4 sc, inc), 25 sc, 2(4 sc, inc) = 86
Body: continue straight up from the base.
Page also shows a granny-square motif chart and a striped band chart (legend: oval=ch, +=sc, T=hdc, dc, tr, dtr).
patterns.notes: Written oval base worked to 86 sts over 6 rounds. W=3 sc in one st, V=inc. Then work the body straight up. Symbol legend included for the extra motif/band charts.

patterns.englishText:
Round Base — Flat Circle Increase Chart (worked as charted)

Rnd 1: MR, work 6-8 sc in ring
Rnd 2: 2 sc in each st (inc around)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc* around
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* around
Continue adding one plain sc between increases each round so the circle stays flat; work as many rounds as needed for the base size.
Symbols: + = sc, splayed cross = 2 sc in one st (inc), o = MR/ch.
patterns.chineseText: 圆形底 螺旋加针符号图+成品圆垫。
patterns.notes: Standard flat circle base worked in the round with even increases each round. Shown with a finished round coaster/base.

patterns.englishText:
Square Base — Center-Out Chart (worked as charted)

Start: MR (center ring marked o).
Work sc around, placing 2 sc (or sc, ch, sc) in each of the 4 corners every round so flat corners form a square.
Each round: sc along the 4 sides, corner increase at each corner; repeat, adding sts to the sides as the square grows.
Symbols: + = sc, splayed cross = 2 sc in one st, o = center ring.
patterns.chineseText: 方形底 中心加针符号图+成品方垫。
patterns.notes: Flat square base worked from a center ring with 4 corner increases per round. Shown with a finished square piece.

patterns.englishText:
Long Oval Strap/Base — Worked Around a Foundation Chain (as charted)

Foundation: ch a length for the strap/base.
Rnd 1: work sc along one side of the chain, 3 sc (or inc) around the end, sc back along the other side, inc around the other end; join.
Rnd 2+: sc around, working end increases (2-3 sc in the end sts) each round so the oval widens evenly while the long sides stay straight.
Symbols: X = sc, chevron/V = 2 sc in one st (inc), oval = ch.
patterns.chineseText: 长椭圆(提手/底条) 环形符号图+成品长条。
patterns.notes: Long flat oval (used as a strap or base band) worked in the round around a starting chain, increasing only at the two ends.

patterns.englishText:
Oval Base — Round Chart (worked as charted)

Foundation: ch a length, then work around both sides.
Rnd 1: sc/hdc along one side of the chain, fan of increases (V) around one end, sc/hdc along the other side, increases around the other end
Rnd 2-5: continue around, spacing the end increases (V) a little wider each round so the oval grows flat while the sides stay parallel (rounds numbered 1-5 in the chart)
Symbols: dash = sc/hdc, V/chevron = 2 sts in one (inc), filled dash = sl st.
patterns.chineseText: 椭圆底 环形符号图(短横线=针)+成品椭圆,约5圈。
patterns.notes: Flat oval base, ~5 rounds, increases concentrated at the two ends. Shown with a finished oval piece.

patterns.englishText:
Oval Base — Double-Crochet Round Chart (worked as charted)

Foundation: ch a length; work around both sides in dc.

description:

**标签**: 钩针 织女的聚会 小红书手工友好季 我的手工日常 织女日常 不完美手工事务所
author: FOOL MOON

patterns.englishText:
Solomon's Knot (Lover's Knot / 七宝针) — Stitch Tutorial

This is the mesh stitch used for the scarf, forming a diamond net.
Step 1: Ch 1 to start, work 1 sc, then draw the working loop up long (elongate it) and ch 1.
Step 2: Insert the hook into the back bump of that long chain, yarn over and pull up a loop.
Step 3: Yarn over and draw through, then work 1 sc into it (steps 1-3 = one Solomon's knot).
Step 4: The same way — elongate the loop, ch 1, pick up the back bump, pull up, work sc.
Step 5: After making 2 Solomon's knots, insert the hook where the arrow shows and work 1 sc to anchor into the previous row.
Step 6: At the end of Row 1, begin Row 2 with 4 ch (turning), 1 Solomon's knot, then sc into the arrowed loop; repeat across.
Symbols: oval = ch, cross = sc; elongated loops = the extended Solomon's-knot loops.
patterns.chineseText: 七宝针(所罗门结)针法教程,6步:1.起1锁针+1短针,把线圈拉长,再钩1锁针;2.钩针插入锁针里山,挂线引拔出;3.再挂线引拔,钩1短针(1-3为一个七宝针);4.同法拉长针目,钩1锁针,挑锁针里山引拔,钩短针;5.钩2个七宝针后,钩针插入箭头位置钩短针;6.第1行末尾,第2行钩4针起立针+1七宝针,插箭头位置钩短针,重复。
patterns.notes: Solomon's/Lover's knot mesh (七宝针) — the whole scarf is this one stitch repeated to the desired length. Keep the elongated loops even for a neat net.

meta.intro: An airy, romantic scarf worked entirely in the Solomon's-knot (lover's-knot) mesh - beginner friendly since it's one stitch repeated.

faq.question: What stitch is used?
faq.answer: Just the Solomon's knot (also called lover's knot or seven-treasure stitch) - elongated loops locked with a single crochet.

faq.question: How long should it be?
faq.answer: Keep repeating the mesh until the scarf reaches your desired length.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 1: Center start. Rnd 1: MR, 6 sc. Rnd 2: 6 inc (12).
patterns.chineseText: 1、环形起6个短针,第二圈6个加针
patterns.notes: First step of the gardenia flower center.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 2: First petal layer (in front loops). In one stitch: 3 treble crochet, ch 3, insert through 2 strands and close a picot (sl st), then 1 more treble in the same place; in the next stitch 1 treble, ch 3, sl st in the same place. Repeat to make 6 petals.
patterns.chineseText: 2、钩第一层花瓣:钩内半针,1个针目里先钩3个长长针,起3个辫子针,挑两根穿过,狗牙拉针完成,同一位置再钩1个长长针,下一针目再钩1长长针然后起3个辫子针,同一位置引拔,钩6组完成第一层花瓣
patterns.notes: First (outer) petal layer of the gardenia; picot = ch 3 + sl st.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 3: Work into the back loops of the round below: 6x(sc, inc).
patterns.chineseText: 3、钩第二圈的内半针,6组1短针,1加针
patterns.notes: Back-loop shaping round between petal layers.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 4: Second petal layer. In one stitch ch 3 + 1 treble; in the 2nd stitch 1 treble-increase, picot, 1 treble-increase; in the 3rd stitch 1 treble, ch 3, then sl st. Repeat for 6 petals.
patterns.chineseText: 4、钩第二层花瓣:1个针目里起3个辫子针和钩1个长长针,第二针里钩1个长长针加针,狗牙拉针,再1长长针加针,第3个针目里钩1长长针,3个辫子针然后引拔,循环钩6组
patterns.notes: Second (middle) petal layer of the gardenia.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 5: Back-loop round again: 6x(sc, inc, sc).
patterns.chineseText: 5、又钩内半针,钩6组1短针,1加针,1短针
patterns.notes: Back-loop shaping round before the third petal layer.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 6: Third petal layer. Ch 3, 2 triple-treble; 2 triple-treble, picot; 2 triple-treble; 2 triple-treble, ch 4, sl st. Repeat for 6 petals.
patterns.chineseText: 6、钩第三层花瓣:起3个辫子针钩2个三卷长针,2个三卷长针狗牙拉针,2个三卷长针,2个三卷长针4个辫子引拔,重复钩6组
patterns.notes: Third (largest) petal layer using triple-treble stitches.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 7: Stamen. Ch 4, sl st back down (3 sl st) from the 2nd ch; repeat for 7 groups, then roll up to form the yellow center.
patterns.chineseText: 7、钩花蕊:起4个辫子针,倒数第2针回钩3个引拔针,重复钩7组
patterns.notes: Yellow stamen center made from repeated ch + sl-st spikes, rolled up.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 8: Leaf. Ch 12 with a wire core; from 2nd ch: sc, dc, 7 hdc, dc, 3 sc in the end st; down the other side: dc, 7 hdc, dc, sc, sl st.
patterns.chineseText: 8、钩一片叶子,看图解钩:12ch,加入铁丝,倒2勾x,t,7f,t,w,另一边勾t,7f,t,x,引拔
patterns.notes: Wire-cored leaf worked around a foundation chain; w = 3 sc in the end stitch.

patterns.englishText: Gardenia Flower — Step 9: Hanging cord. Ch 3, work 3 unfinished hdc and pull through all loops at once (a puff stitch); repeat for about 20 puffs; ch 3 more, sl st, then join first to last with a sl st to close the loop.
patterns.chineseText: 9、钩带子:起3个辫子针,钩3个未完成的中长针,一次拉过,钩20组左右,又钩3个辫子,引拔,最后首尾引拔连接
patterns.notes: Puff-stitch chain cord/loop for hanging the flower charm.

patterns.englishText:
Gardenia Flower — Full Pattern (Flower, Center, Calyx & Leaf)
Key: x=sc, v=inc, e=sl st, ev=sl-st inc, f=hdc, t=dc; triple-treble = yarn over 3 times; picot = ch 3 + sl st.

Flower
Rnd 1: MR, 6 sc
Rnd 2: 6 inc (12)
Rnd 3 (first petals, front loops): (ch 3, sl-st inc, sl st, picot, sl st)(sl st, ch 3, sl st) repeat 6 times; then in the back loops: 6x(sc, inc)
Rnd 4 (second petals, front loops): (ch 3, sl st)(sl-st inc, picot, sl-st inc)(sl st, ch 3, sl st) repeat 6 times; then in back loops: 6x(sc, inc, sc)
Rnd 5 (third petals): (ch 3, 2 triple-treble)(2 triple-treble, picot)(2 triple-treble)(2 triple-treble, ch 4, sl st) repeat 6 times.

Flower Center: ch 4, sl st back into the 3rd ch; repeat for 7-8 groups and roll up.

Calyx: MR, 14 hdc. (Ch 5, from 2nd ch: 2 sc, dc, hdc, k2, sl st) repeat 5 times.

Leaf: Ch 12 with a wire core, from 2nd ch: sc, dc, 7 hdc, dc, 3 sc in end; down the other side: dc, 7 hdc, dc, sc, sl st.
patterns.chineseText:
栀子花|附解
花:
1.环形起针6x 2.6v
3.外半针:(3ch,ev,e,狗牙拉针,e)(e,3ch引拔)重复六次。内半针:6(x,v)
4.外半针:(3ch,e)(ev,狗牙拉针,ev)(e,3ch引拔)重复六次。内半针:6(x,v,x)
5.(3ch,两个三卷长针)(两个三卷长针,狗牙拉针)(两个三卷长针)(两个三卷长针,4ch引拔)重复六次。
花心:4ch倒三引拔,一直重复7-8组,卷起来。
花托:环形起针14f。5ch,倒2勾2x,t,f,k2引拔。重复五次。
叶子:12ch,加入铁丝,倒2勾x,t,7f,t,w。另一边勾t,7f,t,x,引拔。
patterns.notes: Complete gardenia pattern: three layered petal rounds (FLO petals + BLO shaping), rolled chain stamen, 5-point calyx and a wire-cored leaf. Picot = ch 3 + sl st; triple-treble = yo 3 times.

meta.intro: A layered gardenia flower with three rounds of ruffled petals, a rolled yellow stamen, a green calyx and a wired leaf — with a full step-by-step photo tutorial.

faq.question: What makes the petals so full?
faq.answer: Three petal layers are worked, alternating front-loop petal rounds with back-loop shaping rounds; the largest layer uses triple-treble stitches.

faq.question: Is there a photo tutorial?
faq.answer: Yes — the pattern includes nine step-by-step photos plus a complete written chart.

patterns.englishText:
Net Produce Bag

Rnd 1: MR (wrap yarn twice), (ch 7, sc) x7, ch 3, sl st
Rnd 2: (ch 9, sl st into the 4th ch of the 7-ch loop below) x7; on the last group ch 4 and sl st into the sl st below
Rnd 3-6: repeat Rnd 2, joining with a sl st into the 5th (middle) ch of each loop below
Rnd 7: (ch 9, sl st into the 5th ch of the loop below) x2, ch 4, sl st into the 5th ch
Rnd 8: turn, ch 9, sl st into the middle of the loop below, ch 4, sl st
Rnd 9: turn, ch 14, sl st into the middle and fasten off (this is one handle)
Rejoin yarn on the other side and repeat Rnd 7-9 for the second handle.
patterns.chineseText:
网兜:
R1:环起绕两圈线,(7CH,X)*7,3CH,E
R2:(9CH,在上一圈7CH第4个辫子上引拔)*7,最后一组起4CH,在上一圈E上钩E
R3~R6:重复R2,在上一圈中间第5个辫子上引拔
R7:(9CH,上一圈第5个辫子引拔)*2,4CH,第五个辫子上E
R8:翻转,9CH,上一圈中间引拔,4CH,E
R9:翻转,14CH,中间引拔断线(包带)
另一边重新起线,重复R7~R9

Leaf: Rnd 1: 5 sc; Rnd 2: ch 4, from 2nd ch sl st, sc, dc, sl st into next st — make 5. Stem: ch 4, from 2nd ch 3 sl st

Mushroom

Carrot

patterns.englishText:
Blue-and-White Snowflake (symbol chart) — 6-point snowflake worked from a magic ring.

Rnd 1: MR; ch 3 (counts as first dc), work double-crochet spokes evenly around the ring and join with sl st to form 6 dc spokes.
Rnd 2: build each spoke outward with 2-3 stacked dc.
Arms: at the end of each spoke work a central chain spike (about ch 6 with a ch-picot at the tip), then a shorter chain branch on each side of the spike (about ch 4 each, ch-picot tip), and sl st back to the spoke base. Repeat for all 6 arms and fasten off.

(Counts read from the symbol chart; follow the visual chart for exact placement.)
patterns.chineseText: 青花瓷小雪花 符号图解(六角雪花,从环起中心向外)。中心环起,红色符号为长针,蓝色椭圆为锁针,构成六条雪花臂,每臂中间一根主刺两侧各一分支,末端锁针狗牙。
patterns.notes: Symbol chart for a 6-point openwork snowflake (dc spokes + chained picot arms). The chart image itself is the primary reference.

meta.intro: A blue-and-white openwork snowflake charm worked from a magic ring into six chained, picot-tipped arms.

patterns.englishText:
Cockatiel Parrot — Cheeks, Feet & Assembly

Cheeks (make 2, orange, split 2-ply yarn, 1.25mm hook)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR
Rnd 2: 6 inc
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18), fasten off

faq.question: Why does this pattern use different stitch letters?
faq.answer: This maker's key sets T=hdc, F=dc and E=tr, which differs from the usual shorthand — follow the legend given in the pattern.

faq.question: How are the feet made?
faq.answer: The feet are bent from craft wire (about four 20cm lengths) coated in glue and wrapped with skin-tone yarn.

faq.question: Is this beginner-friendly?
faq.answer: No — it runs 60+ rounds with color changes, layered wings and wire feet, so it suits confident makers.

Part 2 'Rounded Picot' segments
Rnd 1: MR, 8 sc
Rnd 2: (ch 3, sl st) x8 = eight ch-picots, join first to last, fasten off. Make the rest starting from 8, 7, 6 sc.

Part 3: Body & tail link
Rnd 1: 6 sc
Rnd 2: in back loops (ch 3, sl st) x6; after the last ch 3, sl st into the front loop of the first st of Rnd 2. [Thread all segments together here.]
Rnd 3: 6 sc (knot and hide the threading tails)

Rnd 5: 1st st (ch 3, 3 hdc, ch 3), 2nd st sl st, 3rd st (ch 3, 3 hdc, ch 3), sl st and fasten off

meta.intro: A cute 'gudu chicken' pouch that holds an egg or a pair of earbuds, worked as two half-domes with a comb, beak, wattle and hanging cords.

faq.question: What can it hold?

faq.question: Is it worked flat or in the round?

**标签**: 山茶花, 山茶花挂件, 钩针山茶花, 手工编织花朵, 钩针花束, 动手就是春天, 钩针小物, 钩针挂件, 我的手作日常, 钩韵时光集
author: 钩韵时光集

patterns.englishText:
One-Piece Camellia Flower — Layered Petals & Leaf

Flower (worked in one continuous piece)
Row 1: Ch 52
Row 2: From 3rd ch, 3 hdc, ch 3, drop the loop and sl st to the first hdc; into the loop just formed work (6 tr, ch 2, sl st) as one group — repeat 5 times.
Row 3: 5 hdc, ch 5, drop loop and sl st to first st; work 9 tr (after the 5th tr, join at the middle of the 5 hdc), ch 2, sl st as one group — repeat 7 times.
Row 4: Turn; in the ch space 3 sc, then in the matching sts of the tr row 4 sc, ch-1 picot, 4 sc, 3 sc in the ch space, sl st as one group — repeat 7 times.
Row 5: 3 sc in ch space, 3 sc in matching sts above, one ch picot, 3 sc, 3 sc in ch space, sl st — repeat 5 times.

Leaf
1) Ch 12, insert wire, from 2nd ch: sc, hdc, sl st, sl-st-inc, 4 sl st, hdc, dc, [w], dc, hdc, 4 sl st, sl-st-inc, sl st, hdc, sc
2) 12x(sc, ch 2), (sc, ch 2, sc), 12x(sc, ch 2)
patterns.chineseText:
一体钩针山茶花(附图解)
花朵
1 起52个锁针
2 倒3钩3中长针3锁针然后脱线到第一针中长针引拔,在形成的洞里钩6个长长针2锁针引拔为一组重复5次。
3 钩5中长针5锁针脱线引拔到首针,钩9个长长针(第五个长长针后在5个中长针中间位置)2锁针引拔为一组重复7次。
4 翻转织物在锁针洞里勾3短针,再到上一排长针对应针目钩4短针,1锁针狗牙针,4短针,锁针洞里3短针引拔为一组重复7次。
5 锁针洞里钩3短针,上排对应针目钩3短针,一辫子狗牙,3短针,锁针洞里三个短针,引拔。重复5次
叶子
①起12ch,加入铁丝,倒2钩x.f.e.ev.4e.f.t.w.t.f.4e.ev.e.f.x
②12(x.2ch).(x.2ch.x).12(x.2ch)
patterns.notes: Camellia flower crocheted from a single 52-ch foundation into spiralling layered petals. Leaf shaped over a wire core; picot = ch then sl st. Leaf design credited to another maker.

meta.intro: A one-piece crocheted camellia flower with layered ruffled petals, worked from a single long foundation chain — pretty as an applique, brooch backing or bouquet bloom.

faq.question: Why is it called a one-piece flower?
faq.answer: The whole bloom is crocheted continuously from one 52-chain foundation that spirals into stacked petal layers, so there is almost no assembly.

faq.question: Do I need wire?
faq.answer: Only for the leaf — a length of craft wire is crocheted inside it so the leaf holds its shape.

title: Blue-and-White Flower Coaster
description:

patterns.englishText:
Blue-and-White Flower Coaster — Step Photos

(X = sc, F = dc, ch = chain; bobble = several unfinished dc closed together)

Rnd 1: 16 sc in a magic ring (16)
Rnd 2: working 2 sc as one group, *2-dc bobble (2 unfinished dc drawn together), ch 3* x8
Rnd 3: *5 dc in the ch-3 space, ch 1* x8
Rnd 4: *1 dc in each of the 5 dc (one-to-one), ch 5* x8
Rnd 5: *5-dc bobble worked over the 5 dc, ch 5, sc in the previous round's ch-5 space, ch 5* x8
Rnd 6: *sc in the ch-5 space, ch 6* x16
Rnd 7: *sc in the ch-6 space, ch 1, 11 dc in the next ch-6 space, ch 1* x8
Rnd 8: sc in each corresponding stitch; on the 6th dc of each 11-dc group, work an sc with a ch-3 picot
patterns.chineseText: 青花瓷配色花朵杯垫——步骤图（8步,中文,@屿沫手作）。R1环起16X;R2两个短针为一组钩(2个未完成长针的枣形针,3ch)*8;R3(3ch上钩5F,ch)*8;R4(5F上一一对应钩F,5ch)*8;R5(在5F上钩5个未完成长针的枣形针,5ch,在上一圈5ch上钩X,5ch)*8;R6(在5ch上钩X,6ch)*16;R7(在6ch上钩X,ch,下一6ch上钩11F,ch)*8;R8一一对应钩短针,在11F的第6F上钩X,3ch的狗牙针。
patterns.notes: 'Blue-and-white porcelain' color flower coaster, shown as an 8-step photo tutorial. Center bobble flower with expanding chain-loop rounds and a picot scalloped edge. Design by @屿沫手作.

patterns.englishText:
Blue-and-White Flower Coaster — Octagonal Symbol Chart

Symbol key: sl st, single crochet (sc), chain (ch), double crochet (dc), dc2tog (2 dc together), dc5tog (5 dc together), plus start-here and cut-yarn markers.

Worked in rounds from a central magic ring outward into an octagonal flower motif: a bobble/petal center, expanding rounds of dc groups and dc-clusters separated by chain spaces, and a final scalloped/picot sc border. Follow the charted wedge repeat around all eight sides.
The two colors (deep blue and white) alternate to give the blue-and-white porcelain look.
patterns.chineseText: 青花瓷花朵杯垫——八边形高清符号图解（Daisy）。符号:引拔针=sl st,短针=sc,辫子针=ch,长针=dc,长针两针并一针=dc2tog,长针五针并一针=dc5tog,断线,开始钩织,环形起针。
patterns.notes: High-resolution symbol chart (by 'Daisy') for the octagonal blue-and-white flower coaster. Companion to the step-photo tutorial; uses dc clusters (dc2tog/dc5tog) to shape the petals.

meta.intro: A 'blue-and-white porcelain' flower coaster: an octagonal doily with a bobble-flower center and a picot scalloped edge.
materials: Cotton yarn in blue and white

faq.question: How do I get the porcelain look?
faq.answer: Alternate the deep blue and white yarns as you change rounds so the petals and border read like blue-and-white china.

faq.question: Should I block it?
faq.answer: Yes — wet-blocking opens up the chain loops and sets the octagonal shape and picot edge flat.

title: Flying Bird (Dove)
description:
白色棉草织的飞鸟很百搭，搭配包包很清爽。

✅飞鸟工具及材料
📕图解：P11

（注：正文含品牌合作内容，已略去。）

**标签**: 钩针图解, 新手钩织, 钩针教程, 飞鸟, 钩针, 织女日常
author: 嘎嘎毛线球

patterns.englishText:
Flying Bird (Dove) — Chart & Steps

(ch = chain, sc = single crochet, hdc = half double, dc = double crochet, inc = sc increase, dec = sc decrease, sl st = slip stitch)

Start: ch 4 and leave a tail, then cut (this chain becomes the beak base, inserted later).
Steps 1-2: with a separate strand, make a magic ring and work the head.
Step 3: work the upper body and the left wing; when you reach Round 2, lay in the ch-4 segment (the beak base) and keep working until the left wing is finished, then cut.
Step 4: with a separate strand, work the right wing; cut when finished.
Step 5: with a separate strand, work the lower body.
Step 6: work one round of sc all the way around the whole body (weave the loose tails under the sc as you go).
Step 7: change color and, starting at the head, work the beak onto the ch-4 base.

Worked flat as a color-coded stitch graph using sc, hdc and dc with sc increases/decreases to shape the head, wings and body.
patterns.chineseText: 飞鸟图解及步骤（@嘎嘎毛线球）。起4个锁针留线断线。Step1-2另线环形起针编织头部;Step3编织身体上半段及左翅,织到R2时把4个锁针的线段放入并继续编织直到左翅完成后断线;Step4另线起针编织右翅膀完成后断线;Step5另线起针编织下半身;Step6绕主体编织一圈(可边织边把线头藏在短针下);Step7换线在头部起针织鸟嘴。符号:锁针=ch,短针=sc,中长针=hdc,长针=dc,短针加针=sc inc,短针减针=sc dec,引拔。
patterns.notes: A flat crocheted dove/flying-bird motif (hanging ornament). Built from several separately started sections (head, upper body + left wing, right wing, lower body) joined and edged with a final sc round, then a contrast beak. Design by @嘎嘎毛线球.

meta.intro: A flat crocheted dove / flying-bird ornament worked as a color-block appliqué: a light, airy hanging decoration.
materials: Yarn in white plus a contrast color for the beak

faq.question: How is the bird put together?
faq.answer: It is built from several separately started sections — head, upper body with left wing, right wing and lower body — then joined and finished with a single sc round all around.

faq.question: How do I add the beak?
faq.answer: A short chain is laid in at the head while working, then the beak is crocheted onto it in a contrasting color at the end.

patterns.englishText:
Granny-Stitch Storage Basket

(f = hdc, v/fv = hdc increase [2 hdc in one st], x = sc, k = skip, sl = sl st)

Rnd 1: 12 hdc in a ring (12)
Rnd 2: hdc-inc in each st around (24)
Rnd 3: *hdc, hdc-inc*, repeat around (36)
Rnd 4: *hdc, hdc-inc, hdc*, repeat around (48)
Rnd 5: work the sides in granny/openwork clusters — *hdc cluster, skip 3 sts*, repeat around
Rnds 6-10: repeat Rnd 5
Rnd 11 (handles): 15 sc, ch 15, skip 9 sts, 15 sc, ch 15, skip 9 sts, sl st
Rnd 12: sc in each st around, no inc/dec
Rnd 13: reverse sc (crab stitch) around to finish the edge
patterns.chineseText: 祖母格收纳篮（参考原创 Casahande）。R1:12f；R2:12fv；R3:12(f.fv)；R4:12(f.fv.f)；R5:fw,k3,fw,k3…循环一圈；R6-R10:同R5；R11:15x,15ch,k9,15x,15ch,k9,sl；R12:不加不减一圈短针；R13:一圈反钩短针收边

meta.intro: A round granny-stitch storage basket in retro Morandi colors: a sturdy little bowl for holding trinkets, jewelry or desk odds and ends.
materials: 8-ply wool yarn in 4 colors (peacock blue, dew, Roman red, camel)

faq.question: How does the basket hold its shape?
faq.answer: The flat hdc base (Rounds 1-4) is worked firmly, then the granny/cluster sides are built straight up so the walls stand on their own; a stiffer wool helps.

faq.question: Where do the color changes happen?
faq.answer: The multicolor granny look comes from changing yarn colors on the cluster rounds of the sides.

title: Star Charm & Milk-Tea Net Bag
description:
平常可以当做挂件挂在包包上，外出游玩时，没喝完的奶茶，又不想一直拿在手上，就可以把挂件变成一个网兜包，用来放奶茶，一物两用。

**标签**: 钩针包包, 钩织, 钩针, 钩针编织, 钩针毛线, 毛线编织, 钩针图解, 钩织图解, lifeyarn
author: 陈甜甜慢点点

patterns.englishText:
Star Charm & Milk-Tea Net Bag

(X = sc, V = inc, T = tr, F = hdc, E/sl = sl st, k = skip)

Net bag body:
Rnd 1: Hold the two star pieces with right sides together (wrong sides out) and begin seaming. Join the first 70 stitches through the outer half-loops of both pieces with sc. For the last 15 stitches (the opening), sc through the front loop of the near piece only — leave this open.
Rnd 2: ch 1, *2 sc, ch 10, skip 7, 1 sc, ch 10, skip 7*, repeat x5 (on the final ch 10, work ch 5 + 1 sl st instead).
Rnd 3: ch 1, *1 sc, ch 10*, repeat x10 (final ch 10 = ch 5 + 1 sl st).
Rnds 4-12: repeat Rnd 3.
Rnd 13: ch 1, *1 sc, ch 6*, repeat x10, sl st.
Rnd 14: ch 1, *1 sc, 7 sc into the ch space*, repeat x10, sl st.
Rnd 15 (strap): ch 60, skip 19, 1 sl st. Make a second strap on the opposite side.
Colors: Rnds 1-4 one color, Rnds 5-9 second color, Rnds 10-15 third color.

Star (make 10 in assorted colors):
Rnd 1: 5 sc in magic ring (5)
Rnd 2: inc in each st (10)
Rnd 3: *[ch 4, starting in 2nd ch from hook: 1 sc, 1 tr, 1 hdc], skip 1, 1 sl st*, repeat x5.
Adjust the chain length as needed, then sl-st the finished stars onto the bag body.
patterns.chineseText: 星星挂件/奶茶网兜包。R1:两片星星正面相对缝合，前70针两边外半针缝合，最后15针只钩靠近自己一片的前半针留出开口。R2:1ch,[2X,10ch,k7,1X,10ch,k7]*5(最后10ch用5ch+1E替代)。R3:1ch,[1X,10ch]*10。R4-R12:repR3。R13:1ch,[1X,6ch]*10,sl。R14:1ch,[1X,7X(锁针上)]*10,sl。R15提手:60ch,k19,1sl。星星R1:环起5X;R2:5V;R3:{[4ch,倒2钩1X,1T,1F],k1,1sl}*5
patterns.notes: Doubles as a bag charm and, opened up, a net pouch to hold a drink cup. Yarn: 4-ply milk cotton. Colors: cheese + light yellow + duckling yellow (main), persimmon + carrot (accent). Hook 3.0mm.

meta.intro: A two-in-one star charm that opens into a stretchy net pouch for a drink cup: clip it to a bag as a decoration, or use it to carry a bubble-tea cup.

faq.question: How is it both a charm and a bag?
faq.answer: Two star pieces are seamed together with a chain-mesh net worked around them; the openwork net stretches to hold a cup, and folds flat into a star charm when empty.

faq.question: How many little stars do I need?
faq.answer: Make 10 small five-point stars in assorted colors and slip-stitch them onto the bag body as decoration.

description:

author: 十三斤甜瓜

patterns.englishText:
Croissant Bag — Triangle Motif Charts (A & B)

Symbol charts for the two triangle motifs. Make 6 of Motif A and 1 of Motif B.
Motif A color sequence: Round 1 purple, Round 2 pink, Round 3 dark green.
Motif B is worked entirely in dark green.
Chart symbols used: chain (ch), single crochet (sc), double crochet (dc), treble (tr) and 3-dc bobbles; brackets = several stitches worked in the same stitch. See the written text pattern for the round-by-round stitch counts.
Legend: open triangle = starting stitch, filled triangle = fastening-off stitch.
patterns.chineseText: 牛角包符号图解（韩文原版）。모티브 A/B = 花片 A/B；색상 배색표 = 配色表；3단 다크그린/2단 핑크/1단 퍼플；모티브 6개 = 钩6片A；시작 코/마무리 코 = 起针/收针。
patterns.notes: Symbol chart from the original Korean pattern. Pairs with the Chinese written pattern (same design). The triangle motifs are assembled into two trapezoid panels for the croissant/horn bag.

patterns.englishText:
Croissant Bag — Joining Motifs & Edging

Arrange 3 triangle motifs into one large trapezoid panel (A-A-A) and join, then work the top edge in dark green using groups of sc and dc.
Assembly: hold the front and back panels with wrong sides together and join with a whip/sc seam, leaving the top opening unjoined (about 23 stitches across the opening, with 5 stitches free at each corner).
Attach Motif B (the small triangular flap) to the back of the opening with a seam, and sew a button in the marked position to finish.
patterns.chineseText: 牛角包组合与收边图解（韩文）。모티브 연결하고 가장자리 뜨기 = 拼花片并钩边；앞판과 뒤판 연결하기 = 前后片缝合；입구 부분 23코 제외 = 留出袋口23针；단추 다는 위치 = 纽扣位置。
patterns.notes: Assembly/edging symbol chart from the original Korean pattern. ⊗ marks the button position.

patterns.englishText:
Croissant Bag — Written Pattern

Stitch key (as defined by this designer): CH = chain, F = dc, X = sc, E = tr, FQ = 3-dc bobble, FW = 3-dc group, FV = dc increase (2 dc in one st), SL = sl st, [ ] = all worked in the same stitch.

Motif A (make 6):
Rnd 1: In a magic ring: ch 3 (counts as first dc), 4 dc, [ch 2, tr, ch 2] in ring for corner, *5 dc, [ch 2, tr, ch 2] corner*, repeat x2, sl st to join.
Rnd 2: change color at the join, ch 1, *5 sc, ch 2, 3-dc bobble, ch 3, sc, ch 3, 3-dc bobble, ch 2*, repeat x3, sl st.
Rnd 3: change color at a bobble, ch 1, *sc, 5 dc, sc, [3-dc group, ch 1, tr, ch 1, 3-dc group] in same st*, repeat x3, sl st.

Motif B (make 1):
Rnd 1: In a magic ring: ch 3, 4 dc, ch 1, (5 dc, ch 1) x2, join.
Rnd 2: ch 3, working into the R1 ch-space: 1 dc, *5 dc, [dc-inc, ch 1, dc-inc] corner*, repeat x2, 5 dc, into the first ch-space [dc-inc, ch], sl st.
Rnd 3: ch 3, into the R2 ch-space: 1 dc, *9 dc, [dc-inc, ch 1, dc-inc] corner*, repeat x2, 9 dc, into the first ch-space [dc-inc, ch 1], sl st.

Assembly: Slip-stitch three small motifs together into a large triangle, then work a round of sc around the outer edge. Seam the two large panels together (slip-stitch seam). Sew Motif B onto a suitable spot and add a button — main body complete.

Strap: ch 3, then work back picking up loops to make a chunky crochet cord (3 loops on the hook; pull through the loops one at a time, reinserting each time), repeating to the desired length (about 20cm), then pull through all loops, cut and tighten, and seam the ends into a ring. A simple chain of about 12cm can be substituted.
patterns.chineseText: 牛角包文字图解。针法说明：CH辫子针,F长针,X短针,E长长针,FQ 3针长针枣形针,FW 3针长针,FV长针加针,SL引拔,【】同一个针目内。织片A(6片):R1环起3CH 4F【2CH E 2CH】(5F【2CH E 2CH】)*2 SL;R2 SL位置换线1CH(5X 2CH FQ 3CH X 3CH FQ 2CH)*3 SL;R3枣形针针目换线1CH(X 5F X【FW 1CH E 1CH FW】)*3 SL。织片B(1片):R1环起3CH 4F 1CH(5F 1CH)*2;R2 3CH 1F(5F【FV 1CH FV】)*2 5F【FV CH】SL;R3 3CH 1F(9F【FV 1CH FV】)*2 9F【FV 1CH】SL。
patterns.notes: Full written pattern for the croissant/horn bag. Note this design defines F = dc and E = tr (different from many patterns). Make 6 of Motif A + 1 of Motif B.

meta.intro: A crocheted croissant (horn) shoulder bag built from granny-style triangle motifs, finished with a chunky crochet-cord strap and a button-flap closure.
materials: Yarn in purple, pink and dark green

faq.question: How many motifs do I need?
faq.answer: Make 6 of the triangle Motif A and 1 of Motif B; the A motifs are joined into two trapezoid panels and Motif B becomes the flap.

faq.question: The written pattern uses unusual letters — what do they mean?
faq.answer: This designer's key defines F as double crochet and E as treble crochet, which differs from many patterns, so read the stitch key before starting.

Pikmin Parts — Antenna, Arm, Eyes, Flower Bud & Calyx

Rnd 16: *3 sc, inc* x6 (30)

Rnd 22: *4 sc, dec* x6 (30)
Rnd 23: *3 sc, dec* x6 (24)
Rnd 24: *2 sc, dec* x6 (18)
Rnd 25: *sc, dec* x6 (12)

patterns.chineseText: 皮克敏（粉色/翅膀款）腿-身体-头部一体钩织，及眼睛。

patterns.englishText:
Pink Pikmin — Arm, Wing & Flower

Arm (x2):
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: 5 sc (5)
Rnd 3: skip 1, 4 sc (miss then 4 sc)
Rnd 4: 4 sc (4)

Wing (x2):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x2, hdc, <dc, hdc in the same stitch>, (sc, inc) x3

Flower:
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: *ch 2, dc, tr, dc, ch 2, sl st* x5 (5 petals)

Flower calyx (cup): *ch 3 + sl st 2* x5.

patterns.chineseText: 皮克敏（粉色）手臂、翅膀、花朵。

patterns.englishText:
Rock Pikmin — Materials, Symbols, Assembly & Piece D

Hook: 2.20mm (size 3/0).
Yarn colors: dark gray, gray, light green, white.

Symbol key: mr = magic ring, o = chain (ch), X = sc, dot = sl st, V = increase, ∧ = decrease, hdc-V symbol = hdc increase.

Pieces needed (rock facets): A' x2, A x2, B x2, C' x2, C x4, D x1, E x1. Sew the lettered facets together as shown in the assembly photo to form the rock body.

Piece D:
Rnd 1: 6 sc in mr (6)
Rnds 2-3: 6 sc (6)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* x2 (8)
Rnds 5-7: 8 sc (8)
Rnd 8: *3 sc, inc* x2 (10)
Rnds 9-11: 10 sc (10)
Rnd 12: *4 sc, inc* x2 (12)
Rnd 13: 12 sc, then work in FLO (front loop only) (12)
Rnd 14: *sc, hdc-inc* x6 (18)
Rnd 15: *2 sc, hdc-inc* x6 (24)
Rnd 16: *3 sc, hdc-inc* x6 (30)
Rnd 17: *4 sc, hdc-inc* x6 (36)
Rnd 18: *5 sc, hdc-inc* x6 (42)
Fill the horn/point with a small amount of stuffing.
patterns.chineseText: 岩石皮克敏：材料、符号说明、缝合参考、D 片。
patterns.notes: Rock Pikmin (gray). Design by @qmld_. Hook 2.2mm; colors dark gray, gray, light green, white. Body is assembled from separately crocheted facet pieces A-E.

patterns.englishText:
Rock Pikmin — Piece A' (x2) and Piece A (x2)

Both worked flat: for Rounds 1-8, start each row with ch 1 and turn to work back the opposite way. Finish Round 8 with a sl st in the first stitch to join.

Piece A' (x2):
Row 1: ch 8
Row 2: 8 sc
Row 3: 6 sc, dec
Rows 4-6: 7 sc
Row 7: 5 sc, dec
Row 8: 6 sc
Row 9: ch 1, 7 sc, ch 1, 8 sc, ch 1, 7 sc, ch 1, sl st (edging around)

Row 1: ch 8
Row 2: 8 sc
Row 3: dec, 6 sc
Rows 4-6: 7 sc
Row 7: dec, 5 sc
Row 8: 6 sc
Row 9: ch 1, 7 sc, ch 1, 8 sc, ch 1, 7 sc, ch 1, sl st (edging around)

patterns.englishText:
Rock Pikmin — Piece C (x4) and Piece C' (x2)

Both worked flat: for Rounds 1-6, start each row with ch 1 and turn to work the opposite way. Finish Round 7 with a sl st in the first stitch to join.

Row 5: 5 sc, inc

Row 2: 5 sc
Row 3: 5 sc

patterns.englishText:

Rock Pikmin — Piece E, Leg, Arm & Assembly

Rnds 2-6: 5 sc (5)

(Korean stitch terms: X = sc, V = inc, ∧ = dec; hooks: size 3/0 for red/blue/yellow Pikmin, size 2/0 for white Pikmin. For the white Pikmin, decrease by 1 fewer stitch on Rnds 5-6, 8-9, 20-21, 32-33 and 35-37, i.e. 5 rounds total.)

Red Pikmin nose: double chain of 4.

Pikmin eyes (x2): ch 4, sc 2, then 2 sc in one stitch, 2 sc; use cut felt for the black pupil.

patterns.chineseText: 皮克敏（韩文原版 @qlsxx_ei）身体-头部、备注、红/白皮克敏眼、叶子。使用 코바늘=钩针；단=圈；사슬=锁针；짧은뜨기=短针;긴뜨기=中长针;한길긴뜨기=长针;두길긴뜨기=长长针。

patterns.englishText:
Pikmin — Flower Bud, Calyx, Arm, Leg & Yellow Pikmin Ear

Flower bud:
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st (12)
Rnds 3-4: 12 sc (12)
Rnd 5: 6 dec (6)

Flower calyx (base): *ch 3 + sl st 2* x5. Leave a long tail and shape by sewing.

Arm (x2): double chain of 14 — leave a long tail, then sew the 4th chain from the end to the tail to connect.
Leg (x2): double chain of 9 — leave a long tail, then sew the 4th chain from the end to the tail to connect.
(Because the tails come out at the fingertips/foot tips, use a new strand of yarn when attaching the arms and legs to the body.)

Yellow Pikmin ear (x2): ch 7, sc1, hdc1, dc2, [in one stitch: dc1, hdc1, dc1], dc2, hdc1, sc1, sl st in the first stitch to finish.

Attach the flower buds and calyx with a small amount of glue. Do not weave the tails in — instead use them to sew the parts on, or use glue.
patterns.chineseText: 皮克敏（韩文 @qlsxx_ei）花苞、花托、手臂、腿、黄皮克敏耳朵。이중사슬=双重锁针链;사슬=锁针;짧은뜨기=短针;긴뜨기=中长针;한길긴뜨기=长针。

meta.intro: Amigurumi Pikmin from the Nintendo game: small stem-like creatures topped with a leaf, bud or flower, in several colors including purple, a winged pink one, a rock Pikmin, and red/blue/yellow/white variants.

faq.question: How is the rock Pikmin made?
faq.answer: Its faceted body is crocheted as separate lettered panels (A-E) that are sewn together; stuff with fiberfill before closing with pieces D or E.

faq.question: How are the eyes done?
faq.answer: The small eyes are worked in a magic ring, and the black pupils are cut from felt and attached.

**标签**: 我的手工日常, 手工钩织, 蕾丝线, 钩织小物, 小围巾, 小领巾, 小围巾钩织, 钩织装饰, 针织手作, 蕾丝线钩织
author: Cheerful的手作日记📝

patterns.englishText:
Lace Collar — Pineapple Lace Edging

Symbol chart (no text). Worked flat in rows as a long strip of repeating pineapple motifs.

Base: a foundation row of dc mesh worked along a starting chain.
Each pineapple repeat: begin with a fan of dc worked into a stitch, then work a series of ch loops joined with sc that decrease each row to form the pineapple point, separated from the next motif by dc/ch mesh columns and long ch loops along the edges.
Top edge: finished with small dc/ch fans forming a scalloped border.

The chart shows the full motif repeat; continue the repeat to the length needed for the collar. Uses ch, sc and dc throughout.
patterns.chineseText: 蕾丝线小领巾——菠萝花蕾丝符号图解（无文字，纯符号）。
patterns.notes: Delicate pineapple-lace collar worked in fine lace-weight thread. Pure symbol chart with no written text; the chart repeat is shown and is worked lengthwise to the desired collar size.

meta.intro: A dainty pineapple-lace collar worked in fine thread: a delicate removable neckline accent to dress up a blouse or dress.

faq.question: How do I make the collar longer or shorter?
faq.answer: The chart shows one pineapple repeat; simply work more or fewer repeats along the length to fit your neckline.

faq.question: Why does my lace look uneven?
faq.answer: Thread lace benefits from blocking — pin it out and lightly steam or wet-block to open up the pineapple motifs and even out the edges.

patterns.englishText:
Lace Vest (Cardigan-Style) — Symbol Chart & Schematic

Symbol key: chain (ch), single crochet (sc), double crochet (dc), dc2tog (2 dc worked together), dc3tog (3 dc worked together), picot, plus a work-direction arrow.
Materials: 6-ply merino wool, 3.5mm hook, about 3 balls.

The garment is worked as an open-front lace vest in a fan/shell pattern. The chart shows three pieces — left front, back and right front — worked from the lower edge upward in rows, using shell groups of dc separated by ch spaces, with armhole and neckline shaping (rows 1-18 charted).
The schematic gives dimensions in stitches/rows: body about 136 base stitches, armhole and neck shaping worked over the upper rows.
A tie (系带) is added at the front to close the vest.
patterns.chineseText: 开衫背心符号图解及裁片图。符号说明:锁针=ch,短针=sc,长针=dc,长针两针并一针=dc2tog,长针三针并一针=dc3tog,钩芽针=picot,编织方向。用线6股美丽诺羊毛,3.5mm钩针,3团。左前/右前/系带。
patterns.notes: Baby/child open-front lace vest. 6-ply merino, 3.5mm hook, ~3 balls. Worked in a dc shell/fan lace with left-front, back and right-front sections plus a front tie.

patterns.englishText:
Little Garment — Lace Pattern Chart & Schematic

Symbol chart for a shell/fan lace body worked in rows. Start with a foundation chain of 81 (锁 81 针). The main pattern repeats every 4 rows and every 8 stitches. Two colors alternate (color a / color b).
Edging A is worked first around the lower body (6 stitches = 1 pattern repeat); edging B finishes the neckline/front (2 stitches over 1 pattern). Work-direction and join/cut markers are shown on the chart (open triangle = join yarn, filled triangle = cut yarn).
The schematic gives finished measurements: about 10.5cm / 14cm / 10.5cm across the body sections and 11cm panel heights, with neck and armhole shaping charted.
Uses ch, sc and dc shell groups throughout.
patterns.chineseText: 小衣服花样编织符号图解及尺寸图（书籍扫描页）。接线/剪断线标记;缘编A/B;a色/b色;花样编织 4行1花样,8针1花样;锁81针起。
patterns.notes: Book-scan chart page for a child's lace garment. Foundation chain 81 (10 pattern repeats); 4-row / 8-stitch shell repeat in two alternating colors with A and B edgings.

patterns.englishText:
Matching Baby Booties — Lace Pattern Chart & Schematic

Symbol chart for booties worked in a shell/fan lace.
Sole: begin with ch 9 and work outward in rounds of sc to form the oval sole.
Sides/instep: pick up 56 stitches (14 pattern repeats) and work the shell lace upward — the chart shows the side (侧面), instep (鞘背) and top sections, finished with a scalloped edging row.
The pattern repeat is 13.5cm = 8 repeats. Schematic heights: sole ~4cm, side ~2.5cm (3 rows), instep ~3cm (4 rows), top ~0.5cm.
Uses ch, sc and dc shell groups; join/cut markers shown on the chart.
patterns.chineseText: 配套小鞋（婴儿鞋）花样编织符号图解及尺寸图。13.5cm=8花样;缘编织;鞋/鞋背/侧面/底;9针起针;56针14花样。
patterns.notes: Baby booties to match the lace garment. Oval sole from ch 9, then 56 sts (14 repeats) of shell lace up the sides and instep. Book-scan chart with cm/row dimensions.

meta.intro: A baby lace set: an open-front vest worked in a shell/fan lace with a front tie, plus matching lace booties.

faq.question: How is the vest shaped?
faq.answer: It is worked in three sections — left front, back and right front — from the lower edge up in a dc shell lace, with armhole and neck shaping, then closed with a front tie.

faq.question: Do the booties match?
faq.answer: Yes — the booties use the same shell lace: an oval sole from a starting chain, then the sides and instep worked up in the pattern.

patterns.englishText:
Seahorse Applique

Finished height: 2¼ in (57 mm). Thread: 3 yds (2.7 m). Worked in rounds around a foundation chain.

Foundation chain: ch 14.
Rnd 1: Starting in 3rd ch from hook, sc in 11 ch, and 5 sc in 1 ch (at end). Continuing around the other side of the chain, sc in 11 ch. Join with sl st in ch-2 point.
Rnd 2: ch 18. Starting in 3rd ch from hook, sl st in 3 ch. [ch 2, sl st] in 9 ch. [ch 3, skip 1 ch, and sc in 1 ch] twice (tail complete). Returning to the body, skip 1 ch, and sl st in 4 sc. [sl st, ch 5, dc] in 1 sc. [ch 3, dc] in 1 sc. ch 3. [dc, ch 5, sl st] in 1 sc. sl st in 7 sc. [ch 2, sl st] in 2 sc. ch 2. dc in 1 sc. ch 5. sc in 2nd ch of ch 5, and sl st in 1st ch of ch 5. [hdc, ch 1, sl st] in same sc as last dc. sl st in 3 sc. sc in 1 sc, hdc in 1 sc, and dc in 1 sc. 3 dc in 1 sc. dc in 1 sc, hdc in 1 sc, sc in 1 sc, and sl st in 1 sl st. Fasten off; weave in ends.
patterns.chineseText: 海洋生物图解——海马（英文原版书）。围绕起始锁针钩织。
