**标签**: #钩针背心 #手工编织毛衣 #编织图解 #钩针花片 #图解分享 #钩针 #钩针蕾丝 #针织手作 #织女的聚会 #织女
author: 西南费雯丽

patterns.englishText:
Lace Lemon-Yellow Vest — Pattern Info, Schematic & Stitch Chart

Yarn: linen (yellow), ~200g. Hook: 4/0 (about 2.5mm).
Finished: length 50 cm, yoke depth 24.5 cm. Gauge: 1 pattern repeat = 3.3 cm; 8.5 rows = 10 cm.

Construction:
- Back & front are worked in the lace pattern stitch. Begin at the shoulders on a chain foundation; work 4 rows on each shoulder, then add the neckline chain and continue. From row 5, work the left and right sides together.
- Work the front by picking up sts from the back foundation, the same way.
- Hem: edge with border A.
Finishing: edge the sides with border B; work the collar back and forth in border B. Make 4 dc ribbons/ties and sew them to the wrong side at the marked spots.

Pattern stitch: 10 sts = 1 repeat, 4 rows = 1 vertical repeat — dc shells/fans with ch mesh (see chart).
patterns.chineseText: 蕾丝柠檬黄背心 图解页(日文):材料Puppy Linen100 黄905约200g,4/0号钩针;成品衣长50cm,肩深24.5cm;密度1花样=3.3cm,10cm=8.5段。含前后身/衣领/缎带schematic与花样符号图(10目1花样,4段)。
patterns.notes: Lace vest. 4/0 hook, linen yarn ~200g. Body in a 10-st lace repeat; borders A and B for hem/sides/collar; 4 dc ties sewn on. Symbol chart carries stitch placement.

patterns.englishText:
Lace Lemon Vest — Body Lace Stitch Chart (hem section, worked as charted)

The body lace is a shell-and-mesh pattern:
- Row: work a fan/shell of dc (about 7 dc) into a ch space, ch, sc into the next space, ch — repeat across (10-st repeat).
- Next rows: stack shells over the ch spaces of the previous row, offset so open diamonds form between the fans.
- Hem edge: a row of scalloped dc shells finishes the bottom.
Symbols: oval = ch, + = sc, T with bars = dc/tr fans.
patterns.chineseText: 蕾丝柠檬背心 身片蕾丝花样符号图(下摆),扇形贝壳花样+锁针网格,底部扇形边。
patterns.notes: Shell-and-mesh lace, 10-st repeat, with a scalloped shell hem. Follow the chart for exact fan counts.

patterns.englishText:
Lace Lemon Vest — Body Schematic (Fig 1) + Borders A & B (worked as charted)

Body layout (Fig 1): rectangular front/back with an oval neck opening worked around; about 49 sts are picked up along each side of the opening for the shoulders/straps.
Border A: fan-shell edging, 10 sts = 1 repeat (used at the hem).
Border B: smaller shell edging, 8 sts = 1 repeat (used at the sides and collar).
Both borders are rows of dc shells separated by sc, giving a scalloped edge.
Symbols: oval = ch, + = sc, T with bar = dc.
patterns.chineseText: 蕾丝柠檬背心 身片schematic(1图,椭圆领口,每侧约49目)+边缘A(10目1花样)/边缘B(8目1花样)符号图。
patterns.notes: Schematic plus the two edging charts. Border A (10-st repeat) hem; border B (8-st repeat) sides/collar. Oval neckline picks up ~49 sts per side.

meta.intro: A delicate open-lace vest worked in a shell-and-mesh stitch, with picot borders and four ties. A lightweight layer for spring and summer.

faq.question: What hook and yarn does this vest use?
faq.answer: A 2.5mm (4/0) hook with about 200g of a fine linen yarn.

faq.question: How is the vest constructed?
faq.answer: Back and front are worked in a 10-stitch lace repeat starting at the shoulders, then edged with two shell borders; four dc ties are sewn on.

title: Lace Bridal Veil
description:
"给自己钩一个头纱是不是很酷"

虽然不知道未来戴上它的那一刻是什么感觉，但是从拿起钩针的那一刻开始，就已经感觉到幸福啦！

图解来自一本日本古早的钩织杂志《毛线球30--婚礼服饰编织》
钩针🪡：1mm
毛线🧵：奥林巴斯金票40号微钩线

**标签**: #钩针蕾丝 #织女 #钩针 #新娘蓬蓬头纱 #蕾丝花边 #头巾 #毛线球 #微钩 #编织 #针织手作
author: 唔西迪西ddd

patterns.englishText:
Lace Bridal Veil — Motif Layout & Flower Motifs A & B (worked as charted)

Layout: the veil (about 80 x 51 cm) is built from joined rows of circular flower motifs (bands a-f).
Flower motif (A/B):
Rnd 1: MR, ch, work a ring of dc (center wheel), join
Rnd 2-3: ch arches around, then dc groups forming petals
Rnd 4-5: pineapple/fan clusters of dc with picot tips around the edge
Join-as-you-go: connect each new motif to its neighbors at the outer picot loops while working the last round.
Symbols: oval = ch, dot = picot, T with bar = dc; triangle ▷ = join new yarn.
patterns.chineseText: 钩织头纱 花样布局(连接带子a-f,80×51cm)+编织花样A/B(圆形花朵花片,边缘拉针连接)。▷=加线。
patterns.notes: Fine-thread bridal veil made of many joined circular flower motifs (~80x51cm). Motifs A and B differ slightly; joined at outer picots as you crochet the final round.

patterns.englishText:
Lace Bridal Veil — Motif Connection Layout (worked as charted)

This diagram shows how the round flower motifs are joined to form the triangular veil.
- Work the circular flower motifs (MR center, dc wheel, ch-arch petals, picot pineapple edging).
- Arrange them in staggered/offset rows and join adjacent motifs at their touching outer picot loops (join-as-you-go on the last round).
- Continue adding motifs row by row, decreasing the count toward the point so the overall shape forms a triangle.
Symbols: oval = ch, dot = picot, T with bar = dc.
patterns.chineseText: 钩织头纱 花片连接布局图(带子连接方法),圆形花朵花片交错拼接成三角形头纱。
patterns.notes: Assembly/connection chart for the veil: staggered round motifs joined at picots into a triangular shape. Motif detail as in the A/B chart (image_5).

meta.intro: An intricate bridal veil built from many joined circular flower lace motifs, joined as you go into a triangular shape.

faq.question: How are the motifs joined?
faq.answer: Each circular flower motif is joined to its neighbors at the outer picot loops while working its final round (join-as-you-go).

faq.question: Is this beginner friendly?
faq.answer: No - it uses fine thread and many joined lace motifs, so it suits experienced crocheters.

title: Chubby Chick
description:

patterns.englishText:
Chubby Chick — Amigurumi

Body (cream):
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 4: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (32)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (40)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc*, repeat around (48)
Rnd 7: BLO, sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 8-12: sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 13: 2 inc, 44 sc, 2 inc (52)
Rnd 14: 2 sc, *4 sc, dec* x8, 2 sc (44)
Rnd 15: 2 dec, 36 sc, 2 dec (40)
Rnd 16: dec, *2 sc, dec* x9, dec (29)
Fold flat and seam closed; leave the last stitch open.

Comb (wine red): (ch 2, hdc inc, ch 2), sl st, (ch, dc, ch), sl st

Beak (ginger yellow): ch 3, pull tight and sew on

Eyes: black, sewn on
patterns.chineseText: 小胖鸡图解。身体:乳白色 R1:环起8x R2:8v R3:(x,v)*8 R4:(x,v,x)*8 R5:(3x,v)*8 R6:(2x,v,2x)*8 R7:BLO(内半针)48x R8-R12:48x R13:2v,44x,2v[52] R14:2x,(4x,A)*8,2x[44] R15:2A,36x,2A[40] R16:A,(2x,A)*9,A[29] 对折缝合,最后一针空着不用管。鸡冠:酒红色 (2ch,fv,2ch),sl,(ch,t,ch),sl。嘴:姜黄色 3ch拉紧缝合。眼睛:黑色缝合。
patterns.notes: Yarn: 7 mm chenille (colors per chart). Hook: 7 mm. Stuffing: approx 150 g. Comb in wine red, beak in ginger yellow, eyes in black.

meta.intro: This chubby little chick is a quick chenille amigurumi with a rounded body, a tiny red comb, and a stubby beak. Its plump shape and squishy yarn make it a fast, satisfying make and a cute desk or shelf companion.
materials: 7 mm chenille yarn (cream body, wine red comb, ginger yellow beak)

faq.question: What yarn and hook does this chick use?
faq.answer: It's worked in 7 mm chenille (velvet) yarn with a 7 mm hook, which gives the body its soft, plush look. Cream is used for the body, wine red for the comb, and ginger yellow for the beak.

faq.question: How is the body finished off at the end?
faq.answer: After the final decrease round, fold the opening flat and seam it closed, leaving the very last stitch open so you can shape and close the body neatly.

faq.question: Why does Round 7 work in back loops only (BLO)?
faq.answer: Working Round 7 in BLO creates a defined ridge that sets the base of the body and helps the chick sit flat, separating the bottom from the sides.

faq.question: How much stuffing should I use?
faq.answer: The pattern calls for about 150 g of stuffing. Because chenille is bulky and stretchy, stuff firmly so the round body holds its shape without the stitches gaping.

title: Bikini Bottom Character
description:
#钩针图解 #图解 #比奇堡

**标签**: 钩针图解, 图解, 比奇堡
author: 你

patterns.englishText:
Bikini Bottom Character — Amigurumi Doll

Fins (Tunisian / afghan technique):
Row 1: ch 13, working from 2nd ch from hook, work 12 incomplete sc, draw through 2 at a time — repeat the draw-off 12 times.
Row 2: ch 1, 11 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x6, continue forward into 6 more incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x11.
Row 3: ch 1, 11 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x11.
Row 4: ch 1, 10 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x10.
Row 5: ch 1, 8 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x8. Sew at center back, between blue rounds 2 and beyond.
Row 6: ch 1, 7 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x7. Sew at center back, between blue rounds 2 and beyond.

Eye Whites (3-ply yarn, 1.8 mm hook, 3 mm eyes):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3-4: 12 sc around (12)
Work with wrong side out.

Eyelids (2-ply yarn, 1.8 mm hook, work loosely):
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: *sc, inc* x4 (12)
Rnd 3-5: 12 sc around (12)
Insert eye whites into the eyelids.

Mouth: ch 11, from 2nd ch from hook, (sl st, sc, tr, tr-inc, tr, tr-inc, tr, sc, sl st), ch 2; repeat the bracketed sequence along the opposite side, ch 2, sl st. Fold with wrong side inside; sew at center, mouth corners at blue Rnd 3, mid-section at Rnd 4.

Eyebrows: ch 5, from 2nd ch from hook, sc, 3 sl st

Spots (1-ply yarn, hook under 1.0 mm):
Large: ch 5, from 2nd ch from hook, 4 sc, (ch, 4 sc, ch 1), sl st
Small: ch 4, join first and last
patterns.chineseText: 比奇堡系列(海超人/泡泡精灵风格人偶)。鳍(阿富汗针法):1.13ch倒2,12个未完成x,两两退出,退12次。2.1ch,11个未完成义(x),两两退出6次,继续往前钩6个未完成x,两两退出,11次。3.1ch,11个未完成x,两两退出,11次。4.1ch,10个未完成x,两两退出,10次。5.1ch,8个未完成x,两两退出,8次。缝在后中,蓝色第2-个圈之间。6.1ch,7个未完成x,两两退出,7次。缝在后中,蓝色第2-个圈之间。眼白(3股线1.8针0.3m眼睛):R1:环起6x R2:6v R3-4:12x 反面在外。眼皮(2股线1.8针钩松点):R1:环起8x R2:4(x,v) R3-5:12x 把眼白装到眼皮里。嘴:11ch,倒2,(sl,x,T,TV,T,TV,T x,sl,)2ch,对面重复括号里面的针法2ch,sl,对折反面在里,缝在正中嘴角在蓝色第3圈,中间部分在第4圈。眉毛:5ch,倒2,x,3sl。斑点(1股线1.0以下钩针):大.5ch倒2.4x,(ch,4x,1ch,s2 小.4ch.首尾相连。
patterns.notes: Made in blue, white, and pink. Eye whites use 3-ply yarn with 1.8 mm hook and 3 mm safety eyes; eyelids use 2-ply yarn. Spots worked with very fine (<1.0 mm) hook and single-ply yarn. Fins use Tunisian/afghan crochet.

meta.intro: This amigurumi doll recreates a beloved Bikini Bottom character, built from separately worked features like detailed eyes, mouth, fins, and spots that are sewn onto the body. The expressive face pieces and Tunisian-crochet fins give it a lot of personality despite its small parts.

faq.question: What crochet techniques do I need to know for this doll?
faq.answer: Besides standard amigurumi rounds, the fins are worked in Tunisian (afghan) crochet using incomplete single crochets that you draw off two at a time, so some familiarity with Tunisian technique helps.

faq.question: Why are the eyes made from two separate pieces?
faq.answer: The eyes use a white inner piece (eye whites) worked wrong-side-out with a 3 mm safety eye, then inserted into a separate eyelid piece worked loosely in 2-ply yarn, which layers them for an expressive look.

faq.question: What yarn weights and hooks are used across the parts?
faq.answer: It's a fine-yarn project: eye whites use 3-ply yarn with a 1.8 mm hook, eyelids use 2-ply yarn, and the tiny spots use single-ply yarn with a hook under 1.0 mm.

faq.question: How are the facial features positioned on the body?
faq.answer: Use the blue rounds as landmarks: the mouth corners sit at blue Round 3 with the mid-section at Round 4, and the fins are sewn at center back from blue Round 2 upward.

title: Little Cockroach
description:
可爱小蟑螂
原创@糖果小麓手作

**标签**: 无
author: 阿慧手作

patterns.englishText:
Little Cockroach — Amigurumi

Head:
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 4: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (32)
Rnd 5-8: 32 sc around (32)
Rnd 9: 9 sc, 4 inc, 6 sc, 4 inc, 9 sc (40)
Rnd 10-11: 40 sc around (40)
Rnd 12: 9 sc, 4 dec, 6 sc, 4 dec, 9 sc (32)
Rnd 13: *sc, dec, sc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 14: *sc, dec*, repeat around (16)

Body:
Rnd 15: change color, work in front loops only: 16 sc (16)
Rnd 16: *sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 17: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (32)
Rnd 18-20: 32 sc around (32)
Rnd 21: *sc, dec, sc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 22: 24 sc around (24)
Rnd 23: *sc, dec*, repeat around (16)
Rnd 24-25: 16 sc around (16)
Rnd 26: 8 dec (8)

Wings (make 2):
Row 1: ch 9, from 2nd ch from hook: 2 dc, 4 hdc, dc, (3 sc), dc, 4 hdc, 2 dc
Row 2: 7 sc, 3 inc, 7 sc
Row 3: 7 sc, 6 inc, 7 sc

Legs (make 2): ch 3, from 3rd ch from hook sl st, ch 2
patterns.notes: Body color changes at Rnd 15 (worked in front loops only). Wings and legs made in pairs.

meta.intro: This cheeky little cockroach amigurumi has a rounded head, a tapered body, and a pair of small wings and legs for a playful, slightly goofy look. It's a fun novelty make that comes together quickly from a few simple pieces.

faq.question: How are the head and body connected?
faq.answer: After finishing the head, you change color and work Round 15 into the front loops only, which creates a clean ridge where the body begins and gives the join a defined edge.

faq.question: How many wings and legs do I need to make?
faq.answer: Make two wings and two legs. The wings are worked as short rows starting from a foundation chain, and the legs are tiny chains with a slip stitch.

faq.question: What stitches are used in the wings?
faq.answer: The wings use a mix of double crochet, half double crochet, and single crochet across the first row to shape a curved wing, then single crochet and increases to widen them.

faq.question: Does the pattern specify yarn or hook size?
faq.answer: No yarn brand or hook size is stated in the pattern, so choose a yarn and a hook one size smaller than the ball band recommends to keep the amigurumi fabric tight and the stuffing hidden.

title: Horse Pendant
description:
小马挂件，附图解

**标签**: #马年小马已就位 #一起来钩织 #钩针挂件 #钩针小物 #小马 #我的小马驹 #钩针图解 #钩织的乐趣
author: 玩儿个毛线吖（接🥚）

patterns.englishText:
Horse Pendant — Complete Pattern

Body (make 2 pieces):
Row 1: Ch 5, starting in 2nd ch from hook, 4 sc in back bumps (4)
Row 2: Turn, sc, inc, 2 sc (5)
Rows 3-4: Turn, 5 sc. Fasten off. (5)

Make a second piece (Rows 1-4) but do NOT fasten off, continue:
Row 5: Turn, 4 sc, inc, ch 6, join to first piece, inc, 4 sc (18 including chain)
Rows 6-11: Turn, 18 sc (18)
Row 12: Turn, 16 sc, dec (17)
Row 13: Turn, dec, 14 sc, inc (17)
Row 14: Turn, dec, 14 sc, inc (17)
Row 15: Turn, dec, 6 sc, inc, ch 5 (for head)
Row 16: Starting in 2nd ch from hook, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc, dec
Row 17: Turn, dec, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc
Row 18: Turn, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc, dec
Row 19: Turn, dec, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc

Head shaping:
Row 20: Turn, 6 sc, inc, 4 sc, dec
Row 21: Turn, dec, 4 sc, dec
Row 22: Turn, dec, 2 sc, dec
Row 23: Turn, dec twice. Fasten off.

Join two pieces: Sc around the edge, inc at corners. Border with contrasting color sl st around.

Saddle:
Row 1: Ch 10, starting in 2nd ch from hook: 8 sc, 3 sc in last st (corner), 7 sc on other side, inc (20)
Row 2: Inc, 7 hdc, 3 inc, 7 hdc, 2 inc (26)
Row 3: Sc around without inc/dec. Sl st border in accent color. Attach mane and tail.

Coin:
Rnd 1: Ch 21, starting in 2nd ch from hook: *(hdc, dc, tr, sl st)*, repeat 4 times, join in round
Rnd 2: *(4 sc, inc)*, repeat 4 times (make 2 pieces). Sew together with gold thread.

r2：(4X, v)*4钩两片 然后用金线缝合
patterns.notes: X=sc, V=inc, A=dec, W=3sc in 1st, T=hdc, F=dc, E=tr. Flat piece worked in turned rows, then two pieces joined. Add mane and tail with yarn fringe.

meta.intro: A flat crocheted horse charm complete with a saddle and a dangling coin, this little pendant makes a charming bag accessory, keychain, or zipper pull. Worked in turned rows and joined into a two-sided motif, it is a quick decorative project with playful detail.
materials: Yarn (a main color plus a contrasting/accent color for the border)
Gold thread for joining the coin
Yarn needle for sewing and assembly

faq.question: How is the horse assembled?
faq.answer: Make two matching body pieces (Rows 1-4), then continue the second piece through the body and head shaping. Hold the two pieces together and sc around the edge with increases at the corners, then add a contrasting sl st border around the outside.

faq.question: How do I add the mane and tail?
faq.answer: They are added as yarn fringe. Cut short lengths of yarn and attach them along the neck for the mane and at the back for the tail, then trim to length.

faq.question: What does the saddle attach to?
faq.answer: The saddle is worked separately as a small flat piece (Rows 1-3) finished with an accent-color sl st border, then sewn onto the joined horse body.

faq.question: Why does the pattern use letters like X, V, A and W?
faq.answer: These are Chinese-notation symbols mapped in the text: X=sc, V=inc, A=dec, W=3 sc in one stitch, T=hdc, F=dc, E=tr. Translate them to the US terms as you read the chart.

patterns.englishText:
Cherry Blossom & Lily of the Valley Pendant — Step 1: Cherry Blossom Petals

Step 1: MR, (dc, ch 1) x 9, sl st to join
Step 2: Change color. In ch-sp: sc, ch 1. In next ch-sp: (dc, ch 1) x 3. Repeat 5 times for 5 petals.
Steps 3-4: Continue working into spaces to complete 5 petal groups.
Steps 5-7: Work into each dc of previous round to add petal definition.
Step 8: Make 2 cherry blossom pieces.
patterns.chineseText:
1、钩樱花片
1.环起钩9组1个长针、1个锁子针
2.换线，在大洞里钩短针、锁子针
3.下一个大洞里钩长针、锁子针，钩3组
4.钩5组

patterns.notes: Use 2.0mm hook. Color numbers: 40, 04, 12. Photo tutorial showing step-by-step construction.

patterns.englishText:
Cherry Blossom & Lily of the Valley Pendant — Step 2: Lily of the Valley Buds

Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Ch 3, 5 (dc, ch 1) around (5 ch-sps)
Rnd 3: Change color. In each ch-sp: 6 incomplete hdc, yarn over and pull through all loops at once, ch 1 (puff stitch in each space)
Rnd 4: In each space between puffs: sc, 2 dc, sc
Make 4 buds total.
patterns.chineseText:
2、钩铃兰花
1.环起5个短针
2.在二圈每组1个长针1个锁子，3.换线，在大洞里完钩6个未完成中长针，4.一次拉过
5.一个锁针
6.第二圈，在大洞里钩短针、2个长针、短针
7.钩4个
patterns.notes: These are the small bell-shaped lily of the valley flowers that hang from the pendant.

patterns.englishText:
Cherry Blossom & Lily of the Valley Pendant — Step 3: Straps & Assembly

Step 1: Ch 100, leaving long tails on both ends.
Step 2: Attach strap to one cherry blossom piece.
Step 3: Sew two cherry blossom pieces together (wrong sides facing).
Step 4: Make second strap: ch 10, sl st through the first strap loop, continue chaining for the other side.
Step 5: Thread cherry blossom pieces onto the straps.
patterns.chineseText:
3、钩带子
1.先钩100个辫子，两头预留一段线
2.将带子先粘在一片樱花上
3.两片樱花粘一起
4.钩第二条带子，先钩10个锁针，从之前穿过去引拔，继续钩另外一片锁子
5.将樱花分别穿入带子里
patterns.notes: Assembly instructions. The pendant has a main cherry blossom with lily of the valley buds hanging below.

patterns.englishText:
Cherry Blossom & Lily of the Valley Pendant — Complete Written Pattern

Cherry Blossom Piece (make 2):
Rnd 1: MR, ch 4, *(dc, ch 1)*, repeat 9 times, sl st to join (9 dc, 9 ch-sps)
Rnd 2: Change color. *[In first ch-sp: sc, ch 1. In next ch-sp: (dc, ch 1) x 3]*, repeat 5 times (5 petals)
Rnd 3: *[In first dc of petal: sc, hdc, ch 1. In second dc: dc, ch 3, sl st in 3rd ch from hook (picot), ch 3, dc, ch 1. In third dc: hdc, sc]*, repeat 5 times (5 petals with picots)
Make 2 pieces. Sew together through back loops.

Lily of the Valley Bud (make 4):
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Ch 3, *(dc, ch 1)*, repeat 5 times (5 ch-sps)
Rnd 3: Change color. In each of the 6 spaces: 6 incomplete hdc, yarn over and pull through all loops, ch 1 (6 puff stitches)
Rnd 4: Between each puff: *(sc, 2 dc, sc)*, repeat 6 times around
patterns.chineseText:
樱花铃兰花

樱花片：
R1:环起，4CH,(F、CH)*9
R2：换线，[在第1圈洞内钩X、CH，下个洞内(F、CH)*3]*5
R3（在第2圈的第一个F处钩X、T、CH，第二个F处钩F、3CH、SL、3CH、F、CH，第三个F处钩T、X)*5
花片需钩织两片，挑内半针缝合。

铃兰花：
R1:5x
R2:3CH，5（F，CH）
R3:换线，在6个大洞里分别钩6个未完成中长针，一次性拖过所有线圈，锁一针
R4:在两个花瓣中间钩（X，2F，X），重复6次
patterns.notes: Use 2.0mm hook. F=dc, X=sc, T=hdc, CH=ch, SL=sl st. Cherry blossom uses 2 colors (pink center + lighter petals). Lily of the valley uses green + white.

meta.intro: A delicate floral pendant pairing a layered cherry blossom motif with small bell-shaped lily of the valley buds that hang below. Worked in fine thread on a tiny hook, it is a pretty bag charm or necklace accent for anyone who loves dainty botanical crochet.
materials: Fine thread/yarn in pink and a lighter pink for the cherry blossom
Green and white thread for the lily of the valley
Yarn needle for sewing pieces together and attaching straps

faq.question: How many pieces do I need to make?
faq.answer: Make 2 cherry blossom pieces (sewn together through the back loops) and 4 lily of the valley buds that hang from the pendant.

faq.question: How are the picot petals formed?
faq.answer: On the final cherry blossom round, each petal point is shaped with a picot: dc, ch 3, sl st in the 3rd ch from the hook, ch 3, dc. This gives the petals their pointed, scalloped edge.

faq.question: How is the puff-stitch bud made?
faq.answer: Each lily of the valley bud uses a puff: work 6 incomplete hdc into the same space, then yarn over and pull through all loops at once and ch 1 to close. Repeat in each space around for the bell shape.

faq.question: What hook should I use?
faq.answer: The pattern specifies a 2.0mm hook with fine thread; going larger will loosen the lacy petals and make the pendant less crisp.

meta.intro: A single layered cherry blossom worked as a two-sided picot-petal motif with a small leaf and a chained hanging strap. This dainty thread pendant is a lovely bag charm, zipper pull, or necklace accent.

Yarn needle for whip-stitching the two pieces together

faq.question: How are the two flower pieces joined?
faq.answer: Make 2 identical flowers (leave a long tail on the second) and sew them together with wrong sides facing, using a whip stitch through the inner loops.

faq.question: How do I make the petals pointed?
faq.answer: The final round shapes each petal with a picot: ch 1, dc, ch 3, sl st in the 3rd ch from the hook, ch 3, dc, ch 1, framed by hdc and sc. Repeat 5 times around for five pointed petals.

faq.question: Where does the strap attach?
faq.answer: Find the center point of the joined flower, insert the hook from the back, and crochet a chain to your desired hanging length, then sl st through the back to secure.

faq.question: How is the star shape formed?
faq.answer: After working the flat circular base (Rnds 1-4), each of the five points is shaped individually over 8 stitches using decreases (sc2tog) across Rows 5-9, then a sc border is worked around the whole edge.

faq.question: How do I assemble the star fruit?
faq.answer: Make two star pieces, leaving a long tail on one for sewing. Hold them together, stuff lightly as you sew around, then attach the two leaves.

faq.question: What does sc2tog do here?
faq.answer: sc2tog is a single-crochet decrease that works two stitches together as one; it is used at the ends of the point rows to taper each star point to a sharp tip.

faq.question: What yarn works best for this coaster?

faq.question: How is the scalloped edge made?

faq.question: How do I join each round neatly?
faq.answer: After the last sc of the final round, sl st into the first sc of that round to close it; the dc rounds begin with a ch 2 to stand in for the first dc.

faq.question: My hands and feet came out too small. Can I adjust them?

faq.question: How is the body shaped at the bottom?

faq.question: What is the assembly order?

meta.intro: A 24x24 pixel-art chart of a Stardew Valley character, ready to crochet as a coaster, mug rug, or small wall hanging. It's perfect for fans of the game who want to practice color changes in tapestry or corner-to-corner crochet.

faq.question: How do I read the numbers in each cell?
faq.answer: Each number tells you how many consecutive stitches to work in that color before the next color change. It's a run-length count, not a stitch type, so you simply work that many stitches of the indicated color across the row.

faq.question: Should I use tapestry crochet or C2C for this chart?
faq.answer: Either works. Tapestry crochet (worked flat in single crochet, carrying unused colors inside the stitches) gives a denser, pixel-perfect square, while corner-to-corner (C2C) builds the grid on the diagonal in small blocks. Both follow the same 24x24 grid.

faq.question: How do I keep the piece square at 24x24?
faq.answer: Tapestry crochet in single crochet naturally reads close to square, but check your gauge on a small swatch first. If the fabric comes out tall and narrow, go up a hook size or work in half double crochet to widen each cell.

meta.intro: A delicate lace scarf worked in fine thread, shaped like an elongated diamond with tapered points at each end. The airy fan-and-mesh "firework" pattern makes it a lightweight, dressy accessory for spring and summer.

faq.question: Why use such a small 2.0mm hook?
faq.answer: The scarf is worked in fine size 5 lace thread, so a 2.0mm hook keeps the stitches tight enough to hold the open fan-and-mesh pattern crisply. A larger hook would loosen the lace and lose the firework effect.

faq.question: How is the diamond shape formed?

faq.question: Can I make the scarf wider or longer?
faq.answer: Yes. Continue the side increases until you reach the width you want, then add more pattern repeats in the even section to lengthen it before you begin decreasing. The shaping is driven by where you stop increasing.

meta.intro: A versatile collection of 21 small crochet flowers plus 5 matching leaves, ranging from simple single-round blooms to layered, multi-petal designs. They're ideal for appliques, bouquets, brooches, and decorating bags, hats, and home projects.

faq.question: Which flower should a beginner start with?
faq.answer: Start with Flowers 1, 2, or 3. They are single-round or two-round designs worked from a magic ring using only chains, double crochet, and slip stitches, so you get a finished bloom in just a few minutes.

faq.question: How do the two-layer flowers work?
faq.answer: Flowers 9, 15, and 21 use front-loop and back-loop construction. You work the first set of petals into the front loops of a round, then go back and work a second, larger set into the remaining back loops behind them, giving a layered, dimensional bloom.

faq.question: Which leaves go with which flowers?
faq.answer: The collection includes 5 leaves matched to different flowers: Leaf 1 for small potted plants, Leaf 2 for chrysanthemums, Leaf 3 for roses, Leaf 4 for daisies and small flowers, and Leaf 5 (with a stem) for green arrangements.

faq.question: What does "3-dc cluster" mean in Flower 14 and 16?
faq.answer: A cluster joins several incomplete double crochets together at the top into one stitch. For a 3-dc cluster, work three double crochets but stop before the final yarn-over on each, then pull through all loops at once to draw them into a single textured point.

meta.intro: A breezy round summer bag worked in an open lace fan and shell pattern, made from two identical circular pieces seamed together with a decorative flower at the center. It's a light, pretty carry-all for warm-weather outings.

faq.question: How are the two circles joined into a bag?
faq.answer: You make two identical circular pieces, then mark the bag opening position, fold the pieces, and slip-stitch the seam together everywhere except the marked opening. An assembly photo in the pattern shows exactly where to leave the opening.

faq.question: What is the bamboo stick base row for?

faq.question: How do I get the two-tone look?

faq.question: What crochet technique does this placemat use?
faq.answer: It's worked in tapestry crochet, using single crochet throughout while changing colors according to the pixel grid chart. You carry the unused color along inside the stitches so the back stays neat and the cat design appears on the front.

faq.question: What yarn is recommended?

meta.intro: A tiny zip-free pouch sized for earbuds or small earphones, finished with a long crocheted chain strap so it can hang from a bag or wrist. Alternating single and half double crochet rows give it a subtle ridged texture.

faq.question: How is the textured body created?
faq.answer: After the oval base reaches 48 stitches, you alternate full rounds of single crochet and half double crochet (Rnds 5-11). This back-and-forth between two stitch heights produces the gentle horizontal ridges that give the pouch its texture.

faq.question: How do I make the long chain strap?
faq.answer: On Rnd 12 you work a chain of 280 stitches off the body, then on Rnd 13 you slip stitch back into each of those 280 chains, inserting your hook into the back bump of the chain to create a firm, neat strap before finishing the opening edging.

faq.question: How does the bag stay closed?
faq.answer: The opening is shaped on Rnd 12 (skip 3, ch 4) and edged on Rnd 13 with a *ch 3, skip 1, sl st* pull-down border. There's no zipper or button; the snug single/half double crochet fabric and small opening hold the earphones in place.

faq.question: What does BLO mean in the Sunrise cake rounds?
faq.answer: BLO is 'back loop only.' Working those rounds through the back loop creates a crisp ridge that shapes the edge of the cake and helps the sides stand up straight.

faq.question: How are the cream layers and swirls made?
faq.answer: The Mars cake uses popcorn/bobble stitches worked in rounds for the cream, while the Sunrise cake's cream is a long chain (ch 33 and a swirl repeat) shaped into a decorative piped swirl.

faq.question: Can I make just one of the two cakes?

faq.question: Is this a written pattern or a chart?
faq.answer: It's a pixel/grid chart only — 138 x 77 stitches. You read each colored square as one stitch, so you choose your own yarn and hook to set the final size.

faq.question: What technique should I use for this chart?

faq.question: How big will the finished piece be?

meta.intro: A simple little Siamese cat charm worked as a small tube with classic point-colored markings and a tiny bow. Quick to make, it's ideal as a bag pendant, keychain, or zipper pull.

faq.question: How is the body constructed?
faq.answer: It's a simple straight tube worked at 7 sc around for most rounds. You change colors to create the Siamese point coloring, then leave a long tail on the last round to sew it closed.

faq.question: Should I start with 7 or 8 stitches in the magic ring?
faq.answer: Either works — the pattern notes 'MR 7 or 8.' Use 7 for a slimmer charm or 8 if you prefer a touch more room; the body rounds settle to 7 sc.

faq.question: How do I finish the charm?
faq.answer: On the final round, pick up the back loops only (BLO) and cinch/sew the opening closed with the long tail, then attach a bow and a charm ring.

patterns.notes: Rose-shaped water bottle net holder. 4-petal rose design that holds a cup/bottle. Each petal grows larger with increasing chain loops.

meta.intro: A rose-shaped net holder that wraps a water bottle or cup in four crocheted petals, each formed from a growing loop of chains. It doubles as a pretty, reusable bottle carrier you can clip to a bag.

faq.question: How does the rose petal shape form?
faq.answer: Each petal is built from a chain loop that grows every round (ch 3, then 7, 9, 13, 17, 23, 31), with that chain space filled by single crochet. The increasing loops make each petal larger so they curl into a rose that cradles the bottle.

faq.question: What do the symbols in the pattern mean?
faq.answer: The notes give a quick legend: X = single crochet, ch = chain, K1 = skip 1 stitch, and SL = slip stitch. Keeping these straight is key, since the slip stitches at the start of several rounds reposition you before the next petal.

faq.question: Will it fit any bottle?
faq.answer: The net stretches, so it adapts to many cup and bottle sizes. For a snugger or looser fit, adjust your hook size or yarn thickness rather than changing the chain counts.

faq.question: How is the scarf assembled from the motifs?
faq.answer: Each cat-face motif is finished with an outer border round of sc and chain loops, and the motifs are then joined edge to edge in a single row to form the scarf strip.

meta.intro: A crocheted doll head with detailed hair styling for the Reporter Alice character, including layered bangs, back-of-head strands, a bow, and a headband. It's a fun project for doll-makers who want a finished, personality-rich character with a journalist look.

faq.question: How is the hair attached to the head?
faq.answer: The hair is built from many individual chained strands of varying lengths. The bangs are worked first, then the back-of-head hair is made by chaining 48, wrapping it around the back of the head, and securing it. Each strand is worked back along its starting chain using sl st, sc, hdc, and dc to create natural taper.

faq.question: Why do the strands use different stitch heights along their length?
faq.answer: Mixing sl st, sc, hdc, and dc within a single strand makes the hair curl and lie in a more lifelike way. Shorter stitches at the base keep the strand flat near the scalp while taller dc toward the tip add curve and volume.

faq.question: Do I need to make both sides of the bangs separately?
faq.answer: No. After working Strands 1, 2, and 3, you repeat Strand 3, 2, 1 in reverse order to mirror the bangs on the other side so the front is symmetrical.

faq.question: What is a Sunny Doll?
faq.answer: A Sunny Doll is the crochet version of a teru teru bozu, a traditional good-weather charm shaped like a round head with a draped body. Coco is a chocolate-themed version finished with a beret, scarf, and bow tie.

faq.question: Why does the final head round use BLO?
faq.answer: Round 13 works the closing decreases in the back loops only (BLO). Working in the back loops creates a clean fold line so the remaining stitches cinch closed neatly without a bulky gap.

faq.question: How are the skirt and beret shaped?
faq.answer: Both the skirt and the beret use double crochet increases (dc inc) spaced progressively further apart each round, which flares the fabric outward. The beret then decreases with sc and dec near the brim to pull it back in to hat shape.

patterns.englishText:
Bubble Princess Dress (Labubu)
Cast on 36 sts (&=YO, K1, YO)
[Worked flat]
(54) Row 1: K6, &, KFB x5, &, K10, &, KFB x5, &, K6
Rows 2-4-6-8: Purl all
(86) Row 3: K7, &, KFB x12, &, K12, &, KFB x12, &, K7
(94) Row 5: K8, &, K26, &, K14, &, K26, &, K9
(102) Row 7: K9, &, K28, &, K16, &, K28, &, K9
(110) Row 9: K10, &, K30, &, K18, &, K30, &, K10
[Rnd 10: Join in round]
(50) Rnd 10: K11, hold 34 sleeve sts, M4, K20, M4, hold 34 sleeve sts, K11
(70) Rnd 11: *K2, &, K2* x10
Rnds 12-26: Continue increasing pattern
(210) Rnd 25: *K9, &* x10
(110) Rnd 27: *K2tog x5, K1, K2tog x5* x10

Sleeves: Pick up 6 underarm + 34 held sts = 40 sts
Rnds 1-4: K40
Rnd 5: K2tog around (20)
patterns.notes: This is a KNITTING pattern (not crochet) for a bubble princess dress for Labubu doll. Uses YO increases and K2tog decreases. Worked flat then joined in round.

meta.intro: A knitted bubble-style princess dress sized for a Labubu doll, worked top-down with a yoke before joining in the round and adding short sleeves. Note that this is a knitting pattern rather than crochet, ideal for dressing up a collectible doll.

faq.question: Is this a crochet or knitting pattern?
faq.answer: This is a knitting pattern, not crochet. It uses knit stitches with YO (yarn over) increases and K2tog decreases, worked on knitting needles rather than a crochet hook.

faq.question: How is the dress constructed?
faq.answer: It starts with 36 stitches cast on and is worked flat for the yoke, with raglan-style YO increases shaping the body and sleeve sections. At Row 10 the work is joined in the round, the sleeve stitches are held aside, and the body continues down before the held stitches are picked up to knit the sleeves.

faq.question: How do I make the bubble effect at the hem?
faq.answer: The body is increased dramatically (up to 210 stitches around Round 25) and then sharply decreased with paired K2tog clusters in Round 27, which gathers the fabric into the puffed bubble shape that gives the dress its name.

meta.intro: A novelty cup sleeve shaped like a popcorn bucket, with a red-and-white striped base and yellow popcorn bobbles on top, that cleverly folds up into a net bag. It's a fun, functional accessory for drinks that doubles as a conversation-starting carry pouch.

faq.question: How do I work the popcorn stitch?
faq.answer: Work 5 dc into the same stitch, then remove your hook from the working loop, insert it into the first dc of the group, pull the working loop back through, and ch 1 to secure. This pops the cluster of dc forward to mimic a piece of popcorn.

faq.question: How does the sleeve turn into a net bag?
faq.answer: The upper net section (Round 19 onward) is worked as *sc, ch 2, skip 2* around, creating an open mesh. Combined with the chain-45 strap, the sleeve folds up so the mesh forms a small net carry bag.

faq.question: How are the vertical red and white stripes made?
faq.answer: The striped bucket body uses front post double crochet (FPdc) with color changes, which creates raised vertical lines rather than horizontal rounds, giving the classic popcorn-bucket striped look.

Rnd 18: 6 sc, inc, 20 sc, inc, 12 sc, inc, 12 sc, inc, 14 sc, inc, 10 sc, inc, 4 sc (90)
Rnds 19-22: Sc in each st around (90)
Rnd 23: 39 sc, ch 6 (skip 12 sc), 39 sc (84)
Rnd 24: 37 sc, dec, 6 sc, dec, 37 sc (82)
Rnd 25: Sc in each st around (82) - mark last sc for leg chain connection
patterns.notes: Elephant body continued. Eyes placed between Rnds 16-17. Rnd 23 creates trunk hole.

Rnd 26: Skip 37 sc. Rejoin yarn and work 8 sc (8)

patterns.englishText:
Page 6 - Leg A:

Rnd 1: 21 sc (body), 6 sc (on Leg A chain) (27)
Rnd 2: 27 sc (27)
Rnd 3: 5 sc, dec, 12 sc, dec, 6 sc (25)
Rnd 4: 17 sc, dec, 6 sc (24)
Rnd 5: *2 sc, dec* x6 (18)
Rnd 6: *Sc, dec* x6 (12)
Rnd 7: Dec x6 (6)
Fasten off, close hole and weave in ends.

Leg B:
Count 15 sts from triangle edge, rejoin yarn.
Rnd 1: 15 sc (body), 6 sc (triangle edge), 6 sc (Leg B chain) (27)

Page 7:
Rnd 2: 27 sc (27)
Rnd 3: Dec, 12 sc, dec, 11 sc (25)
Rnd 4: Dec, 23 sc (24)
Rnd 5: *2 sc, dec* x6 (18)
Rnd 6: *Sc, dec* x6 (12)
Rnd 7: Dec x6 (6)
Fasten off.

Leg C:

Rnd 3: 5 sc, dec, 12 sc, dec, 6 sc (25)

R10: 9X (9)

R2: 6V (12)
R3: (1X, 1V), 重复6次 (18)
R4: (1V, 2X), 重复6次 (24)

R2: 1V, 4X, 3V, 4X, 2V (20)
R3: 1X, 1V, 5X, 1V, 1X, 1V, 1X, 1V, 5X, 1V, 1X, 1V (26)

Rnd 2: Sc in each st around (4)
Rnd 3: *Inc, sc* x2 (6)
Rnd 4: Sc in each st around (6)
Rnd 5: *Inc, 2 sc* x2 (8)

尾巴:
R1: 环形起针4个短针 4X (4)
R2: 4X (4)
R3: (1V, 1X), 重复2次 (6)
R4: 6X (6)
R5: (1V, 2X), 重复2次 (8)
R6-7: 8X (8)

patterns.notes: Ears (continued) with hdc shaping for curved top, and tail. Sew all pieces to body.

meta.intro: A large, huggable elephant amigurumi inspired by the Mao Buyi character style, built from an oval body with four picked-up legs, a sculpted trunk, and floppy ears. Its size and soft shaping make it a standout plushie or nursery decoration.
materials: Crochet hook suited to the yarn

faq.question: How are the four legs attached to the body?
faq.answer: The legs are not sewn on separately. Each leg starts by picking up stitches directly from the body and from the chain spaces (the leg chains A, B, C, D) marked around the oval, then is worked in the round and decreased closed. This gives a seamless join.

faq.question: What creates the trunk opening?
faq.answer: On Rnd 23 of the body you work 39 sc, chain 6 while skipping 12 sc, then 39 sc. That skipped section plus the chain forms the hole; the trunk is later worked by rejoining yarn and picking up stitches around that opening.

faq.question: Why does the pattern stress tension on the first round?
faq.answer: Rnd 1 should be worked slightly tight so the starting oval stays closed, while the following rounds are kept slightly loose. This keeps the body surface smooth and prevents the oval base from gaping or puckering.

faq.question: How does the belly piece fit?
faq.answer: The belly is a flat 24-stitch oval that sews onto the edges of the four leg chains. It is sized so 24 stitches equal 4 legs times 6 chain stitches each, so it should fit exactly once the body and trunk are stuffed firmly.

meta.intro: A Jellycat-style No.2 pencil amigurumi worked in one tube with color changes for the natural tip, yellow body, gray ferrule, and pink eraser, finished with two small feet. It makes a playful desk companion or a cute gift for stationery and plushie lovers.
materials: Yarn in natural/cream, light yellow, yellow, gray, and pink
Crochet hook suited to the yarn

faq.question: What order do the color changes go in?
faq.answer: Starting from the pencil tip: natural/cream for the point, then light yellow, then yellow for the long body (Rnds 8-32), gray for the metal ferrule, and pink for the eraser at the top.

faq.question: Why is Rnd 2 of the feet worked in back loops only?
faq.answer: Working that round in BLO (back loops only) creates a defined edge that shapes the little foot and keeps it from curling, helping the two feet sit flat against the body when sewn on.

faq.question: How much should I stuff the body?
faq.answer: Because the body is a long narrow tube only 20 stitches around, stuff it lightly and gradually as you go so it stays straight and pencil-like rather than bulging in the middle.

patterns.englishText:
Zhou Shen "Biao Yang" Mini Sheep Charm

DARK GRAY (face/back):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (18)

WHITE (wool fleece, worked in BLO):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: 6 inc in BLO (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc* in BLO, repeat around (18)

Assembly: Without cutting yarn, hold the two pieces (gray and white) wrong sides together and sl st around to join. Then work 2 rounds of BLO edging, *ch 3, sl st* around to make the woolly fleece loops. For the white piece, repeat the Rnd 2-3 *ch 3, sl st* loops. Finally, sl st around the remaining front loops in black.

EYES: White — work 5 *hdc, sl st* groups around. Yellow (held double) — 5 sc in MR.

EARS: ch 4, starting in 2nd ch from hook: sc, dc, sc.

faq.question: What makes these good for beginners?

faq.question: What kind of yarn works best for an amigurumi doll like this?
faq.answer: The pattern does not state a yarn. A smooth worsted or DK acrylic is a common choice for character dolls because it holds stitch definition and comes in a wide color range for the outfit and hair.

faq.question: How do I stop stuffing from showing through the doll?

meta.intro: A plump little crocheted pear worked in continuous rounds with a simple leaf and stem. This sweet fruit amigurumi makes a charming bowl filler, photo prop, or quick handmade gift.

faq.question: How is the pear's shape created?
faq.answer: The body increases to 30 stitches over the first five rounds, holds steady through Rnd 10, then decreases in stages (Rnds 11, 15, 19-20) to form the rounded bottom and narrower top of a pear.

faq.question: When should I stuff the pear?
faq.answer: Add fiberfill gradually as you work the decrease rounds, packing firmly before you close the final 6 stitches with the Rnd 20 fasten-off so the shape stays plump.

faq.question: How do I attach the leaf and stem?
faq.answer: The stem is a short chain worked into a single-crochet tube and the leaf is a chained piece with gradient double crochets; sew both to the top center of the pear once the body is closed.

author: 刀刀和舟舟

patterns.englishText:
Witch Doll Dress — Bodice, Skirt, Sleeves & Collar

Dress (worked top-down):
Row 1: Ch 17, sc in 2nd ch from hook and across (16). Divide the 16 sc into 2 x 6 + 4: one section each for the left and right front, one for each sleeve opening, two for the back, plus 1 st at each of the 4 corners. Join first and last to work in the round.
Rnd 2: sc in each sc; at each of the 4 corners work (sc, ch 2, sc) (4 corners)
Rnd 3-7: sc in each sc; into each corner ch-2 space work (sc, ch 2, sc)
Rnd 8: sc in each st around; when you reach corner 1, sc, ch 3, then skip directly across to corner 2 and sc; treat corners 3 and 4 the same way. Sleeves are now separated from the body.
Rnd 9: sc in each st around
Rnd 10: 2 dc in each st around
Rnd 11-19: dc in each st around
Rnd 20: sc in each st, ch 2 (picot/edging)

Sleeve (x2):
Rnd 1: sc in each st around
Rnd 2: sl st in each st around

Collar:
Starting at the center back, work: sc, dc, hdc, 2 sl st, hdc, dc, 2 sc, dc, hdc, 2 sl st, hdc, dc, sc
patterns.chineseText:
连衣裙:
R1: 起17ch, 倒2勾16x, 分成2*6份+4(左右前片各1份, 两只袖口各1份, 后背2份, 4个转角各1针), 首尾相连成环
R2: 短针的位置勾短针, 4个转角的位置勾(1x,2ch,1x)
R3-R7: 短针的位置勾短针, 每个转角的2ch空里勾(1x,2ch,1x)
R8: 每个针目勾1x, 到第1转角时勾1x, 勾3ch, 直接到第2转角勾1x, 第3、4转角同理。这里就完成分袖了。
R9: 每个针目勾1x
R10: 每个针目勾2t
R11-R19: 每个针目勾1t
R20: 每个针目勾1x, 2ch
袖子:
R1: 每个针目勾1x
R2: 每个针目勾1引拔针
领子: 从后背中间起针, 勾1x,1t,1f,2e,1f,1t,2x,1t,1f,2e,1f,1t,1x
patterns.notes: Part of the Little Witch doll outfit. Yarn: size 8 lace thread, colorway 610 for the dress. Hook: 1.0 mm. Shorthand: x = sc, t = dc, f = hdc, e = sl st. Dress is worked as a top-down yoke; Rnd 8 separates the sleeves, then the skirt is worked in dc.

patterns.englishText:
Witch Doll Accessories — Bag & Bow

Bag:
(I started with ch 13 but it felt a bit big, so the pattern is given with ch 11)
Rnd 1: Ch 11, working back from 2nd ch from hook: inc, 8 sc, inc (12)
Rnd 2: 3 inc, 8 sc, 3 inc (working around the foundation chain)
Rnd 3-10: sc in each st around
Row 11: Fold the bag flat, find the two end stitches, start at one side and sc across to the other side (this forms the flap base)
Row 12-16: Turn the work, dec 1 at the start, then sc across (decrease 1 each row; on row 14 leave 4 sts open in the very center as a buttonhole)
Finally sc 1 round all around the flap edge.

Button: 6 sc in a magic ring; Rnd 2: 6 inc; sew it to the center front of the bag.

Strap: sc 1 at one end, ch 40, sc 1 into the other end, then sl st back across all 40 chains, returning to the start; sl st to finish.

Bow:
Row 1: Ch 11, dc in 2nd ch from hook and across (10 dc)
Row 2-20: dc in each st, working back and forth in rows; finally sew the last row to the first to form a loop.
Pinch the center tight and sew to create the bow shape. Lastly, separately ch 100 and sl st back across; use it to cinch the bow center and sew the ends into a headband.
patterns.chineseText:
包包:
(我起了13ch, 但是感觉有点大, 图解就改成11ch了)
R1: 起11ch, 倒2勾w, 8x, w
R2: 勾3v, 8x, 3v
R3-R10: 一个针目勾1x
R11: 对折包包, 找到两端的两针, 从一侧起针, 勾短针到另一侧
R12-R16: 翻转织片, 先勾一个减针, 然后继续勾短针(每一行减一针, 第14行最中间需要4针预留扣眼)
最后沿着包包盖子勾1圈短针
扣子: 环起6x, 第二圈勾6v, 缝合再包包中间
包带: 从一端起1x, 然后勾40ch, 到另一端勾1x, 再倒回勾40引拔针, 回到起针的位置勾引拔针结束
蝴蝶结:
R1: 起11ch, 倒2勾10t
R2-R20: 每个针目勾1t, 来回片勾, 最后和第一行缝合成环
把中间捏紧缝起来, 这样就会有蝴蝶结的形状。最后再另起100ch, 倒回勾引拔针, 然后把蝴蝶结捆起来, 两端缝合成发带。
patterns.notes: Part of the Little Witch doll outfit. Yarn: size 8 lace thread, colorway 103 for the bow, 306 for the bag. Hook: 1.0 mm. Shorthand: x = sc, t = dc, w/v = inc. Bow can also be used as a hair band.

patterns.englishText:
Kitty Cat
Kitty ears: Ch 3, work back: sc, dc
Bow: MR, ch 2, 2 dc, ch 2, repeat once

Body:
MR 7 or 8 (either works)
Rnds 1-2 (color 02 or 49): 7 sc
Rnd 3 (light gray): 7 sc
Rnds 3-15 (main color): 7 sc
Rnds 16-21 (color 53 or 18): 7 sc, leave long tail on last rnd
Rnd 22: Pick up BLO (away from you), sew closed
patterns.chineseText:
kitty猫
kitty耳朵: 3ch 倒二回钩 X F
蝴蝶结: 环形起针2ch, 2F, 2CH 重复一次

R1-2(02或49): 7X
R3(浅灰): 7X
R3-15(颜色): 7X

meta.intro: A soft, simple kitty amigurumi worked as a small tube with color changes, finished with little ears and a tiny bow. Its beginner-friendly construction makes it a fast, cuddly make for cat and Sanrio fans alike.

faq.question: Should I start with a 7 or 8 stitch magic ring?
faq.answer: Either works, per the pattern notes. Use 7 for a slightly slimmer body or 8 for a touch more width; the rest of the rounds stay at the same low stitch count.

faq.question: How are the color changes arranged?
faq.answer: The body works in bands: the first rounds in one accent color, a light-gray round, the main color through Rnd 15, then a second accent color for Rnds 16-21 before closing.

faq.question: How do I close the body neatly?
faq.answer: Leave a long tail on the last round, then pick up the back loops only (BLO) facing away from you on Rnd 22 and sew the opening closed for a tidy finish.

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Star Cup Cozy — Assembly & Net Bag

Joining the two stars:
Place the two star pieces with right sides facing each other. Working through both layers around the outermost edge, sc all the way around (leave a small opening to turn it right side out).

Net bag (worked from the joined edge):
Ch 12, then sc 1 into the 5th stitch along; *ch 12, skip 5 sts, sc 1*, repeat around to build the netting.
patterns.chineseText: 2片星星面对面，最外圈钩短针。接着钩网兜，12锁针，每隔5个针目，钩1短针。
patterns.notes: Yarn: milk cotton (萌娃娃二号), colorway 18 light yellow. Hook: 2.0 mm. Make two star pieces, hold them right sides together, sc around the outer edge leaving an opening to turn, then continue with the net-bag section.

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Stars — Five Sizes

US terms. Shorthand: x=sc, F=hdc, T=tr, E=sl st, w=inc, k=incomplete hdc (yarn over, pull up a loop), sl=sl st.

Star 3.4 cm:
Rnd 1: 15 hdc in a magic ring (15)
Rnd 2: *ch 5, working back from the 2nd ch from hook: sc, tr, hdc, sl st, then yarn over twice & pull up loops (k2), sl st*, repeat 5 times to form 5 points

Star 3.5 cm:
Ch 61. Working back from the 2nd ch from hook, repeat 5 times: 11 sc, then inc (w). (forms 5 points)

Star 4.0 cm:
Rnd 1: ch 3, 2 hdc, ch 1, then *3 hdc, ch 1* 4 times
Rnd 2: sl st over to the 2nd hdc, then in each ch-space of Rnd 1 work (2 hdc, sl st, ch 3, sl st, 2 hdc); repeat in all 5 ch-spaces

Star 5.2 cm:
Rnd 1: in a magic ring work *hdc, ch 1* 10 times (10 hdc, 10 ch-1 spaces)
Rnd 2: in each ch-1 space of the previous round, make 4 incomplete hdc then yarn over and draw through all loops at once (puff), ch 3, move to next space and repeat; 10 puff groups total
Rnd 3: working into the ch-3 spaces, *sc, then (tr, 2 hdc, sl st, ch 3, sl st, 2 hdc, tr)*, repeat 5 times to form 5 points

Star 5.6 cm:
Rnd 1: ch 3, then *3 hdc, ch 3* 5 times
Rnd 2: in each large ch-space, work (3 hdc, ch 3, 3 hdc); repeat 5 times
Rnd 3: *sc, then in each large ch-space work (4 hdc, ch 3, 4 hdc)*, repeat 5 times
patterns.chineseText:
5种星星图解:
3.4cm: R1:15F  R2:【5ch, 倒2回钩(x, T, F, E, k2, sl)】*5
3.5cm: 61ch, 倒2回钩5(11x, w)
4.0cm: R1:3ch,2F, ch, 4(3F, ch)  R2:【sl到第二个F上, 在R1的ch上钩(2F, E, 3ch, E, 2F)】*5
5.2cm: R1.环起10*(F,1ch)  R2.在上一圈1ch洞里钩4个未完成中长针, 一次性钩出所有线圈锁一针, 3ch, 到下一个洞里重复钩织, 共10组  R3.在第二圈3ch洞里钩织, (x),(T,2F,E,3ch,E,2F,T)*5
5.6cm: R1:3ch,5(3F.3ch)  R2:大洞内(3F,3ch,3F)*5  R3:[x, 大洞内(4F,3ch,4F)]*5
patterns.notes: Five star sizes given: 3.4 cm, 3.5 cm, 4.0 cm, 5.2 cm, 5.6 cm. The 3.5 cm version is a chain-based star ring. Notation: F = hdc, T = tr, E = sl st, w = inc, k = incomplete hdc loop held on hook for a puff.

meta.intro: A cozy cup sleeve decorated with a crocheted star motif that slips over a takeaway or drink cup. It is a quick, practical accessory that adds a handmade touch while protecting your hands from hot or cold drinks.

faq.question: Will this sleeve fit my cup?
faq.answer: Cup sleeves fit best when sized to your specific cup; work a quick gauge check and adjust the round circumference so the finished band hugs the cup snugly without being too tight to slide on.

faq.question: What yarn works best for a cup sleeve?
faq.answer: Cotton or a cotton blend is a good choice because it holds its shape, handles warmth from hot drinks well, and washes easily.

有没有和我一样超爱宝可梦的友友们！今天来给大家分享 10 只超萌的迷你宝可梦图解，每一只都可爱到犯规，赶紧来看看有没有你喜欢的宝可梦吧💕
🎈皮卡丘
永远的萌神皮卡丘，圆滚滚的身体，闪电形状的尾巴，脸颊上的电气袋粉粉嫩嫩，仿佛在对你卖萌放电。

可以进化成多种形态的伊布，本身就超级可爱。毛茸茸的身体，大大的耳朵，像个小团子一样，让人忍不住想要抱一抱。

author: Amy手工

patterns.englishText:
Vaporeon — Head, Body & Tail

Head (alternate Blue and Light Blue):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc, (sc, sc), inc... worked as 4 inc, (sc, sc), inc across (12)
Rnd 3: sc, inc, (sc, inc) x3, (sc, inc) x2 (18)
Rnd 4: 2 sc, inc, (2 sc, inc) x2, sc, (sc, sc), (2 sc, inc) x2 (24)
Rnd 5: 24 sc (24)
Rnd 6: 3 sc, (sc, dec) x6, 3 sc, (3 sc, inc) x2 (30)
Rnd 7: 30 sc (30)
Rnd 8-9: 30 sc (30)
Place eyes between Rnd 8-9, 5 sts apart.
Rnd 10: (3 sc, dec) x6 — decreasing toward (12)
Rnd 11: (2 sc, dec) x6 (18)
Rnd 12: (sc, dec) x6 (12)
Fasten off, stuff.

Body (Light Blue):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc, sc, bobble, inc) x2, (2 sc, inc) x2 (24)
Rnd 5: (2 sc, dec) x6 (18)
Rnd 6: 6 sc, bobble, sc, bobble, 9 sc (18)
Rnd 7: (sc, dec) x6 (12)

Tail (Light Blue):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (8)
Rnd 3: (3 sc, inc) x2 (10)
Rnd 4: 5 dec (5)
Make two of the above, join with sl st and continue.
Rnd 5: 5 sc, 2 dec, sc, 2 dec (6)
Rnd 6: 6 sc (6)
Rnd 7: (sc, inc) x3 (9)
Rnd 8: (2 sc, inc) x3 (12)
Sew tail to body between Rnd 3-5.
patterns.notes: Part of a 10-piece mini Pokémon (Eeveelutions) plush set. Made in chenille/velvet yarn. Head and body use bobble stitches for cheeks/body texture. Colorway: blue and light blue alternating.

patterns.englishText:
Vaporeon — Tail Fin, Head Crest, Side & Front Fins

Tail Fin: Work along tail between Rnd 7-8, in Blue: (sc, sl st) x2, sl st.

Head Crest: Work around the head in White: tr, (hdc, ch 2, sc), sl st; repeat around.

Side Fins (make on both sides of head, inserting between Rnd 6-7, in Blue):
Row 1: ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 6 sc (6)
Row 2: turn, sl st to head between Rnd 7-8, 6 sc (6)
Row 3: change to Cream, ch 1, [sc, (sc, ch 2, sc)] x2, ch 1

Front Fin (work in center top of head, inserting between Rnd 3-4, in Blue):
Row 1: ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 5 sc (5)
Row 2: turn, sl st to head between Rnd 2-3, 5 sc (5)
Row 3: turn, change to Cream, ch 1, 4 sc (4)
Row 4: turn, sl st to head between Rnd 1-2, ch 1, 3 sc (3)
Row 5: turn, ch 1, 2 sc (2)
patterns.chineseText: 尾棘: 在尾巴R7-8之间钩 蓝色(X,SL)*2,SL. 头棘: 用白色沿头部一圈钩 T,(F,2CH,X),SL循环. 侧翼: 用蓝色在头两侧R6-7之间入针钩 R1: 7CH倒2勾6X; R2: 翻转引拔到头R7-8之间钩6X; R3: 换米色K1,[X,(X,2CH,X)]*2,K1. 前翼: 用蓝色在头顶中间R3-4入针钩 R1: 6CH倒2勾5X; R2: 翻转引拔到头R2-3之间钩5X; R3: 翻转换米色K1,4X; R4: 翻转引拔到头R1-2之间钩K1,3X; R5: 翻转K1,2X.
patterns.notes: Vaporeon fins and crest are worked directly onto the assembled head/tail. Fins worked flat in rows. Cream tips on side and front fins.

patterns.englishText:
Espeon — Head, Body, Ears, Tail & Forehead Gem

Head (Purple):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc) x6 (24)
Rnd 5: 24 sc (24)
Rnd 6: (3 sc, inc) x6 (30)
Rnd 7-9: 30 sc (30)
Place eyes between Rnd 8-9, 5 sts apart.
Rnd 11: (2 sc, dec) x6 (18)
Rnd 12: (sc, dec) x6 (12)

Body (Purple):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc, sc, bobble, inc) x2, (2 sc, inc) x2 (24)
Rnd 5: (2 sc, dec) x5, 2 sc, dec (18)
Rnd 6: 6 sc, bobble, sc, bobble, 9 sc (18)
Rnd 7: (sc, dec) x6 (12)

Ears (make 2; alternate Purple and Dark Blue):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: (sc, inc) x2 (6)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, (sc, sc), 2 sc, inc (8)
Rnd 4: 3 sc, inc, 3 sc, inc (10)
Rnd 5: 3 sc, inc, sc, 3 sc, inc, sc (12)
Rnd 6: 3 sc, inc, sc, inc, 3 sc, inc, sc, inc (14)
Rnd 7-8: 16 sc (16)
Rnd 9: 3 sc, 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, 5 sc, inc, 2 sc (18)
Rnd 10-11: 18 sc (18)
Sew ears to head between Rnd 3-7.

Tail: Insert at back between Rnd 3-5, ch 19, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 18 sc; at the tip (sts 6-7) make a fork: ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 6 sc.

Forehead Gem: 6 sc in MR in Red; attach to head between Rnd 5-6.
patterns.notes: Espeon (purple Eeveelution). Bobble stitches mark the body. Ears are two-tone (purple/dark blue). Red magic-ring disc is the forehead gem. Forked tail.

patterns.englishText:
Espeon Whiskers & Flareon — Ears and Head Tuft

Espeon Whiskers (make 2; Purple):
Rnd 1: 3 sc in MR (3)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (6)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x3 (9)
Rnd 4: (sc, dec) x3 (6)
Rnd 5-6: 6 sc (6)
Then ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook (sl st), sc. Attach whiskers to both sides of head at Rnd 8.

patterns.englishText:

Rnd 2: inc, 2 (tr inc), inc (8)

Rnd 5: 5 sc, (hdc, hdc inc) x4, 5 sc (22)

Head and Body follow the universal base pattern; switch the hands/feet bobble stitches to Brown.

patterns.englishText:

Head Leaf (Green): ch 2 in MR, 3 hdc, ch 2, 2 hdc, ch 1, sl st. Attach to head between Rnd 4-5.

patterns.chineseText: 叶子(Leafeon): 绿色MR2CH,3F,2CH,2F,1CH,SL 固定在头R4-5之间。尾巴(片钩): R1: 米色2CH倒2勾X[1]; R2: 翻转米色V[2]; R3: 翻转绿色2X[2]; R4: 翻转绿色X,V[3]; R5: 翻转绿色3X[3]; R6: 翻转绿色2X,V[4]; R7: 翻转绿色4X[4]; R8: 翻转绿色3X,V[5]; R9: 翻转绿色5X[5]; R10: 翻转绿色K1,4X[4]; R11: 翻转绿色K1,3X[3]; R12: 翻转绿色K1,2X[2]; R13: 翻转绿色K1,X[1]; 将尾巴缝合在身体R3-5之间。

patterns.englishText:

Head and Body Rnd 1-6 follow the universal base pattern.

Rnd 2: sc, (sc, sc), sc, inc (6)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc (8)
Rnd 4: 2 sc, sc, inc, 2 sc, sc, inc (10)

meta.intro: A collection of ten tiny Pokemon amigurumi worked as a coordinated set of mini characters. These bite-sized makes are great for keychains, desk companions, or building out a whole crocheted Pokemon lineup.

faq.question: How many characters are in this set?
faq.answer: The set covers ten different mini Pokemon characters, so you can make them individually or as a complete collection.

faq.question: What yarn weight suits mini amigurumi?
faq.answer: Smaller characters look crispest in a thinner yarn worked at a tight gauge; choose a lighter weight and a correspondingly small hook so the stuffing does not show through the stitches.

faq.question: How is the bag base shaped?

faq.question: How long is the strap?

faq.question: Why work the base round in back loops only?

Mandala Coaster — Step-by-step Photo Tutorial

meta.intro: A colorful round mandala coaster worked in eight rounds from the center out, combining bobble clusters, dc groups, and a scalloped fan edge across three colors. It protects surfaces while adding a bright handmade touch to a table or desk.

faq.question: How do I make the bobble stitch used in the early rounds?
faq.answer: The bobble is a 2-dc cluster: yarn over, insert hook, pull up a loop, yarn over and pull through 2 loops, repeat the dc, then yarn over and pull through all the loops on the hook to close the cluster.

faq.question: When do I change colors?

patterns.englishText:
Simple Coaster

Rnd 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 11 dc in MR, sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. (12 dc)
Rnd 2: Join yarn, ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in same st, ch 1, *dc-inc in next st, ch 1*, repeat around, sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. (24 dc, 12 ch-1 sps)
Rnd 3: Join yarn, ch 3, 2 dc in first ch-1 sp, ch 2, *3 dc in next ch-1 sp, ch 2*, repeat around, sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. (36 dc, 12 ch-2 sps)
Rnd 4: Join yarn, ch 3, dc in next st, ch 2, 2 dc in ch-2 sp, *(2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 sp*, repeat around, sl st. Fasten off. (48 dc, 12 ch-2 sps)
Rnd 5: Join yarn, ch 3, 6 dc in ch-2 sp (7 dc total with ch-3), sc between the 4-dc groups of Rnd 4, *7 dc in next ch-2 sp, sc between groups*, repeat around, sl st. Fasten off.

Note: Fasten off after each round. Ch 3 at start of each round counts as 1 dc.

patterns.notes: Symbol chart (quarter section shown). Each round is fastened off and rejoined. The ch-3 turning chain counts as 1 dc. Final round creates a scalloped flower edge with 7-dc fan shells separated by sc.

meta.intro: A quick round coaster that grows from a magic ring through five rounds of dc clusters and chain spaces, finishing with a scalloped flower edge of 7-dc fan shells. It's a beginner-friendly project and a satisfying way to use up small amounts of yarn.

faq.question: Does the turning chain count as a stitch?
faq.answer: Yes. The ch-3 worked at the start of each round counts as 1 dc, so you join with a slip stitch to the top of that ch-3 to close each round.

faq.question: Why does the pattern fasten off after every round?
faq.answer: Each round is fastened off and the yarn rejoined for the next, which keeps the rounds tidy and is useful if you want to change colors between rounds.

faq.question: What creates the decorative edge?
faq.answer: The final round forms a scalloped flower border by working 7-dc fan shells into the ch-2 spaces, separated by single crochets between the dc groups of the previous round.

patterns.englishText:
Triomphe Arch Pendant — Handwritten Chart

This is a miniature Celine Triomphe arch charm worked in multiple steps:

1. Ch 2, 4 dc (working back), ch 2, sl st back 5 sts
2. Ch 5, work petal: sl st, hdc, dc, hdc, sl st (repeat for 3 rows)
3. Ch 4, sl st back 4
4. At front of row 3: ch 5
5. Work downward with sl st along 3 rows, ch 4, sl st back down 3 rows
6. Inc across 3 rows (building the arch columns)
7. After ch 5, repeat from beginning for second column; both sides return to first st, 4 dc, sl st
8. Same as back: 3 sts, 5 sts sl st, hdc, dc, hdc, sl st; then skip 3, ch 6, sl st
9. 3 sl st at front, ch toward center on both sides, sl st back 3, 3 sts, fasten off.

materials: Single strand of yarn in 3 gradient pink colors

faq.question: What creates the diagonal stripe texture?
faq.answer: The diagonal effect comes from Front Post Double Crochet (FPdc) worked in an offset pattern over a 12-stitch repeat. Following the symbol chart so the posts shift each round is what produces the slanted ridges.

faq.question: How is the base shaped?
faq.answer: You chain 34 and work double crochet down both sides of the chain with dc-increases at each corner (the FW/FV marks), forming an oval/rectangular base of 64 stitches that the body builds up from.

faq.question: Can I change the bag's height?
faq.answer: Yes. After the base, you simply repeat the diagonal pattern rows until the pouch reaches your desired height before adding the scallop edging and button tab.

title: Rice Ball (make 2 identical pieces)
description:
Jellycat系列玉子烧寿司

#钩针小物[话题]# #手工钩织[话题]# #钩针图解[话题]# #钩针玩偶[话题]# #钩织使我快乐[话题]# #织女[话题]#
author: 板栗爱吃草莓🌰

patterns.englishText:
--- Rice Ball (make 2 identical pieces) ---
R1: Ch 10
R2: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, 7 sc, 3 sc in last ch (turn corner), 7 sc along other side, inc in last st (26)
R3: Inc, 7 sc, 3 inc, 7 sc, 2 inc (32)
Make 2 pieces; fasten off one piece, keep yarn attached on the other.
R4: Place pieces together, (BLO) 26 sc through both layers to join
R5-R7: Sc in each st around (26)
Stuff with fiberfill, sew the remaining opening closed.

--- Shrimp ---
With white yarn:
R1: 6 sc in MR (6)
R2: Inc in each st around (12)
R3-R8: Sc in each st around (12)
R9: Dec, 8 sc, dec (10)
R10: Dec, 6 sc, dec (8)
R11: Dec, 4 sc, dec (6)
Change to orange yarn:
R12: Sc in each st around (6)
R13: Inc in each st around (12)
R14: Fold flat, sc through both layers to close (12)

Assembly: Place shrimp on top of rice ball, sew together.
patterns.chineseText:
饭团：
R1: 10CH
R2: 倒2, 8X, W, 7X, V
R3: V, 7X, 3V, 7X, 2V
勾2片，一片断线，一片不断线
R4: blo26X
R5-R7: 26X
塞棉，把勾好的一片缝合上去

甜虾：
R1: 6X
R2: 6V
R3-R8: 12X
R9: A, 8X, A
R10: A, 6X, A
R11: A, 4X, A
换橙色线R12: 6X
R13: 6V

patterns.notes: 3.0mm hook. Colors: white (rice), light pink (rice accent), orange-red (shrimp). W = 3 sc in same st. V = inc. A = dec. BLO = back loop only. Inspired by Jellycat-style sushi amigurumi (tamago/egg sushi).

meta.intro: An adorable amigurumi sushi rice ball topped with a little crocheted shrimp, inspired by Jellycat-style plush sushi. It's a fun, beginner-friendly food piece that makes a cute desk buddy, keychain charm, or gift for sushi lovers.

faq.question: Why do I make two identical rice-ball pieces?
faq.answer: The two oval pieces are placed together and joined with back-loop-only single crochet through both layers, which gives the rice ball its flat, pinched sushi shape rather than a fully round ball.

faq.question: When do I stuff the rice ball?
faq.answer: Stuff with fiberfill after working rounds R4-R7, then sew the remaining opening closed so the piece holds its plump shape.

faq.question: How is the shrimp attached?
faq.answer: The shrimp is worked separately in white then orange, folded flat and closed, then placed on top of the rice ball and sewn in place during assembly.

title: Earth Globe Pattern
description:

换线不规则反而更像地球～不追求无痕换线啦。【圆的技巧】没塞棉前就是偏椭圆的，塞棉后就变圆了，多往两侧四周塞；钩两三圈就剪开换线的连接线。[哭惹R]我就是塞棉太心急了，不够多，正面看还是不够圆，不如正上方看着圆。

#钩针挂件[话题]# #地球村[话题]# #钩针图解[话题]# #钩针[话题]# #手工钩织[话题]# #钩织[话题]# #钩织小物[话题]#
author: 柯米嘟嘟

patterns.englishText:
Earth Globe Pattern — Color-coded Amigurumi Chart
Colors: White / Royal Blue / Grass Green / Ginger Yellow

Increase section:
R1: 6 sc in MR (6)
R2: Inc in each st around (12)
R3: *Sc, inc*, repeat around (18)
R4: *2 sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
R5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (30)
R6: *4 sc, inc*, repeat around (36)
R7: *5 sc, inc*, repeat around (42)
R8: *6 sc, inc*, repeat around (48)

Body (follow color chart for earth map pattern):
R9-R18: Sc in each st around (48) — change colors per stitch as shown in chart

Decrease section:
R19: *6 sc, dec*, repeat around (42)
R20: *5 sc, dec*, repeat around (36)
R21: *4 sc, dec*, repeat around (30)
R22: *3 sc, dec*, repeat around (24) — begin stuffing
R23: *2 sc, dec*, repeat around (18)
R24: *Sc, dec*, repeat around (12)
R25: *4 sc, dec* (or as charted) — continue stuffing
R26: Dec around, fasten off (6)

Color placement per stitch follows the chart — irregular color changes create the world map continents.
patterns.chineseText:
毛线地球图解（带颜色编排）
颜色：纯白/宝蓝/草绿/姜黄
R1: 6X (6)
R2: 6V (12)
R3: (X, V)×6 (18)
R4: (X, V, X)×6 或类似 (24)
R5: (3X, V)×6 (30)
R6-R7: 继续加针至42-48
R8-R18: 不加不减，按颜色图钩织地球图案
R19起开始减针
R25-R26: 收口
每针的颜色按图中彩色标注排列（绿=草绿，蓝=宝蓝，黄=姜黄，白=纯白）
patterns.notes: 2.0mm hook. 4 colors of yarn (white, royal blue, grass green, ginger yellow). The color chart shows per-stitch color assignments to create a world map pattern. Stuff firmly around the sides to achieve a round shape. Cut connecting threads every 2-3 rounds when changing colors. The increase/decrease structure follows standard amigurumi sphere shaping; the unique aspect is the per-stitch color pattern.

meta.intro: A round amigurumi globe whose continents are formed by per-stitch color changes following a world-map chart. This colorwork sphere makes a charming decorative piece for a shelf, classroom, or anyone who loves geography and travel.

faq.question: How are the continents created?
faq.answer: The sphere itself uses standard amigurumi increase/decrease shaping; the world map comes entirely from changing yarn color per stitch according to the color chart, so the difficulty is in tracking the colorwork rather than the shaping.

faq.question: How do I keep the back of the work tidy when changing colors?
faq.answer: Cut the connecting threads every 2-3 rounds when changing colors so you don't carry long floats across the inside of the globe.

faq.question: How do I get a nicely round shape?
faq.answer: Stuff firmly around the sides as you close the decrease section so the globe holds a smooth, round form rather than collapsing flat.

patterns.englishText:
Mini Net Earphone Bag

Main Body:
R1: Ch 61, skip 24, 5 sc, ch 3, skip 3, sc, *(ch 6, skip 6, sc)* repeat 6 times, ch 3, skip 3, 5 sc
R2: (BLO) 5 sc, *(ch 6, skip 6, sc)* repeat 7 times, (BLO) 5 sc
R3: (BLO) 5 sc, starting in ch-1 sp: ch 3, sc, *(ch 6, sc)* repeat 6 times, ch 3, (BLO) 5 sc
Repeat R2-R3 until R19, fasten off.

Bag Opening:
R1: 19 sc (19)
R2: (BLO) 19 sc (19)
R3: (BLO) 19 sc (19)

Strap + Clasp:
Starting from any side of the bag opening:
R1: 3 sc, 5 sc, 8 sc (1 sc in each net hole), 5 sc, 3 sc, ch 30, 3 sc, 5 sc, 8 sc (1 sc in each net hole), 5 sc, 3 sc, ch 30, sl st to first st
R2-3: (BLO) work even around
patterns.chineseText:
钩针mini渔网耳机包
主体：
R1: 61ch, 倒24钩5X, 3CH, K3, X, (6CH, K6, X)6, 3CH, K3, 5X
R2: (离自己远的半针)5X, (6CH, K6, X)7, (离自己远的半针)5X
R3: (离自己远的半针)5X, 开始在锁针1锁钩钩3CH, X, (6CH, X)6, 3CH, (离自己远的半针)5X
重复R2-3钩织到R19行，断线
袋口：
R1: 19X
R2: (离自己远的半针)19X
R3: (离自己远的半针)19X
袋带+扣：
袋口从侧面任意开始钩R1: 3X, 5X, 8X(网兜位置每个洞钩一个短针), 5X, 3X, 30CH, 3X, 5X, 8X(网兜位置每个洞钩一个短针), 5X, 3X, 30CH, 引导至第一针
R2-3: (离自己远的半针)不加不减钩完
patterns.notes: 1.8mm hook, #5 lace thread. Mini net bag for earphones/AirPods. BLO = back loop only throughout most of the pattern.

meta.intro: A delicate open-net mini pouch sized for earphones or AirPods, finished with a clasp strap so it can hang from a bag or keychain. The airy mesh and fine thread give it a dainty, lacy look while still holding small essentials.

faq.question: What forms the net pattern?
faq.answer: The mesh is built by alternating short single-crochet sections with ch-6 loops worked over skipped stitches (the *(ch 6, skip 6, sc)* repeats), creating the open net holes that give the bag its lightweight look.

faq.question: Why is so much of the pattern worked in back loop only?
faq.answer: Back loop only is used through most of the body and opening to create a defined ridge line and a slightly stretchy, structured edge that helps the small bag keep its shape.

faq.question: How is the strap added?
faq.answer: The strap is worked directly from the bag opening, single crocheting around (including one sc into each net hole) and chaining 30 to form the strap loops before joining with a slip stitch.

title: Flower & Bird Scarf
description:
🌸
环形起针
🐦
蓝色辫子针位置入针钩
